# dsh-TUI > An interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness. It ships a pixel-whale > header, live work status, streaming thinking, double-Esc time rewind, a > context progress bar, and a TPS gauge. Zero core changes: it consumes only > DSH's public exports, and is moving from a mounted plugin to an app with its > own entry and composition root, where DSH loads in process as the first-party > backend. Install to enable; uninstall leaves no patches behind. The prompt footer hides completed goals once the turn is idle; the Todo side panel retains their history. `Ctrl+Q` folds todos while working and hides/restores the idle goal/todo footer. Clicking its todo header also hides it while idle. Hiding changes only this display: a new goal/todo snapshot or session reveals it again, and `/goal clear` does not clear todos. Split diff cards give one-sided additions and deletions the full body width, without an empty opposite pane. Ordinary edits remain side by side, and mixed files choose their layout separately before folding or streaming reveal. Compaction status stays on one line in narrow panes: phase and cancellation hints yield first, then the label is shortened; elapsed time is shown only as a complete field. Image files referenced with `@path` use the same admission and resize/conversion policy as pasted images. Adjustment notices report the stored dimensions and format; required animation conversion is refused instead of dropping frames. Mention images and staged images still share count and stored-byte limits in source order. ## Highlights Panels without a verified Component identity are temporary: settings show their title and a distinct number for this run. Their toggles take effect immediately without being saved, and unrelated settings changes preserve that choice. Old `actN:panel` entries cannot be mapped safely: remove the placeholder and select the current panel again. Verified Components named `actN` keep their public runtime address; an explicit selection uses `component:actN:panel` in saved preferences to avoid claiming an old anonymous entry. The default reasoning-effort setting offers the current backend/model’s declared tiers, including custom IDs. Saved values absent from that catalog stay visible and stored; while loading or unavailable, only Auto is selectable. On DSH, Auto follows the saved `/effort` choice, then the configured effort, then the model default. Claude/Codex retain backend preferences for Auto at startup and for resumed sessions; explicitly choosing Auto resets the model default. Explicit settings changes affect the next request; unsupported preferences fall back with a notice and are never forced onto a route. Resuming a DSH session preserves its recorded reasoning effort (or its live selection when reattaching). The saved default seeds new sessions; explicit `/effort` and effort-default settings changes still apply to the current session’s next request. - **Pixel whale pet** — three startup intros, click to wake; freezes after the first task. - **Launchpad and first-run guide** — every ordinary launch lands on a landing page with a **real input box** (big text + whale + quick actions, dropping whole blocks on short/narrow terminals; whale-girl images use a compact native-canvas footprint instead of leaving a large gap before the title; on by default — /settings `launchpad` off boots straight into chat); command completion matches chat: `Tab` fills the input, `Enter` runs the command and clears it. The first run walks a four-step wizard (API key / language+theme / model+workspace / shortcuts), re-runnable with `/setup`. - **Terminal-native UI** — streaming Markdown, tool cards, `/` and `@` completion, `#L12-14` ranges, history search, zh/en UI. - **Task completion notifications** — DSH, Claude and Codex notify after successful live work settles, with no queued follow-up or active goal. The title is “dsh-TUI · Task complete”; the body shows the latest settled reply as a single-line plain-text preview (Markdown formatting removed, up to 200 characters). OSC 777/9 apply an additional 2048-byte sequence budget, including title and protocol bytes, preserving whole graphemes. No reply shows only the title; BEL only rings. `/settings` → Conversation: `taskNotifications` = `unfocused` (default), `always`, or `off`; `notificationMethod` = `auto` (default), `osc9`, `bel`, or `windows`. Auto uses separate title/body fields on Ghostty/WezTerm (OSC 777) and Kitty (OSC 99); iTerm2/Warp and explicit `osc9` use a title prefix; other terminals ring the bell; delivery follows your terminal's notification/bell settings. On local Windows, `auto` resolves to `windows`, the system's native notifications: a task-completion toast. The first toast registers that user's AppUserModelID under HKCU, the toast appears about 3 seconds after the task ends (the PowerShell cold start that buys the no-extra-install route), and for DSH sessions an enabled, active external DSH notification plugin in the running profile makes dsh-TUI yield to it (no toast, no bell); an installed but disabled plugin does not suppress notifications; if that AppUserModelID cannot be written, the notification falls back to the bell instead of going silent. SSH sessions keep the attached terminal's notification protocol in `auto` mode; explicit `windows` still selects the host's native transport. tmux requires `set -g allow-passthrough on` for OSC notifications and `set -g focus-events on` for focus reporting. Terminals without focus reporting need `always`. Replay, cancellation and failures do not notify. Works in inline and fullscreen modes. - **Native cursor** — focused text inputs inherit your terminal's cursor shape, color, blinking, and enabled animation or trail effects in both inline and fullscreen modes. The `/model` picker shows the same cursor during movement between provider tabs, model rows, and effort levels, then hides it after **0.5 seconds at rest**; clipped regions fall back to the model row. The session manager also moves this cursor between the workspace rail, session rows, and search box; typing claims the search caret, and navigation returns it to the focused row. Configure animation and trail effects in your terminal. - **Images** — Kitty/Sixel thumbnails, centered preview with zoom and pan, paste-time fitting, text fallback. Kitty images scale to the reserved cells' physical pixels, including on HiDPI terminals. - **Mermaid diagrams** — ````mermaid ```` fences drawn as Unicode diagrams. - **LaTeX math** — `$…$` and `$$…$$` formulas as Unicode text, fractions and limits stacked in display blocks; `mathRendering: image` typesets block and one-row inline formulas as terminal images on graphics terminals. - **Timeline rail** — every turn clickable; timeline / scrollbar / hidden gutter. - **Side panel** — `Ctrl+B` splits the chat with a panel column once the terminal is wide enough; drag the divider to resize it. All eight built-in panels are enabled by default, and so are plugin panels registered later (`sidePanel.panels: '*'`; untick a row in `/settings` to switch to an explicit list). The header shows each inactive panel's symbol; hover to see its name. Narrow terminals and inline mode keep full-screen panels. - **Live state** — activity animation, context bar, TPS, cache hit rate, effort, tokens, session cost estimate (main + subagents), Git and session metadata. Title, trajectory-strip and session-state animations update independently of the transcript and pause when idle or unfocused. Context-bar fill follows backend occupancy; colors estimate content composition. Compaction clears obsolete estimates, and missing composition displays a single used block with a measured used count in both hover details. - **One session manager** — `/resume` `/home` `/agentview` `/bg` `⌸`. - **Session workflow** — `/new` `/compact` `/export` `/btw`, model hot-switch, fork, rewind, vim, fullscreen draft editor. `/btw` uses an overlay when its sidebar cannot render. Main-task questionnaires and the fullscreen draft editor take priority while preserving the side question and draft. - **IDE selection channel** — a VS Code selection lands in the prompt. - **DSH integrations** — presets, skills, MCP, goals, todos, subagents, questionnaires. - **Account sign-in** — the standard profile offers pi-ai OAuth for ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, and Grok (plus OpenAI direct and Meta Muse when available), and Host-owned DeepSeek browser sign-in as `deepseek-account` on DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+. Use `/provider` or `/auth` without another plugin. A profile-only update from a global TUI patch that already mounts `dsh-tui-auth` can still start the official loopback callback listener on demand; fixed-port SSH forwarding still requires the global package to be aligned. - **Extensions** — browser interaction, computer use and more. - **Built for long sessions** — event-driven projection, virtualization, bounded caches. Keys and commands: [Interaction and commands](docs/interaction.en.md). Everything else: [documentation index](docs/README.md). Plugin side panels stay enabled when unrelated settings change. Editing the enabled panel list still applies your explicit selection. Workspace side-panel counts match the session manager: the current conversation counts; empty logs, subagents, fork ancestors and archived sessions do not. Registered workspaces with no visible conversations remain at zero. Loading and read errors are shown separately; press `r` to refresh. Fullscreen mouse selection stays in the pane where the gesture starts, including chat, sidebar and either diff column. Diagonal, word and line selection copy that pane’s text; soft wraps join independently, source newlines remain, and divider drags only resize. ## Preview
## Featured & Listed Among the community plugins recommended by the **official lead of DeepSeek Harness**, dsh-TUI is the first. Featured by the **DeepSeek Harness official WeChat account**, listed in the [dshfind](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) plugin directory, and ranked **#7 on [GitHub Trending](https://trendshift.io/repositories/146168) daily** (TypeScript).

Featured by the official WeChat account
Listed in the dshfind directory


GitHub Trending Daily #7
## Quick Start ### Windows one-click installer (x64) Download `dsh-tui-setup-win-x64.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/releases) and run it. Per-user, no administrator, fully offline, and no preinstalled Node or DSH. ### Command-line installation Prerequisites: [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en) and [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The `deepseek-official` API-key route needs `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. On DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+, the standard profile can instead use `/auth login deepseek-account` and select the separate account route through `/model`. Other supported accounts can sign in through `/provider` or `/auth` after startup. The primary compatibility target is DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. This adapter supports its Shell API, V4 session messages, declarative presets, and profile-backed settings; older supported hosts retain their compatibility paths. See [configuration](docs/configuration.en.md). On DSH rc.2, `/settings` also selects DeepSeek Search / Fetch APIs and edits their endpoint and result limits, supporting custom Loader entry IDs and a masked API key input saved through DSH's credential store. Official Flash model labels show the `1017` release marker while retaining the `deepseek-flash` model ID. `/settings` groups its sections into pages: the TUI's own settings sit under **General**, and plugins that declare a page get their own tab (`Tab` / `Shift+Tab`, or a click on the strip in fullscreen, switches pages; the strip is hidden when only one page exists). On DSH 0.1.7, `/settings` uses the TUI's actual Loader entry ID, including custom IDs. It requires matching profile dependencies with `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.3 or newer; an incompatible schema stops TUI startup with repair guidance instead of showing an uneditable settings page. Older hosts keep their legacy settings scope. The `dsh-tui` section of `/settings` is saved in `~/.dsh-tui/settings.json`, shared by every kernel; the first launch imports it once from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (and an older host's `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`) (see [configuration](docs/configuration.en.md#tui-configuration)). ```sh # Install the CLI and this plugin globally (ships the dsh-tui command) npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui # Start (first run auto-initializes the profile; needs pnpm) dsh-tui # Both `dsh-tui` and the short `dst` alias start the same TUI. dst ``` Manual alternative: `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`. The repo's `sh install.sh` runs that step and checks the required commands. Afterwards `dsh-tui` and `dsh --profile dsh-tui` are equivalent. > **New-user note**: pnpm ≥11 blocks dependencies with install scripts by > default and reports `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`. Updates skip foreign-platform > natives — the `@img/sharp-*` packages and the Claude SDK's per-platform > bundles — so only this machine's binaries are fetched. `/update` and > `dsh-tui update` write both settings automatically. An update never installs > the Claude SDK on its own: it enters a profile only when you pick that > backend in the kernel picker, which then installs the pinned SDK for the > running platform. No manual step needed. Details: > [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md#pnpm-install-script-blocks-and-foreign-platform-natives). After startup the TUI checks for newer versions in the background. It never blocks the first frame. Type `/update` for a one-shot upgrade. It restarts automatically and resumes the current session. See [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md) for the profile lifecycle, source builds, and troubleshooting, including migration from the former `dsh-cc-tui` package. ### CLI Automation: `dst -p "task"`, `dst run --json`, `dst session list --json`. The independent engine does not load the TUI or inherit its profile/preferences; it uses official DSH headless/services (validated on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2). `dst cli --help` lists its commands; `dst dsh ` forwards native DSH. See [Automation CLI](docs/cli.en.md) for protocol, limits, resume restrictions, and Node/Python/PowerShell integration examples. | Command | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `dsh-tui` / `dst` | Start the TUI; `dst` is a short alias for the same program | | `dsh-tui --resume [id]` · `dsh-tui update` · `dsh-tui doctor` | Resume a session · update the profile and align the launcher · pre-flight environment checks | | `dsh-tui safe` | Read-only diagnostics, plugin inventory and repair guidance; `safe --rescue` builds a clean rescue profile | | `dsh-tui version` · `dsh-tui help` | Launcher and profile versions and usage; both work even without a `dsh` install | Leading DSH options such as `--dump-config` and `--patch ` are forwarded unchanged; other arguments go to the app in `dsh --profile dsh-tui`. Use `dsh-tui -- --resume=sid-1 ./notes` to send `--resume=sid-1 ./notes` as literal prompt text, without selecting a session or workspace. When invoking DSH directly, use `dsh --profile dsh-tui -- -- --resume=sid-1 ./notes`: the first `--` belongs to DSH, the second to the app. Host options can precede a literal prompt: `dsh-tui --patch ./overlay.yml -- --resume=sid-1` applies the overlay and sends `--resume=sid-1` as prompt text without resuming that session. Safe mode: [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md). ### Importing conversations from other agents (`dsh-tui migrate`) Bring Claude Code, Codex, OMP, zcode, or Grok Build conversation histories into the DSH session store, then browse and resume them by their original working directory via `/resume`: ```sh dsh-tui migrate # list importable counts per agent (writes nothing) dsh-tui migrate claude-code # import every Claude Code conversation (likewise codex / omp / zcode / grok-build) dsh-tui migrate codex --dry-run # preview what would land, write nothing ``` - **Read-only source**: migration only reads the foreign agent's local store; artifacts are written through the official `JsonlSessionPersistence` backend, so imported sessions are first-class (openable, continuable). - **Idempotent**: one deterministic UUID per source conversation — re-importing skips what is already present instead of stacking duplicates. - **Structure preserved**: user/assistant messages, reasoning traces, tool calls with their results, and the source's context compactions (as native compaction checkpoints) are rebuilt turn by turn; harness-injected machine text opens no turn. An imported session can pick the work straight up. In-TUI browsing: the session screen (`/resume`) shows a tab per agent that has conversations; picking one imports just that conversation and opens it. In-TUI: `/migrate` (optionally `/migrate [--dry-run]`) runs the same import in a child process and reports through the notification flow. CLI alternative: `dsh-tui migrate ...` from any shell runs the same import. Full guide: [Session migration](docs/migrate.en.md). - More agents (pi, opencode, …) extend the adapter registry as adapters land; grok-build reads `GROK_HOME` when set. **VS Code**: use the integrated terminal or the `dsh-tui-vscode` extension. See [VS Code guide](docs/vscode.en.md). **Herdr**: run `dsh-tui` in a [Herdr](https://herdr.dev) pane; `idle` / `working` / `blocked` are reported through its local integration API. **Any terminal**: dsh-tui reports `idle` / `working` / `blocked` / `done` / `error` over the pty with [OSC 7501 (Program Status Protocol)](https://www.superlogical.com/rex/docs/build/program-status), so terminals and agentic inboxes that implement it can show what the session is doing; terminals that do not implement it ignore the sequence. Set `DSH_TUI_PROGRAM_STATUS=0` to turn it off. Bare `--resume` (`-c`, `--continue`) reopens the last session of the backend this launch selected. Startup recovery only ever targets that backend: a backend with no last session, or a derived target that belongs to a different backend than the one that actually booted (an unknown backend id falling back to DSH, `--backend` naming a backend that is not installed, a remembered kernel that is not the marker's source), refuses with a clear error and exit code 1 — never a silent cold start, never another backend's session, never a new session. An explicit `--resume ` passes that id to the selected backend as-is. The one exception is safe mode's "retry normal startup": it retries the kernel and session recorded in `last-run.json`, so a record whose backend is gone degrades to a warning plus a cold start — that retry is the last way back. ### Experimental: Claude backend dsh-TUI can also run its session on Claude: the same interface, driving the Claude Code CLI through the Claude Agent SDK. Your project's `CLAUDE.md`, settings, hooks, MCP servers and plugins load as the CLI loads them. ```sh # once, in the dsh-tui profile directory (the SDK is an optional dependency) cd ~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui && pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.287 dsh-tui --backend claude # or pick Claude in /kernel; that choice is remembered ``` The easiest install: open the kernel picker (the launchpad "Kernel" entry or `/kernel`) and press Enter on the dim Claude row — the wizard locates the profile directory and installs the pinned SDK for you; the command above is its manual equivalent. The confirmation shows the exact package and version. Closing the wizard, including clicking outside it on the launchpad, cancels a pending installation. - **Sign-in**: a `/channel` relay profile, your dsh-auth `anthropic` sign-in (`/login`), `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or cloud-provider variables, or an existing `claude login`, in that order. A `claude` on `PATH` is used when present, then one in the native install directory under your home (`~/.local/bin`, or `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin` on Windows); every candidate has to launch and report a version, and the SDK's bundled binary is used only when none does. - **Works**: streaming, tool cards, approvals and questions, `/model`, `/effort`, Claude's permission modes (`/permission`, `Shift+Tab`), `/compact`, `/context`, `/mcp`, `/resume`, `/fork`, double-`Esc` rewind, subagents, background jobs, images, `/btw`, and the USD cost Claude reports. - **Not available**: DSH-only commands such as `/tree`, `/preset`, `/provider`, `/workspace`, `/agentview` and `/bg`. One process runs one backend; `/kernel` switches by restarting into a new session. - **Startup**: the screen appears before the session opens, with only a light profile composed (this package plus the profile's third-party plugins); see [Claude backend](docs/claude-backend.en.md#known-limitations). The DSH kernel starts from the same entry and loads DSH in the same process behind its first screen; `DSH_TUI_HOST_ENTRY=0` restores the old launch path for every kernel. Details and known limitations: [Claude backend](docs/claude-backend.en.md). ### Experimental: native Codex backend Run your own Codex through `codex app-server`, sharing its configuration, login, instructions, skills, hooks, MCP and native threads: ```sh npm install -g @openai/codex@0.160.1 dsh-tui --backend codex dsh-tui --backend codex --resume ``` Protocol baseline **0.160.1**, minimum **0.144.0**; other versions may show drift. `CODEX_EXECUTABLE` selects a binary; `/kernel` remembers the backend. `codex resume ` can open the same thread after the other writer exits. This is not `migrate codex`, which imports history into DSH. With native credentials, a writer conflict for an idle thread retained by the official background server triggers a reconnection to that server. Managed subscription credentials and `/channel` connections use private app-server processes. Streaming/tool cards, approvals, questions, steer/queue/interrupt, model and effort controls, Plan, `/review`, `/diff`, `/usage`, `/init`, skills and MCP share the existing UI. Async questions open the questionnaire while Codex continues working; answers steer the turn (or queue if unavailable), and dismissing the question leaves work running. **Shift+Tab only toggles Plan**, keeping its underlying permission preset; Full Access requires an explicit choice. Existing Codex settings are respected, not overwritten with defaults. `/login` offers ChatGPT OAuth, a device code or an API key (the last writes to Codex’s own credential store). Relay `/channel` connections take precedence; managed subscription tokens are only injected on first-party routes. dsh-TUI does not write `~/.codex/config.toml` or log out your native Codex account. A provider `env_key` from your own config (e.g. `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`) that the shell did not export is injected from the DSH credential store when the ref is stored there — the active store first, then the default `~/.dsh` one — so keep the key in the store, no per-shell export needed. When nothing can supply it, the session still starts and the reason is reported once as a start notice: Codex itself rejects every turn of that provider. For Claude and Codex, `/channel` tokens (`CHANNEL_*` refs) belong to the active `DSH_HOME` only. Disconnecting a channel cannot revive a token from the default home; reconnect it in the active home if needed. Provider `env_key` credentials retain the fallback described above. TPS includes hidden reasoning time and excludes tool execution time. Live text estimates are corrected when Codex reports output token usage. Decode spans of 500ms or less are excluded from TPS samples; token and cost totals still include all reported usage. Native browsing/archive, fork/conversation rewind (the first message requires Codex app-server 0.160.1+), paged history, images, subagents, polled background terminals, goals and `/btw`/`/recap` use the existing surfaces. `/logout` removes only the matching dsh-auth credential; already-loaded managed tokens require a normal restart, not native logout. The real 0.160.1 app-server passed nine credential-free offline checks and eight daemon-resume checks, with no model turn or charge; real subscription login, credentialed model calls and real-TTY interaction were not run. Only Codex identification/title changes automatically, not palette or companion. Using ChatGPT subscription tokens in third-party clients is subject to OpenAI’s terms. # 会话状态看板 · Session Status Board **DSH 会话状态分类看板插件 — 一屏看清每个会话到底卡在哪一步。** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-status-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-status-board) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-plugin-status-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-status-board) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.6-3178c6.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-%E2%89%A520-339933.svg)](https://nodejs.org/) [![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Plugin-247bbf.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [简体中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)
--- ## 这是什么 `dsh-plugin-status-board` 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Web UI 插件。它把 Harness 里散落在侧栏的会话，按**当前真实状态**重新归入三块可折叠看板： | 看板 | 判定规则 | 它回答的问题 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **待我决策** | 会话正在等你回话：工具用 `ask_user_question` 停在那里等你回答（含计划审阅），或 Lead 会话里有「已就绪且待认领」的团队任务 | 「我现在必须处理什么？」 | | **正在执行** | 会话的 Agent 正在干活，且不需要用户介入 | 「后台在跑什么？」 | | **近期记录** | 其余会话中，在时间窗口内有活动的 | 「最近动过什么？」 | 判定顺序是**排他的**：一个会话只会出现在一块看板里。这也正是它相对原生侧栏列表的价值——原生列表按工作区/时间排列，看不出「谁在等我」；看板按**行动优先级**排列。 > **演示占位** > 截图/GIF 待补充：`docs/demo/demo-light.png`（浅色主题）、`docs/demo/demo-dark.png`（深色主题）、`docs/demo/demo-collapse.gif`（折叠交互）。 > 三块看板在宽屏下为多列网格，窄屏（≤720px）自动堆叠为单列。 --- ## 功能 - **三块响应式折叠看板**：`待我决策` / `正在执行` / `近期记录`；默认只折叠「近期记录」，让前两块——真正需要你注意的——始终展开。 - **状态优先级正确**：等待用户决策的会话即使 Agent 仍在执行，也归入「待我决策」，不会被「正在执行」淹没。 - **实时跟随**：直接订阅 Harness 已有的会话列表快照，不轮询、不重复扫描会话日志。 - **折叠状态记忆**：三块看板的展开/收起状态按用户偏好持久化（`localStorage`）。 - **中英双语**：界面文案与插件管理页标题/描述均随 Harness 语言设置切换。 - **主题自适应**：配色全部取自 Harness 主题令牌，浅色/深色主题自动跟随。 - **键盘与读屏可用**：每块看板的标题是真实 `

`，内部是展开/收起按钮（WAI-ARIA accordion 模式），带 `aria-expanded` 与始终可解析的 `aria-controls`；标签同时播报看板名、动作与数量。面板标题用 `aria-labelledby` 关联，DOM id 由 `useId` 生成，多开面板不冲突。 - **空状态与截断提示**：空看板、被数量上限截断的「近期记录」都有明确说明，不静默丢弃数据。 --- ## 一键安装 ### 方式一：Plugin Manager（推荐） 1. 打开 DSH Web UI → **Settings → Plugins**。 2. 选择 **Install bundle**，填入本包的**绝对路径**（本地目录安装）或包名（已发布到 npm 时）。 3. 安装完成后刷新页面，侧栏导航区（「自动化任务」下方）会出现**会话状态看板**一行，后面跟着三个计数（待决策 · 执行中 · 近期）。点击该行即在侧栏右侧弹出看板；按 `Esc`、点面板外或点面板右上角 × 均可收起。 ### 方式二：命令行（从 npm 安装，推荐脚本化场景） 包已发布到 npm，无需克隆或构建，`lib/` 产物随包分发： ```bash npm install -g dsh-plugin-status-board # 或 npm i dsh-plugin-status-board dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-status-board ``` ### 方式三：从本地目录安装 ```bash # 目录中必须已有 lib/ 产物（npm 安装的副本已自带） dsh plugin --profile add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-status-board ``` ### 方式四：从源码构建（Git 安装必须先构建） `lib/` 是构建产物，不进入版本库。从 Git 克隆后请先构建，再安装： ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccclucky/dsh-plugin-status-board.git cd dsh-plugin-status-board pnpm install pnpm build # 产出 lib/index.js（Host）与 lib/client.js（Client） pnpm test # 运行全部单元测试 # 构建完成后再交给 CLI 安装 dsh plugin --profile add . ``` 构建产物结构： ``` lib/ ├── index.js # Host 半部（ESM，Cordis Loader 加载） ├── client.js # Client 半部（__ModuleLoader__ 信封） └── types/**/*.d.ts # 类型声明 ``` --- ## 配置项 配置写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件行里，也可在 **Settings → Plugins → 本插件** 页面修改（由 `Config` schema 生成表单，带范围校验）。 ```yaml - insert: - id: status-board name: 'dsh-plugin-status-board' config: recentWindowHours: 24 maxRecent: 20 defaultCollapsed: recent showEmptyBuckets: true ``` | 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 取值范围 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `recentWindowHours` | number | `24` | 1 – 720 | 「近期记录」看板的时间窗口（小时）。超出窗口的会话不进入该看板。 | | `maxRecent` | number | `20` | 1 – 200 | 「近期记录」看板最多显示的行数；超出部分在看板底部提示「另有 N 个较早会话未显示」。 | | `defaultCollapsed` | string | `recent` | `decision` / `executing` / `recent` / `none` / `all` | 初次加载时哪块看板处于折叠状态。用户一旦手动折叠过，以用户选择为准。 | | `showEmptyBuckets` | boolean | `true` | `true` / `false` | 空看板是否仍渲染标题栏。设为 `false` 时，没有会话的看板整体隐藏。 | > 越界值会被**钳制**到合法范围，类型错误会**回退**到默认值，而不是让插件加载失败——手工编辑的配置写错一个数字，不应让整个面板白屏。 --- ## 工作原理 ``` ┌─────────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Host 半部 (Node) │ │ Client 半部 (Browser) │ │ │ │ │ │ Config schema 校验/钳制 │───────▶│ GET /status-board/config │ │ │ JSON │ ↓ 失败则用文档默认值 │ │ 只读配置路由 │ │ 会话列表快照 ──┐ │ └─────────────────────────────┘ │ (Harness 已发布) │ │ ▼ │ │ 分类 / 排序 / 截断 │ │ ▼ │ │ sidebar.panellist → 导航行 │ │ shell.overlay → 浮层看板 │ └──────────────────────────────┘ ``` 三个设计取舍： 1. **看板由 Client 半部计算**。Harness 已经把会话列表推送到浏览器，插件订阅即可；把分类放到 Client 侧可以做到零延迟、零额外请求，也让 Host 半部保持极薄。 2. **Host 半部只发布配置**。唯一的跨进程需求是「操作者在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里配了什么」，所以只有一条只读、不缓存的 JSON 路由。 3. **会话快照的形状只在一个文件里出现**。`src/client/session-source.ts` 是唯一适配运行时快照的地方；Harness 升级改字段时，只需改这一个文件，分类器、视图和全部测试都不受影响。 --- ## 开发 ```bash pnpm install pnpm typecheck # tsc --noEmit，strict + exactOptionalPropertyTypes pnpm test # vitest，182 个用例 pnpm build # 清理 → 声明文件 → 两半部打包 → Client 信封包装 → 产物自检 pnpm verify # 只跑构建产物自检（需先 build） pnpm test:watch # 监听模式 ``` ### 项目结构 ``` dsh-plugin-status-board/ ├── src/ │ ├── index.ts # Host 半部：Config schema + 只读配置路由 │ ├── shared/ # 两半部共用的纯逻辑（无 Harness 依赖） │ │ ├── board.ts # 分类 / 排序 / 时间窗口 / 截断 / 折叠状态 │ │ ├── config.ts # 配置默认值与边界钳制 │ │ ├── i18n.ts # 双语字典、插值、相对时间 │ │ ├── route.ts # 跨进程常量（路由路径、marker） │ │ └── types.ts # 共享类型契约 │ └── client/ │ ├── index.tsx # 插槽注册（导航行 + 浮层 + 字典） │ ├── overlay.tsx # 导航行入口 + 浮层容器（含点击拦截、定位、收起） │ ├── Panel.tsx # 三看板视图 │ ├── store.ts # 外部 store（useSyncExternalStore） │ ├── session-source.ts # 运行时快照 → 分类输入的唯一适配点 │ └── styles.ts # 主题令牌驱动的样式 ├── locale/{zh,en}.json # 界面文案 + 插件管理页元数据 ├── tests/ # 182 个单元测试 ├── scripts/ # 清理与 Client 信封包装 ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle 补丁（含默认配置） └── tsdown.config.ts # 两半部独立构建 ``` ### 测试覆盖 | 测试文件 | 覆盖内容 | | :--- | :--- | | `board.test.ts` | 分类优先级、排序稳定性、时间窗口、截断计数、折叠状态 | | `config.test.ts` | 默认值、上下界钳制、非法类型回退 | | `i18n.test.ts` | 中英键对齐、必需键校验、单遍占位符插值、相对时间 | | `session-source.test.ts` | 运行时快照适配、子会话/空白会话过滤、决策投影读取、异常行容错 | | `store.test.ts` | 订阅通知、变更检测、折叠持久化、配置晚到不覆盖用户选择、卸载语义 | | `panel.test.tsx` | 服务端渲染：三看板、折叠、aria 关系可解析、加载/空/错误态、主题令牌 | | `overlay.test.tsx` | 浮层开关、Esc/外部点击收起、焦点进入面板、控制器通知语义 | | `nav-entry.test.tsx` | 导航行拦截点击（不触发跳转）、计数描述、卸载后还原框架行为 | | `host.test.ts` | 配置路由 GET/HEAD/405、Allow 头、effect 清理、webServer 延迟挂载 | | `manifest.test.ts` | 清单/补丁/locale/图标/MIT/LICENSE 一致性 | | `artifacts.test.ts` | 构建产物：Host 真实导出、Client 信封、React 外置、字典内联、样式未被改写 | --- ## 常见问题 **面板里看不到我的会话？** 看板只列出**顶层**会话：子 Agent 派生的会话（`origin: 'subagent'` 或带父会话 id 的行）已体现在父会话上；从未交换过消息的空白会话也没有状态可报，且其默认标题就是工作区名，容易读成幽灵行。这样列出的才是「你真正在对话的会话」。 **为什么某会话在「待我决策」里但它其实还在跑？** 这是刻意设计。「Agent 仍在跑」和「它在等你拍板才能继续」可以同时成立，后者更重要——它才是阻塞点。判定只读取运行时的 `userQuestions.active` 投影（`ask_user_question` 工具正等待人工回答，含计划审阅）。 团队任务的 `pending` 状态**不参与判定**：实测持久化日志里一条明确记录只有 `id/revision/subject/status`，没有 `ready` 字段，而工单结束后其任务行会永远停留在 `pending`。早先版本按它判定，结果把六天前就完成的会话钉在了「待我决策」上。 **点击会话行会怎样？** 通过 Harness 的 `uiWorkspace.openSession` 跳到该会话。若当前配置未提供该服务，行会渲染成静态文本而不是可点按钮——界面不会给出点不动的假按钮。 **折叠状态存在哪里？** 浏览器 `localStorage`，键名 `dsh-plugin-status-board.collapse.v1`。清除该项即恢复配置里的默认折叠方式。隐私模式下写入失败会自动降级为仅本次页面有效。 **卸载插件后残留什么？** 不残留。样式是面板组件内的 `

# job-workbench × DeepSeek Harness（DSH） 把求职工作台接进 DSH 宿主：**MCP 工具面**（17 个工具，两段式写入；岗位正文走 `read_job_text`——DSH 不桥接只读资源；筛选校准走 `score_calibration`）+ **9 个 `jwb-*` 技能** + 可选 **`jobws` agent preset**。本目录同时是 npm 包 **`dsh-job-workbench`** 的源码 （`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）——**装包即接线，不需要手改任何 profile 文件**（与第一阶段「把 insert 块抄进 profile」的本质区别）。 三条 insert 一张表（细节与理由见 `cordis.patch.yml` 头注）： | 行 id | 干什么 | 依赖 | |---|---|---| | `mcp-jobws` | MCP 工具面（stdio → `jobws-mcp`） | 平台预构建 `jobws-mcp.exe`（P2-2 产出）；开发态可用覆盖层指到本机 venv | | `preset-jobws` | 可选 agent preset（求职语境 + 工具集基线） | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` | | `skill-filesystem-jobws` | 独立技能 provider，只挂**本包** `skills/` 镜像 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` | **数据根刻意不写进配置**（数据根 spec 决策 1）：`jobws-mcp` 自己读工作台的持久化选择与 B3 默认； `config.env.JOBWS_DATA_DIR` 只作应急覆盖——写死它会制造第二个事实源。 ## 一、用户态（推荐）：一键安装 ```powershell # 默认装到 desktop profile、装最新版： $script = (irm 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenxiang6663635/job-workbench/main/integrations/dsh/scripts/install.ps1').TrimStart([char]0xFEFF) & ([scriptblock]::Create($script)) # 指定版本 / profile / 只看计划（-DryRun）： & ([scriptblock]::Create($script)) -Version 26.11.0 -Profile web -DryRun # 本地保存后运行（等价）： powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop ``` 脚本做五件事（全部幂等，可反复跑；先 `-DryRun` 只打印计划）： 1. **工作区放行**：给 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 写 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` （pnpm 11 对发布不足 24h 的版本执行隔离——首发当日安装会被拦；放行本包与平台子包， 免「重跑一次才成功」）。 2. **装包**：`dsh plugin --profile

add dsh-job-workbench[@版本]`——CLI 会自动写 **两处**：profile 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`；重启 DSH 后装载。 3. **校验**：确认 `dsh.profile.bundles` 真的包含本包。 4. **迁移**：幂等移除第一阶段手抄进 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `mcp-jobws` / `preset-jobws` 挂载行——否则与 bundle **双挂载**（同 `serverName` 注册两次）。 删除前先写 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-<时间戳>` 备份；没有旧行时不动任何东西。 5. **初始化工作区**（2026-10-19 补）：跑一次随包 `jobws-mcp.exe --init`，把包内 `template/workspace` 铺成 `/personal` 空骨架（14 个文件、6 个模块； 已存在则不改动）。**没有它，MCP server 会直接退出、17 个工具一个都不注册**—— 详见 §五「首次使用必须有工作区」。 不想跑脚本时，等价的是一条命令 + 两处手工检查： ```powershell # 发布后： dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-job-workbench # 开发期 / 离线 / 尚未发布时（link 直挂本仓库）： dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add link:<仓库路径>\integrations\dsh # 1) 首发 24h 内被 pnpm 拦：把 dsh-job-workbench 与 dsh-job-workbench-win32-x64 加进 # profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml → minimumReleaseAgeExclude，或等 24h 后重试； # 2) 第一阶段手工接线迁移：先备份、删掉 profile cordis.patch.yml 里手抄的 # mcp-jobws / preset-jobws insert 条目，再装本包。 ``` 装完在会话里应能看到 `mcp__jobws__*` 工具；技能清单里出现 9 个 `jwb-*`（来源为本包）。 脚本本体同时随包装（`scripts/install.ps1`，装完后在 profile 的 `node_modules\dsh-job-workbench\scripts\` 里也有一份），另支持 `-SkipInstall` （只做放行与迁移清理、不装包）。 ## 二、开发态：link 直挂 + 本机 venv ```powershell # 1) 生成随包技能镜像（唯一真源 = 仓库 skills/；防漂移由 four-ends 检查兜底） python tools\jobws.py skills install --target dsh # 或一条龙（含校验；-Pack 预演 npm pack 的内容清单）： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_dsh_bundle.ps1 -Pack # 2) 构建随包运行时（PyInstaller exe → platform/win32-x64/bin/；bin/ 不入库） powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_mcp_exe.ps1 # 冒烟：python scripts\smoke_mcp_exe.py # 3) 装包（link 形态；改完源码重启 DSH 即生效） dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add link:<仓库路径>\integrations\dsh # 4) 只有「不想构建 exe」时，才用覆盖层把命令指到本机 venv（一次性叠加，不改任何 profile） dsh headless --patch <本目录>\cordis.patch.yml --patch <本目录>\dev-python-overlay.yml "你好" ``` `cordis.patch.yml` 里的路径全部用 `!!js` + `baseUrl` 现算（官方 agent-preset 同款： `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-job-workbench/package.json')` 从 **profile 目录**解析本包， 因此 `package.json` 必须保留 `"exports": { "./package.json": ... }`）——**link 直挂与 npm 安装 两种形态成立，零绝对路径**；注意基点：只有「装过包（link 或正式包）」的 profile 里本包才可解析， **只 `--patch` 叠加而不装包**时技能行会报 `Cannot find module 'dsh-job-workbench/package.json'` （预期行为——先装包，或忽略该行只用 MCP 部分）。 ## 三、升级 / 卸载 / 回滚 ```powershell # 升级（发布后）：装新版本号即可（或重跑 install.ps1 -Version <新版本>）； # link 形态改回 git 旧提交即回滚 dsh plugin --profile

add dsh-job-workbench@<新版本> # 卸载：CLI 会把 dependencies 与 dsh.profile.bundles 两处一并清理（2026-10-07 实测） dsh plugin --profile

remove dsh-job-workbench ``` - **数据零影响**：本包只加「读取与调用入口」，不迁移、不写工作区；卸载不动数据。 - 回滚演练（首次接线前）：`Get-FileHash \package.json, \cordis.patch.yml` 留基线；改后核对哈希只在预期文件上变化。 ## 四、验收清单（每个接触 DSH 的改动跑一遍） 1. **合成**：`dsh --profile

--patch <本目录>\cordis.patch.yml --dump-config` → 三条 `jobws` 行（`mcp-jobws` / `preset-jobws` / `skill-filesystem-jobws`）都在；无 `entry ... not found` 警告。（`--dump-config` 只做合成、**不求值** `!!js`。） 2. English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) ![Dashboard](docs/screenshots/01-dashboard.png) ## Why job-workbench Job hunting means sensitive personal data (resumes, phone numbers, employer history) — and AI outputs that can quietly fabricate facts. This project is built around three answers: - **Local-first privacy.** Everything lives on your disk as plain text — git-diffable, Excel-friendly, no telemetry, and **no cloud server** (the desktop app starts a local backend that listens on 127.0.0.1 only). Real personal data stays in `personal/`, which is fully git-ignored: a fresh clone gives you an empty workspace, and you can fork this repo without leaking a thing. - **Auditable AI, not black-box automation.** Your own AI CLI (BYOK models) does the semantic judgment — reading the JD, scoring fit. Python scripts do everything deterministic: eligibility gates, score validation, PDF generation, tracker I/O — and every automated verdict (application health, CSV import diffs, failure clustering) comes with explicit, human-checkable **reasons**, never a bare score. - **Anti-fabrication safeguards.** Resume import is *extraction, not generation*: every persisted value must trace back to source text, and unextracted fields are flagged. AI rewrite suggestions must pass five local anti-fabrication checks before they can be accepted. - **One engine, any field.** The scoring rules are field-agnostic — the domain knowledge lives in **data-only profiles** (two ship in the box: HVAC & cooling, software backend), so any specialty works by authoring one per [`docs/domain-contract.md`](docs/domain-contract.md). ## What it solves The real difficulty of job hunting is not "not knowing what to do" — it is **scattered information that blocks decisions**: - Is this company worth applying to? What did I conclude about a similar one last week? - Which resume version did I send them three months ago, and what did the JD ask for? - How many applications are in flight, and which deadline is tomorrow? - The email said "finish the assessment before the 25th" — will that deadline quietly slip? The workbench turns all of that into queryable, traceable files. ## Core design - **AI judges, scripts verify.** Scores come from your AI CLI reading the JD against your profile; Python only validates totals, applies thresholds, generates PDFs, reads/writes the tracker — and makes explainable deterministic calls (application health in four states, CSV import diffs, failure clustering — all with reasons). Changing scoring rules means editing Markdown profiles, not code. - **Four-layer one-way dependency**: skills (domain knowledge) → scripts (IO & validation) → data (Markdown + CSV) → git (versions). The `tools/` tree is a layered package — one CLI entry point (`jobws`) plus domain modules and gate scripts; module dependencies stay acyclic (domain code never imports the web/protocol layer), so each module stays independently testable. - **Three-layer separation**: tooling (`tools/` + `skills/`, domain-agnostic) · domain profiles (`template/profiles/`, pluggable) · user workspace (`personal/`, your real data). A three-tier lexicon judges skills by *"can you survive follow-up questions"*, not *"have you heard of it"* — see [`template/AGENTS.example.en-US.md`](template/AGENTS.example.en-US.md). ## Features at a glance - **Four AI-assisted workflows**: `jwb-jd` (JD parsing & scoring), `jwb-apply` (application package), `jwb-track` (tracker & funnel), `jwb-resume` (PDF rebuild & validation) — driven by the in-repo `jobws` CLI; full command reference in the [usage guide](docs/usage-guide.md) - **Web UI** (`web/`): eight pages sharing the very same data files — dashboard, tracker, job pool, resume workshop (one-click import that *extracts rather than generates* + guarded AI rewrite + Word export), prepare (talks & your question bank), progress (interviews, emails, contacts), library (notes & material), settings; see [`web/README.md`](web/README.md) - **Post-application loop**: interview records (one-click `.ics` export), recruiter contact follow-ups, offer comparison (**side-by-side facts, never a recommendation**), resume version lineage, stage-conversion retros, failure clustering, application health in four states — each with concrete reasons instead of a black-box score - **Read-only email fetch (optional)**: with your own IMAP authorization code, pull recent recruiting emails and turn them into per-record status suggestions; read-only, connected only when you click, credentials kept local, dry-run until you confirm — details in the [usage guide](docs/usage-guide.md) - **Email ledger & honest deep links** (`mails.csv` + `jobws track mail`): interview invites, test notices and rejections become first-class records that link back to an application — pulled emails carry their Message-ID and can be filed with one click. "Open original" is graded honestly: your own pasted link wins; Gmail gets a real `rfc822msgid` search deep link; other providers (Outlook / QQ / 163 / …) get a "copy the subject and search" fallback instead of a fake link. **Emails never change stages by themselves** — you always confirm. - **Resume layouts & accent colors**: three built-in layouts (Classic / Compact / Accent) share a single placeholder skeleton, all single-column and ATS-checked; four accent colors combine freely with any layout, and the generated PDF matches the preview. Drop your own compliant HTML into the templates directory and it appears in the picker. - **Interface typography**: a continuous size slider (80%–150%, 5% steps — root-font scaling, decoupled from desktop zoom and available in a plain browser); **12 UI typefaces** (Inter by default, plus Geist, IBM Plex Sans, Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Figtree, Outfit, Public Sans, Source Sans 3, Work Sans, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, and system/serif) and an independent **6-family monospace slot** (Maple Mono by default; JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Geist Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Source Code Pro) plus a dedicated **numerals slot** (Geist Mono by default, or JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono / follow the UI typeface) — all bundled locally under OFL-1.1, Latin subsets only (CJK falls back to the system stack). - **Scoring framework**: an eligibility gate first (degree → major → cohort → language → city; unfilled profile facts yield "awaiting profile facts" instead of a fail — fill them and re-run; city *preferences* only deduct from growth, hard infeasibility still vetoes), then four weighted dimensions → five-tier verdict; the full standard lives in [`skills/jwb-recruit-coach/SKILL.md`](skills/jwb-recruit-coach/SKILL.md) - **Domain profiles are data, not code**: two ship in the box (HVAC & cooling — 6 directions; software backend — the minimal reference example). If you do not have one yet, the Settings page offers [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/ref/ref_f34ad879f774bce8bc82) as a preset optional provider. Full disclosure: this is a **referral link** — signing up through it earns the project author a commission; your pricing and benefits are unaffected, and clicking it only opens a web page (nothing is sent from the app by clicking). ## Privacy This repository contains **no real personal data**. `personal/` is a workspace you fill with your own data (name, photo, contacts, applications, fact cards); it is entirely excluded from version control — after cloning, it is empty; generate your own with the init command above. In short: **fork it publicly with confidence, but never paste `personal/` content into issues, PRs or discussions.** ## Repository layout | Path | Purpose | |---|---| | `template/` | Generic skeleton: profile templates, empty workspace, domain plugins | | `skills/` | Nine skills — five job-hunting workflows (JD / apply / track / resume / coach), one setup/extension skill (domain profiles), and three maintainer-facing skills (CLI contract / API review / MCP) — single source across AI runtimes | | `tools/` | Python domain layer — one CLI entry point plus domain modules and gate scripts | | `web/` | Web UI: FastAPI backend + React frontend (eight pages), same data files as the CLI | | `site/` | Project site (documentation site): assembler, config, page content and build | | `tests/` | pytest suite — privacy guards, anti-fabrication checks, tracker semantics; the CI gate | | `personal/` | Your real workspace (**fully git-ignored; the repo ships zero real data**) | | `docs/` | Usage guide, doc index, design documents (`docs/specs/`) | | `.github/` | CI workflow, issue / PR templates, code of conduct, Copilot instructions | | `.codebuddy-plugin/` | CodeBuddy plugin manifest — delivers the same `skills/` plus the commands and subagents; no second copy | | `integrations/dsh/` | **DeepSeek Harness surface** — npm package `dsh-job-workbench`: the MCP hookup, the nine skills and an optional preset, installed with one command; that folder's README is the source of truth for install / upgrade / rollback | | `docs/four-ends.md` | **Four-entry capability matrix** (CLI / AI host / editor plugin / desktop UI), generated from `tools/four_ends_matrix.json` and checked by `jobws lint four-ends`. See `docs/mcp-integration.md` to plug the workbench into an AI host — the config key differs per host | ## Download > **Note**: the interface is **bilingual** — every page ships in 简体中文 and English, with a `中文 / English` switch in the header (first run follows your system language, and the choice is remembered). The code, this README and the [usage guide](docs/usage-guide.md) are in English — with one deliberate exception: **code comments are Chinese by convention** (see [contributing.en-US.md](docs/contributing.en-US.md) §Copy & i18n). What stays Chinese **by design**: the values stored in your CSV / Markdown files (stage names, column headers) — they are the shared data contract with the CLI and with your own history, so translating them would desync the UI from your data — plus the CLI's built-in help. The screenshots above show the English UI; the same pages in 简体中文 are in the [Chinese README](README.zh-CN.md). A packaged Windows desktop app (no Python/Node needed) is attached to the latest release — grab `job-workbench-setup-*.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/chenxiang6663635/job-workbench/releases/latest), install, launch, done. The installer is a wizard: pick the install folder and whether to install for all users or just you (when upgrading, keep the defaults). Data lives in `%APPDATA%\job-workbench\` and stays local — no project-run server, no telemetry. Networking happens only through the features you enable, plus one startup update check — details in the [data-flow matrix](docs/data-flow-matrix.md). Prefer source? Skip to [Quick start](#quick-start). **The installer is not code-signed yet.** On first run Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen) — that is expected for unsigned software: click **More info** → **Run anyway**. SmartScreen reputation builds per release, so the notice may reappear on later versions. Starting with v26.9.0, each release attaches `SHA256SUMS.txt` (hashes for the installer and `latest.yml`) — you can verify your download against it. Auto-update works normally despite the missing signature (integrity is checked against the hash in `latest.yml`). ## Docs - [Online docs site](https://chenxiang6663635.github.io/job-workbench/) — project intro, usage guide and downloads as a website (bilingual, searchable). The site is GitHub-hosted: if GitHub is unreachable from your network, the [Gitee mirror](https://gitee.com/Chenxiang663635/job-workbench) carries the repository — docs sources render as Markdown there, and its Issues are the mainland-reachable feedback channel - [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) — Now / Later plus a shipped-batch log; items link to a tracking issue when one exists - [Doc index](docs/README.en-US.md) — status of every document (current / deprecated) - [Usage guide](docs/usage-guide.md) — startup, the eight pages, AI workflows, CLI reference, FAQ - [Support & compatibility](docs/support-and-compatibility.md) — when this counts as a stable release, what is supported, and why upgrades never require converting your data - [Design documents](docs/specs/) — architecture, Web contract, productization, open-source release - [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) - [Glossary](docs/glossary.en-US.md) — the internal terms used across these docs and the changelog, defined once (terms stay Chinese; the English companion explains them) ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome — bug fixes, documentation, new domain profiles, privacy safeguards, tests and interoperability improvements are particularly useful. Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) first (the four-gate process for new features, branching strategy, release flow) and the [code of conduct](.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). **Found a security problem? Use the private channel described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — please do not open a public issue.** **All changes go through a PR with green CI** (pytest + frontend lint/build + PR-title check + UI smoke) — `main` has branch protection, so that includes documentation-only edits (see [contributing.en-US.md](docs/contributing.en-US.md) §Branching strategy). **Pace expectation**: a single-maintainer project — work arrives in bursts: some days land a focused batch of small PRs, other weeks land none (no development during interview/exam weeks — see [contributing.en-US.md](docs/contributing.en-US.md) §Sustainability). First response to issues targets 48 hours, with slips disclosed in a pinned issue (see [docs/maintenance.md](docs/maintenance.md)); a few day

# dsh-notify-me **离开 DSH 页面，也能及时知道何时需要回来。** 简体中文 | [English](README.en.md) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-notify-me?style=flat-square&label=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-me) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-notify-me?style=flat-square&label=downloads%2Fmonth&color=1F883D)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-me) [![npm total downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-notify-me?style=flat-square&label=total%20downloads&color=1F883D)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-me) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![DSH Web and Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Web%20%7C%20Desktop-blue?style=flat-square)](#安装) [![Package size](https://img.shields.io/npm/unpacked-size/dsh-notify-me?style=flat-square&label=package%20size)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-me) [![DSH Compatibility](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E5%B7%B2%E9%80%82%E9%85%8D%200.2.1--rc.2-6366f1.svg?style=flat-square)](#兼容性) [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)
[安装](#安装) · [效果预览](#效果预览) · [配置](#在-dsh-设置里改配置) · [兼容性](#兼容性) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) DSH Web / Desktop 的通知插件，让你敢不开完整访问，也不必一直守着页面。 - **需要你操作时**：审批、方案确认、提问，用通知、提示音和标题标记提醒。 - **后台回复完成时**：及时回来查看结果，点击通知可回到对应对话；提醒时机可选「仅后台 / 仅当前对话静默 / 总是提醒」。 - **人走开但窗口没走**：窗口留在最前台、人却离开座位，超过 3 分钟没有输入也算离开，该提醒的照常提醒；收到的那条通知不会在你回来之前自己消失。 - **离开电脑时**：可选转发到 Discord、Bark、Gotify、飞书群机器人、Server酱、WxPusher 或自己的 Webhook。 > 页面或桌面应用需保持运行，后台 / 最小化可以。系统通知需要通知权限。审批按钮靠 Service Worker 才能进通知：Web 端（`http://127.0.0.1` 或 `https`）有，桌面端 `dsh-app://` 页面注册不了，通知上没有按钮，点通知回到对话里裁决。 > 🔎 想找这个插件？可以搜：`dsh-notify-me`、**消息提醒**、**可操作提醒**、**桌面通知**、**需要你操作**、**回复完成提醒**、**后台完成提醒**、**外部通知**、**安卓推送**、**Discord / Bark / Gotify / 飞书 / Server酱 / WxPusher 推送**（npm 关键词已含以上中英文词）。 ## 效果预览 ![Windows 上经 Edge 显示的 DSH 普通通知，未包含审批按钮](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/main/docs/screenshots/notify-toast.png) *普通通知示例 · Windows / Edge · 不含审批按钮。* [查看原图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/main/docs/screenshots/notify-toast.png)
展开设置界面预览 ![通知提醒设置页：页眉、提醒方式、什么时候提醒、试一试与折叠的高级设置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/main/docs/screenshots/settings-zh.png) 只截插件自己的面板（真实组件，与宿主同款深色主题），不带 DSH 左侧导航栏；每行说明在鼠标停在标题文字上时才出现，所以这里只看到标题。
## 安装 ### DSH Web 已安装 DSH CLI 的用户，在终端执行： ```powershell # 安装并自动挂载进 web profile dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-me ``` 重启 `dsh web`，然后硬刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）。如果你使用其他 Web profile，请把命令中的 `web` 换成实际名称。 ### DSH Desktop 1. 在桌面应用打开 **插件 → 添加插件**。 2. 输入 npm 包名 `dsh-notify-me`，按应用提示完成安装，并确认插件已启用。 3. 完全退出并重新启动 DSH Desktop，使插件加载。 桌面端的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用管理；不要把上面的 Web 命令改成 `--profile desktop`，CLI 会拒绝此操作。安装到 Web profile 也不会自动安装到桌面端。 ## 首次验证 1. 在 DSH 页面上点击一次，按提示允许通知；若此前拒绝过，在浏览器站点设置中允许通知。操作系统也需要允许对应浏览器 / DSH Desktop 显示通知。 2. 打开 **设置 → 通知提醒**，确认出现该分区及底部插件版本号，保持「启用提醒」「提示音」开启。 3. 点击设置页的「测试『回复完成』」按钮：应出现一条测试通知，并按当前音效设置播放声音。这个本地测试不会转发到外部通知端点，也不受「窗口在前台时也提醒」开关限制。 Web 用户可再测审批按钮，通知上会带「同意 / 拒绝」。桌面端拿不到 Service Worker，这条测试只发一条普通通知；真实审批的提醒同理——只弹通知，点它回到对话里裁决。 **控制台验证（可选）** — 支持 DevTools 的环境也可执行： ```js window.__dshNotifyMe.test("done") // 「完成」示例 window.__dshNotifyMe.test("attention") // 「需要你」示例 window.__dshNotifyMe.test("approval") // 桥可用时带「同意 / 拒绝」按钮；否则只发普通通知（桌面端即如此） window.__dshNotifyMe.debug() // 桥接状态看 bridge 字段，active = 按钮可用 ``` 没有测试通知时，先检查：通知权限是否被拒绝（在页面上点一下 → 选「允许」；或地址栏锁 → 站点设置 → 通知 → 允许 → 刷新）、装完没重启 DSH、系统设置里浏览器通知被关。 ## 为什么需要它 - **不开完整访问（`workspace-write` + ask）**：保留事前审批，但错过请求会让 agent 等待。 - **开完整访问（full access）**：减少审批打断，同时放弃事前拦截能力。 dsh-notify-me 把「监督」和「守在屏幕前」解耦：只在真的出现决策点（审批 / 方案确认 / 提问）或回复跑完时，才用系统通知把你叫回来——**让你敢不开完整访问**，不必靠放弃拦截能力来换效率。它不降低 full access 本身的权限风险（它不是沙箱），只是减少 ask 模式下因错过审批而产生的等待。 ## 提醒时机 | 事件 | 默认行为 | | --- | --- | | 🔔 需要你操作 | 页面可见也提醒；当前对话只留标题标记 | | ✅ 回复完成 | 页面隐藏 / 后台时提醒（可选「仅当前对话静默」或「总是提醒」） | **需要你操作**包括审批请求、方案待确认（plan review）和提问（`ask_user_question`）。审批带「同意 / 拒绝」的按钮只在 Web 端有（需要 Service Worker）；桌面端注册不了，通知上没有按钮，点通知回到对话里裁决。 **回复完成**也覆盖后台会话；完成但还没看时，标题带 `✅ 回复完成 ·` 标记，打开对应会话即撤。标题标记不受提醒策略限制。 > **后台**子代理（subagent）子会话的等待与完成默认**不提醒**：DSH 把每个子代理子会话列成独立会话，但它们是所属主对话那一轮里的步骤，提醒只会是噪音。你当前打开的那个子代理会话不算在内，照常提醒。设置页「子代理会话不提醒」可关掉这个静音。 ## 在 DSH 设置里改配置 打开 **设置 → 通知提醒**。页面按「提醒方式 → 什么时候提醒 → 试一试」三段排开，不常改的收进底部「高级设置」，点一下展开。每行只写标题，具体说明在鼠标停在标题文字上时弹出的小方框里（只有标题本身触发布局，整行空白处不会弹；触屏或键盘操作时留一份隐藏文本给读屏）。带 ▸ 的行点一下展开子项。 ### 提醒方式 - **启用提醒** 总开关：关闭后不弹通知、不响提示音，也不改标签页标题； - **提示音 / 音量**：开关直接切；音量滑块收在该行里，点一下标题（▸ 变成 ▾）展开。具体播什么由「高级设置 → 音效来源」决定； - **审批通知上直接裁决**（默认开）：审批带「同意 / 拒绝」，点一下即完成裁决，不用切回页面。Web 走带按钮的系统通知；桌面端 `dsh-app://` 注册不了 Service Worker，通知上没有按钮，点通知回到对话里裁决。设置页「试一试」下面那行会如实说明当前环境能不能给按钮。 ### 什么时候提醒 - **窗口在前台时也提醒「需要你」**（默认开）：窗口在前台也提醒；关掉后只有窗口转到后台才提醒——切到别的应用、被别的窗口遮住、最小化都算后台。窗口一直留在前台但人离开座位（默认 3 分钟没有任何键鼠输入）同样算后台；`idleMinutes: 0` 退回只看窗口； - **当前对话不弹通知**（默认开）：等待就发生在你正看着的对话里时只留标签页标记，免得打断眼前的操作；人离开（窗口转到后台或闲置超时）后照常提醒，若你已处理掉就作废； - **「回复完成」什么时候提醒**（默认「仅后台」）：三选一。「仅后台」＝原来的规则，不在看页面才提醒；「仅当前对话静默」＝屏幕上那条静默，别的对话完成照常提醒，多开对话时有用；「总是提醒」＝从不静默。老配置里的「窗口在前台时也提醒『回复完成』」开关自动迁移到这一项； - **通知自动消失**（默认「离开时保留」）：三选一。「离开时保留」＝只有你在看页面时才几秒后关闭，人不在时收到的那条留在通知中心等你回来；「总是关闭」＝旧行为；「从不关闭」＝普通通知一直留着，等你点掉。带「同意 / 拒绝」的审批通知仍按 12 秒走，同样不会在人不在时被撤掉； - **子代理会话不提醒**（默认开）：跳过后台子代理（subagent）会话——它们是主对话那一轮的步骤，完成由主对话自己的提醒覆盖；你当前打开的那个子代理会话照常提醒； - **点击通知回到对应对话**（默认开）：点通知切到提醒所属的对话；浏览器里同时把窗口带到前台；桌面端交给宿主路由做原生激活（见[桌面端怎么抬窗的](#桌面端怎么抬窗的)），抬不起来时只切对话，原因记在 `debug().raiseLast` 里；多个标签页同时开着时只调起一个（优先当前可见的那个）；关掉后点通知不做任何事。 ### 试一试 三个按钮分别发一条「需要你」「回复完成」「审批按钮」测试提醒，用当前设置立即发，**不受**「什么时候提醒」里的开关限制；下方一行如实说明当前哪种渠道能给审批按钮。 设置页底部常显插件版本号（`dsh-notify-me v…`）——报障、核对是否装上新版本时直接照抄这一行。 ### 高级设置 默认收起，点一下展开。里面收着三块不常改的东西：音效来源、外部推送、运行环境与诊断——分别见下面三节。 ### 音效 「需要你」与「回复完成」可独立选择内置合成音、自定义音频或系统通知音。
自定义音频、试听与回落规则 - **音效来源**（「需要你」与「回复完成」各自独立选）：内置合成音（默认）/ 自定义音频文件 / 系统通知音。选「自定义音频文件」可在设置页挑一个本地音频（上限 1 MiB，存在浏览器本地，可试听与移除）；选「系统通知音」则完全不播插件音效，通知照发，声音交给操作系统（音色跟着系统通知设置走），此时「试听」会改发一条测试通知——该模式没有插件可播的音，你听到的就是它。任一来源缺文件、读不出来或存不下时自动回落到内置合成音，提醒不会因此变成哑的；
### 外部推送 默认关闭。支持 Discord Webhook / Bark / Gotify / 飞书群机器人 / Server酱（Turbo 与 Server酱³）/ WxPusher / 自定义 Webhook；提醒正文会发往你填写的地址，只使用可信端点。
目标地址、转发开关、发送测试与失败记录 - **外部通知**（默认关）：把提醒同时转发到你自己的推送端点，人不在电脑前也能收到——支持 **Discord Webhook** / **Bark** / **Gotify** / **飞书群机器人** / **Server酱** / **WxPusher** / **自定义 Webhook**，可加多个目标，每个目标可单独启用/停用（Discord 填 Webhook 地址；Bark 填 `https://api.day.app/<设备密钥>`；Gotify 填 `https://<服务器>/message?token=<应用令牌>`；飞书填群机器人 Webhook，可选填签名校验密钥；Server酱 填 `…/send/.send` 完整地址；WxPusher 填 appToken 与接收者 UID；自定义端点收一条 POST JSON：`{source, event, title, body, text, sessionId, time}`）；「转发「需要你」」「转发「回复完成」」各自独立开关；**发送测试通知**往所有目标发一条测试消息（不受这两类开关限制，也不会冒充真提醒）。转发跟本地提醒走同一套触发规则（「当前对话不弹通知」等开关同样管它）；提醒正文会原样发往你填的地址，**只填你自己信任的端点**； - **可靠投递**：明显是临时故障的失败（网络中断、5xx、429）按 2 秒 / 6 秒自动重试两次，其它错误立即停；重试仍失败会把这一条记进「失败记录」（最多 10 条，只留标题与正文摘要和主机名，不留完整端点），设置页能一眼看到并清空； - **每个目标的状态**：目标行右侧显示它最近一次投递的结果（上次成功 / 上次已送出但不可确认 / 上次失败 + 原因），并各自带一个启停开关——某个端点临时不可用就单独关掉它，不用关掉整类事件； - **签名**：自定义目标填了签名密钥时，请求带 `X-DSH-Notify-Signature`（对请求体做 HMAC-SHA256，`sha256=`）；飞书填了签名密钥时按官方算法在请求体里带 `timestamp` / `sign`； - **消息模板**（可选）：飞书 / Server酱 / WxPusher / 自定义目标可填模板，占位符 `{{title}}` `{{body}}` `{{event}}` `{{time}}` `{{session}}`，留空默认是「标题 + 换行 + 正文」； - **钉钉不在支持列表里**：钉钉群机器人接口不返回任何 CORS 头，且只接受 `application/json`——浏览器页面既读不到响应，也无法发出符合要求的请求（no-cors 下 Content-Type 会被限制成 safelisted 类型）。要用钉钉，请在自己能控制的机器上搭一个中转，再把「自定义 Webhook」指向它。
### 运行环境与诊断 在「高级设置」最后一块。默认自动识别当前是 Web 端还是桌面端（DSH Desktop，`dsh-app://`）；识别不准时可手动指定——桌面端点通知走宿主路由做原生抬窗（见[桌面端怎么抬窗的](#桌面端怎么抬窗的)）、通知上不带快捷裁决按钮；Web 端走 `window.focus()` 与 Service Worker 桥。手动覆盖与自动识别不一致时，设置页会明示检测结果。
通知语言、桌面端抬窗与恢复默认 - **通知语言**：跟随界面 / 简体中文 / English——决定通知文字与 `🔔 …` 标题标记使用的语言； - **桌面端怎么抬窗**：页面侧的 `window.focus()` 在 Electron 里抬不动原生窗口，1.14.0 起由页面 POST 到宿主路由 `/__dsh-notify-me/focus-window`、宿主跑一次 PowerShell 做原生激活——窗口最小化、被别的窗口盖住都实测能抬回来（详见下一节）； - **恢复默认设置**：把所有开关与音效设置还原成出厂值（不动外部推送目标和已选的自定义音频文件）。
> 左侧导航行的图标由 DSH 设置外壳统一渲染：外壳按分区 id 硬编码（只认 account / models / agent-presets / plugins / archived-sessions），其他分区一律给默认齿轮，`settings.section` 也没有图标字段。插件的做法是在设置面板渲染后替换那一行：按本地化标签文本找到自己的入口，把宿主的 ``）；如果 DSH 改了这套结构，补丁会静默失效、显示回默认齿轮，其他功能不受影响。 ## 开发自检 ```powershell node --check lib\client.js node --check lib\index.js node smoke\smoke-test.cjs # 离线状态机冒烟测试：三代宿主 + 主开关 + 中英语言用例 + 快捷裁决桥（Service Worker 半侧一并跑）+ 闲置判定与通知自收 node smoke\cordis-host-test.mjs # 真 cordis 端到端（找不到本机 DSH 时自动跳过） powershell -NoProfile -File lib\focus-window.ps1 -ProcessId 0 # 手动验证抬窗脚本，末行应是 FOCUSED=1 npm pack --dry-run # 预览发布包 ``` `cordis-host-test.mjs` 会从本机 DSH 安装借 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`（依次探测 npm 全局目录、`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules` 与 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` 平铺回退目录）；源码 checkout 里没有 profile 依赖时，用 `DSH_CORDIS_PATH=/vendor/cordis/lib/index.js` 指定即可。 ## 致谢与贡献须知 贡献者（按 handle 列出，链接指向他们参与的 PR / issue）： - [@AgMahone](https://github.com/AgMahone) — [#7](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/pull/7)：0.1.6+ / 0.2.0 宿主代际支持，以及通知双响、cordis 查找路径的报障与复测； - [@d0ublecl1ck](https://github.com/d0ublecl1ck) — [#8](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/pull/8)：子代理会话静音（`ignoreSubagent`）与配套测试、文档；1.4.0 里「只静音后台子代理、当前打开的照常提醒」的口径同样出自他在 #8 讨论里的建议，落地由维护者完成； - [@EliteOtaku](https://github.com/EliteOtaku) — [#9](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/issues/9)：桌面端抬窗链路（1.5.2）的逐层排查与真实壳三轮复测——确认点通知抬窗 + 切会话稳定生效，并定位出「无用户手势的脚本化注入被 Chromium 静默丢弃」这一复现差异，纠正了最初「沙箱拦死」的判断； - [@Wh1stle05](https://github.com/Wh1stle05) — [#10](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/pull/10)：「音效来源」功能（内置合成音 / 自定义音频文件 / 系统通知音，「需要你」与「回复完成」各自独立选），含设置页交互、回落链与测试、文档；「系统通知音」试听改发测试通知、假 React 按索引跨渲染保持 hook 状态这两处修正同样出自该 PR。 - [@yanzhaohui1999](https://github.com/yanzhaohui1999) — [#13](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/issues/13) / [#14](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/pull/14)：482 个会话下空闲页面烧 CPU 的性能报告（定位到 `currentSessionId()` 每行重扫全表，实测占 CPU 5.9%~6.5%）与修复（一次列表变化只推导一次「当前会话」），并带先红后绿的回归断言——4 行与 40 行的列表变化代价必须相等（上游报 7 vs 43，修后 5 vs 5）。 - [@RiZhiZhaoYi](https://github.com/RiZhiZhaoYi) — [#12](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/issues/12)：外部通知转发（Discord Webhook / Bark / Gotify / 自定义 Webhook）的功能建议与使用场景（1.7.0）。 - [@yuexian7](https://github.com/yuexian7) — [#17](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/issues/17)：安卓端收消息的诉求——Discord 在国内不便、Bark 没有安卓端，只能自己搭后台中转；1.13.0 的飞书 / Server酱 / WxPusher 三种目标、自动重试与失败记录都是据此做的。 - [@shrekcg](https://github.com/shrekcg) — [#16](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me/pull/16)：把「人在前台但离开了」并入离开判定（`idleMinutes`，默认 3 分钟）、「回复完成」按哪个对话完成决定是否提醒（`donePolicy` 三选一）、通知自动消失的三档策略（`autoDismiss`），并带上对应冒烟用例与旧配置迁移；1.12.0 落地时维护者补了闲置到期补发被压下的审批、删掉残留的页内审批卡片、补齐文档与版本。 - [@xinming-chenniang](https://github.com/xinming-chenniang) — [deepseek-harness discussions #10446](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/10446#discussioncomment-19143913)：五种 Win32 抬窗手法的实测对照（单独 `SetForegroundWindow` 被前台锁拒、合成 ALT 键后通过、最小化→恢复两种场景都有效），以及「宿主注册同源路由 + PowerShell 兜底链」这条绕法的可运行验证；1.14.0 的宿主路由与 `lib/focus-window.ps1` 的直接依据。 署名口径：本仓库收编外部 PR 时以维护者提交落地——不沿用原 commit、不挂 Co-authored-by，GitHub 的 contributors 图只显示维护者，贡献者以上面的致谢署名。 ## License MIT — 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-office

[![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@copylee/dsh-office)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@copylee/dsh-office)

让 DeepSeek Harness 直接在你电脑上打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 里改文档。AI 不改写文件，而是通过 Office 的自动化接口（COM）让应用自己执行修改，所以改动会实时出现在窗口里，你可以边看边一起编辑，格式不会因为换工具保存而走样。

仅支持 Windows，需要本机装有微软 Office 或 WPS Office。

![AI 在 Word 窗口里写一份通知：标题、导语、表格逐步出现](assets/demo-word.gif)

上图是一次真实操作的录屏（只录了 Word 窗口）：AI 按要求写出标题、导语和表格，随后检查排版并修正。下图是对话里的交付结果，以及设置页。

| 对话与交付的文件 | 设置页 |
|---|---|
| ![对话：AI 说明文档结构并交付 读书会通知.docx](assets/chat.png) | ![设置 → Office：应用状态、办公套件、行为开关](assets/settings.png) |

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 在打开的文档里改 | 文件正开着也能改（直接改文件的做法这时会因为文件被占用而失败）；文件已经打开就直接接着用，不会再开一份 |
| 实时可见，可以一起改 | 每一步修改即时出现在 Word / Excel / PowerPoint 窗口里。你可以同时在里面打字、调格式，AI 每次动手前读到的都是文档当下的样子 |
| 不需要窗口在前台 | 修改不靠鼠标键盘，Office 窗口被挡住或在后台也照常进行，你可以同时用电脑做别的事 |
| 静默模式 | 在设置里开启后，AI 在后台完成工作：不弹出 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的窗口，不显示迷你卡片，文字一次写入。Word 和 Excel 用一个单独的、不可见的实例（不碰你正开着的窗口），PowerPoint 以无窗口方式打开文稿；渲染检查照常进行。回合结束时，后台打开的文档自动保存并关闭，后台实例随之退出。你自己已经打开着的文档仍在原处修改，只是不滚动、不弹卡片。Excel 的纯数据处理此时允许 AI 借助 Python（在工作簿未打开时），图表与格式仍由 Excel 自己完成；Word 和 PowerPoint 始终由 Office 排版。确需操作窗口时，AI 可以用 `office_open {show: true}` 把文档调出来。后台文档打开期间你在资源管理器里双击同一个文件：Word 和 Excel 会提示文件正在使用（可以只读打开，不影响 AI 的工作）；PowerPoint 只有一个进程，文稿会直接显示出来，AI 继续写，回合结束时保存但不再替你关闭 |
| 跟随与静默 | 默认“跟随”：AI 改到哪里，窗口自动滚动到哪里（Word 滚到那一段，Excel 滚到那片单元格，PowerPoint 切到那一页），不动你的光标和选区。关闭即静默执行，不动你的视图 |
| 逐字写入 | 文字分小段写出，像打字一样出现，表格逐行填入，而不是整块贴上去。每段约多花 0.3 秒，可关闭 |
| 迷你卡片 | AI 每次动手修改文档时，屏幕右下角出现一张小卡片：正在改哪个文档、改到第几项，带“查看”“快速”两个开关（“快速”亮起时文字一次写入，熄灭时逐字写入），点一下立即生效（正在进行的这一批也跟着变）。点“查看”会把文档窗口带到前台并跟随修改位置，按钮变成“查看中”；你切到别的窗口后它自动熄灭，再点一次回来。可拖动，不抢焦点；AI 读取、检查、保存期间卡片也留着，这一轮回答结束时消失 |
| 原生公式 | AI 在文字里用 `$...$`（行内）和 `$$...$$`（单独一行）写 LaTeX，由 Word 自己的 LaTeX 解析器读成原生公式，所以常规 LaTeX 写法都能用（`\mathfrak`、`\bigoplus`、矩阵、分段函数等），不需要逐个符号适配；Word 不认识的写法退回插件自带的转换，仍失败的保留原文并在结果里提示。单独一行的公式末尾加 `\tag{1}` 即在右侧对齐编号。Word 的正文、表格单元格、题注、查找替换内容，以及 PowerPoint 的标题、正文、文本框里都可以写 |
| 引用与参考文献 | 正文里写 `\cite{1}`、`\cite{2,5}`、`\cite{3-6}`，变成上标 [1]、[2,5]、[3-6]；`insert_references` 生成参考文献列表。引用是 Word 的交叉引用域，按住 Ctrl 点击跳到对应文献 |
| 原生脚注 | Word / WPS 文字中插入、读取、编辑、删除真正的页底脚注，编号随增删自动重排，支持连续、每节或每页重编号。正文可内联写 `[fn:完整引注]` 或 `\footnote{完整引注}`；脚注支持加粗、局部斜体、字体字号和 `$...$` 原生公式，与 `\cite{}` 文末参考文献共存 |
| 样式与版式 | 直接修改样式本身（标题用什么字体字号、是否自动编号，正文的字体、行距、首行缩进），所有用到它的段落一起变；设置纸张和页边距、页码、页眉、目录（保存时自动刷新）、某段另起一页。这些都不需要再去点 Word 的对话框 |
| 填模板 | 报告模板常把正文放在大单元格里。这类表格会按段落展开给模型看，正文、公式、表格都写进单元格里面，而不是堆到文档末尾；新写的正文沿用旁边正文的字体、字号和行距 |
| 规范的图表题注 | 插入表格或图片时给出题注，插件按规范排：自动编号（“表 1”“图 1”，是 Word 题注域，增删后自动重排）、居中、表题在上、图题在下；图表前后留出段间距，图片居中 |
| 不被自带技能带偏 | DSH 桌面版自带的 Office 技能会让模型写脚本生成文件，这样你看不到过程，文件开着时还会写入失败。插件在模型第一次加载这些技能时把它引回来，确有需要（批量转换、应用打不开的文件）再次请求即放行 |
| 交付前整体视觉检查 | 保存时如果 AI 改完之后还没看过成品，保存结果会自动附上整份文档的总览图让它过一遍，有问题先修再保存。总览图把各页（或各张幻灯片）带页码拼在一张图里，一张最多 6 页，最多 18 页；模型也可以随时主动调出总览，再放大某一页细看 |
| 不拆词、不重复编号 | 插件写入的段落、表格、题注一律按整词换行（有些模板的样式带着“允许西文在单词中间换行”，会把 37000 拆成 37 和 000）；标题文字自带编号而样式又自动编号时，去掉自动的那个 |
| 提醒纯文本公式 | 正文里出现 d_k、10^18 这类没写成公式的下标和幂时，结果里会提醒模型改用公式 |
| 三线表与表格格式 | `insert_table` 的 `borders` 可选 `grid`（全框线）、`three-line`（论文三线表：上下粗线、表头下细线）、`none`；`format_table` 修改已有表格的框线、字号、行高、是否保持在同一页 |
| 图片尺寸 | `set_image` 调整已有图片的宽高（磅或 `"12cm"`）；插图所在段落不受固定行距裁切。插入的图（Word 与 PowerPoint，支持 PNG、JPG、SVG 矢量图）如果被缩到远小于绘制时的尺寸，结果里会告诉 AI 图中文字实际只有几磅，让它按版面重画 |
| 消除图表前的留白 | `fill_gaps`：图或表在上一页放不下而整块移到下一页时，上一页底部会空出一截；这条指令像排版软件那样把图表后面的正文段落提到图表前面，把空白填上（不会让正文越过标题） |
| 图表与正文连续写 | `insert_paragraphs` 的条目里可以直接放图片或表格，按顺序落在前后段落之间，不必再数段落号 |
| 成型版式的幻灯片 | PowerPoint 里 AI 不再自己摆文本框：先选一套主题（ink、paper、ocean、forest、graphite 五套浅色，night、chalk、plum 三套深色，可改单个颜色和字体），再用一条 `slide` 指令生成一整页——封面、目录、章节页、要点、卡片、数据、图表（柱状、条形、折线，由形状绘制）、表格、公式卡片、时间线、流程、对比、满版配图、引言、结束页。版面、配色、字号、页码、切换和入场动画由插件按主题排好；标题里的 `**词**` 以强调色加粗，`$...$` 是公式，卡片可带线性图标。要点页配图时按图的形状排版：宽图横跨整页、要点排在图下，其他图放在文字旁边；图表、示意图用“配图页”时整张完整显示。整份演示文稿通常一两次调用完成 |
| 更多版式与自由画布 | 定理 / 定义页（陈述卡片 + 证明思路）、图组页（2–6 张图带题注）、总结页（大号编号的要点）、对开页（半页满版图）、封面与结束页的满版样式；图表页新增由形状绘制的散点图（可带最小二乘拟合线、方程和 R²）、函数曲线图、饼图和圆环图；表格单元格里的公式是真正的公式。没有合适版式时用“画布”：AI 在 960×540 的画布上自己摆放文字、卡片、色块、箭头、图片、公式、数据、图表，颜色和字体仍跟随主题；摆好的页可以用 `reuse_slide` 复用 |
| 章节页样式、代码页与框图 | 章节页有四种样式（整页色底、左侧色块配编号、横向色带、淡色大编号），一份演示文稿统一用一种，未指定时随机取一种，不同文稿不再千篇一律。新增代码页（深色面板、行号、关键字和注释着色）。画布上的方框可以起名并用连接线相连（直线、折线、曲线，带箭头，自动找最近的边），用来画网络结构、流程管线这类框图。曲线图在线的末端直接标名称（相近的自动错开），可加参考线和标注 |
| 主题与背景 | 新增三套主题：sepia（旧纸张底、暗红配金、衬线标题，适合历史与人文）、crimson（暖白底、红配金，适合党政与纪念）、slate（冷灰底带细网格，适合工程技术）。背景不再只有纯色：旧纸张（颗粒与暗角）、渐变、网格、圆点，或把一张图片淡淡地铺在每一页后面 |
| 图片裁切 | 照片铺满版位时，竖长的图保留上部（人像的头部所在），可用 `focus` 指定保留哪一部分，图组里可用 `fit: "contain"` 完整显示；被裁掉较多的图会在结果里点名，提醒 AI 去看。图组页遇到竖图（人物肖像）排成一行竖格，最后一行不满时居中 |
| 幻灯片图示与表格 | PowerPoint 里可以直接生成原生 SmartArt（流程、循环、层次结构、组织结构图、棱锥、维恩图等 20 种常用版式，条目可带下级）、原生表格、常用形状和连线，正文可写多级要点 |
| 操作说明按需提供 | 每次请求只带一段简短说明；某个应用的全部操作清单在 AI 第一次打开或读取该应用的文档时随结果给出一次，之后可用 `office_help` 再取。用不到的应用不占上下文 |
| 表格跨页 | 表头行在下一页重复，单行不被拆到两页，表题不会单独留在页尾 |
| Excel 数据处理 | 长表格不必逐行读：`office_read` 对超过 60 行的表自动给出每一列的概况（数值、文本、日期、空白各多少，最小值、中位数、最大值，各取值及次数，以及值得注意的地方：多余空格、写成文本的数字和日期、类型混杂、离群值、空行、重复行）。清洗：`clean`（去空格、删指定字样、统一大小写、取值改名、把“¥1,299”“89元”“10%”读成数字、把“2025/3/1”“20250301”“3月1日”读成日期）、`replace`、`fill_blanks`、`remove_duplicates`、按条件 `delete_rows`、`sort`、`filter`、`copy_range`（保留原表、在副本上清洗）。每一步都报告改了多少格、删了哪些行 |
| Excel 分析与图表 | `add_column` / `fill_formula` 把一个公式填满一列并报告出错的单元格；`pivot` 建数据透视表（行、列、值、筛选，日期按月、季、年分组，结果直接返回）；`add_chart` 支持柱状、条形、堆积、折线、饼图、圆环、散点、面积、雷达和组合图（次坐标轴），可设标题、坐标轴标题、数据标签、图例，结果里给出图表占用的单元格并提示与其他图表重叠；`set_chart`、`delete_chart`；`table`、`conditional_format`、`freeze`、`validation`。`office_render` 可以看带图表的区域，也可以单独看一张图表 |
| 批量编辑 | `office_edit` 一次调用按顺序执行一批修改（写一整篇文档、填一张表加公式加图表、做几页幻灯片），中途某一项失败就停下并报告已完成哪些 |
| 改错位置的防护 | Word 按“段落编号 + 这段开头的文字”定位。你刚改过导致编号对不上时，这一步会被拒绝并要求重新读取；改写和删除段落必须带开头文字 |
| Word 一次撤销 | AI 的一批修改在 Word 里是一个撤销步骤，按一次 Ctrl+Z 整批撤回 |
| 读结构 | Word：带编号的段落、标题级别、表格；Excel：工作表、单元格的值和公式；PowerPoint：每页的形状（名称、类型、位置、文字） |
| 看排版 | `office_render` 把 Word 的一页、PowerPoint 的一页或 Excel 的一个区域渲染成图片给模型核对，不依赖截图，窗口在后台也能出图 |
| 写错参数会被指出 | 操作里出现它不认识的字段时，结果里会点名哪个字段被忽略，而不是悄悄不生效 |
| 零安装依赖 | 首次使用时用 Windows 自带的 .NET Framework `csc.exe` 编译一个小 helper（约 1 秒，之后缓存），不需要 Python、LibreOffice 或 node-gyp |

## 安装

DSH 桌面版：**插件 → 添加插件**，输入 `@copylee/dsh-office`，安装后启用。

命令行（web 等其他 profile）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @copylee/dsh-office@latest
```

要求：Windows 10 / 11（自带 .NET Framework 4.8），微软 Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint，装了哪个就能用哪个）或 WPS Office（文字、表格、演示），DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高。

## 使用

直接说要做什么，例如：

- 用 Word 写一份季度工作总结，保存到桌面
- 打开 D:\数据\销售.xlsx，加一列金额并在最后一行求和，再画一个柱状图
- 把我现在开着的 PPT 第 3 页的标题改短一点，正文改成三条要点

AI 干活的同时你可以直接在窗口里改。你正在单元格里输入、或者开着对话框时，Office 不接受外部修改，AI 会等几秒再试。

AI 只有在调用保存时才写入文件，不会替你关闭文档。

## Agent 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `office_open` | 在 Word / Excel / PowerPoint 里打开文件；路径不存在则新建；已打开则直接使用 |
| `office_status` | 列出三个应用里现在打开了什么、哪些有未保存的修改 |
| `office_read` | 把打开的文档读成文本（段落 / 单元格 / 形状） |
| `office_edit` | 按顺序执行一批修改，不保存 |
| `office_render` | 把一页 / 一张幻灯片 / 一个单元格区域渲染成图片；Word 和 PowerPoint 一次最多看 4 页，或用总览把全部页面拼成一张图 |
| `office_save` | 保存；给出路径时另存为，扩展名为 `.pdf` 时导出 PDF；改完没看过成品时附带各页图片 |
| `office_close` | 关闭 AI 自己打开或新建的文档；你原本开着的文档会被拒绝，有未保存修改时必须明确说保存还是丢弃 |
| `office_help` | 列出某个应用（Word / Excel / PowerPoint）下 `office_edit` 的全部操作和字段 |

`office_edit` 支持的操作：

- Word：`insert_diagram`（流程图、结构图：用 Word 自己的形状画在文档里，节点按行列摆放，连线自动走直角，画完仍可逐个编辑）、`insert_paragraphs`、`set_text`、`replace_text`、`format_text`、`delete_range`、`insert_table`、`set_cell`、`insert_image`、`set_image`、`format_table`、`insert_references`、`insert_footnote`、`edit_footnote`、`delete_footnote`、`footnote_settings`、`style_format`、`page_setup`、`page_numbers`、`header`、`page_break`、`insert_toc`、`update_fields`
- Excel：`write_range`（值或公式）、`format_range`、`autofit`、`insert_rows`、`delete_rows`、`add_sheet`、`rename_sheet`、`delete_sheet`、`add_chart`
- PowerPoint：`theme`（配色之外还可定卡片、圆角、项目符号的样式，以及 LaTeX Beamer 风格的外框）、`slide`（成品版式；其中 `grid` 由 AI 按行列自由组合图表、数字、表格、步骤、引语等部件，不用给坐标）、`add_slide`、`set_text`、`format_text`、`add_textbox`、`add_image`、`add_smartart`、`add_table`、`add_shape`、`set_shape`、`delete_shape`、`delete_slide`、`move_slide`、`duplicate_slide`、`set_layout`、`set_background`、`set_notes`

## 原生脚注

法学、历史等使用脚注体例的文稿，可以直接要求 AI 使用原生脚注、每条写完整出处。它与 `\cite{}` 加文末参考文献是两种不同功能。

```json
{"op":"insert_paragraphs","items":[{"text":"有关这一观点的论证[fn:张三：《示例论文》，《示例期刊》2026年第1期，第12—15页。]，还可比较其他资料\\footnote{Author. Full citation, 2026, pp. 20–23.}。"}]}
```

修改已有文稿，先 `office_read {"footnotes":true,"full":true}` 读取全部脚注；新增时用 `insert_footnote {para, expect, find?, occurrence?, where?, text}`，不传 `find` 插在段末，传入时默认位于第一次匹配文字之后。编辑、删除用 `edit_footnote` / `delete_footnote`，必填 `footnote`（读取结果的集合序号）和 `expect`（脚注原文开头）。`edit_footnote` 可以更新 `text` 及格式；局部格式用 `format_text {footnote, expect, find, italic: true}` 等。

正文中的 `[footnote:7]` 表示脚注集合第 7 条；每页或每节重编号时，页面显示的编号可能是 1，不能用它代替集合序号。增删后重新读取再操作。读取结果同时给出正文段落、段内位置、页与节；非常规编号样式无法可靠表示时，显示编号标为不可用，不会拿集合序号冒充。

`footnote_settings {numbering: "continuous" | "section" | "page", section?}` 调整全篇或指定节的编号规则。普通插入保留文档原有规则和样式。脚注中可以写 `**加粗**` 和 `$E=mc^2$`；内联语法支持配对花括号/方括号及转义分隔符，不支持脚注嵌套，未闭合或空脚注会被拒绝。给脚注起始符加一个反斜杠可保留字面文本。

含已有脚注的段落禁止整段 `set_text`，请用不跨过脚注引用标记的局部 `replace_text`；明确删除正文范围的 `delete_range` 会连同其中的脚注一起删除，并报告数量。

## 设置

设置 → Office。每项改动自动保存。

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 办公套件 | 自动 | 新打开的文件用哪个软件：自动（装了微软 Office 就用它，否则用 WPS）、微软 Office、WPS Office。已经打开着的文档始终在它所在的软件里修改 |
| 跟随 AI 的修改位置 | 开 | 窗口自动滚动到 AI 正在修改的位置；关闭为静默执行 |
| 逐字写入 | 开 | 文字像打字一样逐步出现；关闭后写得最快 |
| 静默模式 | 关 | 在后台完成，不弹窗口、不显示卡片、一次写入；回合结束时自动保存并关闭后台打开的文档。开启后“跟随”“逐字写入”“迷你卡片”不再起作用 |
| 迷你卡片 | 开 | AI 修改文档期间在右下角显示带“查看”“快速”开关的小卡片。在卡片上切换过的开关（包括你离开文档窗口后自动熄灭的“查看”），到 DSH 重启前以卡片为准 |
| 交付前整体视觉检查 | 开 | 保存时自动把整份文档的总览图交给 AI 检查；会多用一些 token |
| 优先在真实 Office 里操作 | 开 | DSH 桌面版自带 office-docx / office-xlsx / office-pptx 技能，用脚本生成文件。开启后，AI 第一次想加载这些技能时会被引回本插件（对应的 Office 应用已安装时才拦）；它再次请求时放行 |
| 打开文档时显示到前台 | 开 | 关闭后文档仍会打开，只是不抢当前窗口 |
| 核对排版的图片宽度 | 1100 像素 | `office_render` 给模型的图片宽度；越大越清晰，也越费 token |

设置页还会显示三个应用是否安装、是否在运行、打开了哪些文档。

## 限制

- Excel 和 PowerPoint 里 AI 的修改无法用 Ctrl+Z 撤回（Excel 的外部修改不进撤销栈，并且会清空已有的撤销记录）。只有 Word 支持整批撤销。
- 你正在单元格里输入、或 Office 开着模态对话框时，修改会被 Office 拒绝；插件等待约 5 秒后报告“应用忙”。
- Excel 区域的图片是通过剪贴板取得的，渲染时剪贴板里的文字会被保留，图片、文件等其他内容会丢失。
- 公式由插件自己启动的一份不可见的 Word 解析，不动你正在用的 Word。它只在一批修改期间存在（启动约 1 秒），这一批结束就关闭；万一插件中途被强行结束而留下了它，下次插件启动时会清掉。Excel 里还不能写原生公式。
- PowerPoint 的公式经剪贴板放入幻灯片。做法与电脑控制插件一致：先把剪贴板上的全部内容存起来，每写完一段文字立刻放回，且不进剪贴板历史；这期间你自己复制了新内容的话，以你的为准，不会被覆盖。Word 复制公式的那一下仍会出现在 Win+V 历史里。
- PowerPoint 的表格单元格和 SmartArt 节点里放不了排好版的公式，公式在那里写成带上下标的文字。
- 引用按编号书写，插入或删除文献后不会自动重新编号。
- 兼容模式（Word 97–2003 格式）的文档里不能建立原生公式。
- WPS 文字里的公式是原生公式（由插件把 LaTeX 转成公式格式后插入），带编号的公式其编号跟在公式后面而不是靠右；WPS 演示不接受公式（不能建立，也不能粘贴），那里的公式由 WPS 文字排好后以矢量图片叠在文字上：颜色和字号与所在文字一致，放大不糊，但不能编辑，也不能转回文字；移动或改写带公式的文本框后需要重写其文本以重新摆放。幻灯片里公式多的话，推荐用 PowerPoint。WPS 文字里窗口不会跟随滚动到修改位置；资源管理器里双击后台文档时的行为没有像微软 Office 那样专门处理。其余操作与微软 Office 相同。
- 没有打开 Office 时处理文件、批量转换格式不在本插件范围内。

## 数据与隐私

插件只在本机运行，不联网。它读写的是你让 AI 处理的文档；`office_render` 生成的图片作为附件保存在会话历史里，和 DSH 的其他图片附件一样。

## 工作原理

宿主侧是一个 Cordis 插件，注册上面六个工具。它启动一个常驻的小程序（`helper/OfficeHelper.cs`，C# 5，运行时由系统自带的 `csc.exe` 编译，按源码哈希缓存在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-office\`），通过标准输入输出逐行交换 JSON。helper 用 COM 附着到正在运行的 Office 应用（没有运行则启动并显示出来），按后期绑定调用它们的对象模型。每条命令结束后 helper 释放全部 COM 引用，这样你关掉 Office 时进程能正常退出。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build
node scripts/office-smoke.mjs        # 真实 Office：只操作脚本自己在临时目录里新建的文档
node scripts/office-smoke.mjs --wps  # 同样的步骤，在 WPS Office 里
node scripts/footnotes-smoke.mjs       # 原生脚注、公式、保存重开及跨页/跨节编号验收
node scripts/footnotes-smoke.mjs --wps # WPS 文字独立验收
```

# dsh-task-ledger

Name reserved for an upcoming [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) (dsh) plugin:

- a **task ledger board** UI (per-workspace todos, history by owner, reports)
- the **task-ledger** skill bundled for global agent use

First functional release in development.

# dsh-task-ledger

Monorepo for the **task ledger** project — one repo, two npm packages:

| Package | What | Who installs it | Publish trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-task-ledger`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-task-ledger) | DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: task ledger board UI + the `task-ledger` skill bundled | DSH users (`dsh plugin add dsh-task-ledger`) | tag `plugin-v*` |
| [`task-ledger`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/task-ledger) | The standalone skill (SKILL.md + scripts + assets), zero-code | CodeBuddy / other agent users (`npm install task-ledger`) | tag `skill-v*` |

The skill content has a single source of truth at `packages/skill/`; the plugin bundles a copy built from it, so DSH users get the skill automatically while everyone else installs `task-ledger` directly.

## Status

- `task-ledger@1.3.0` published (2026-10-21): `--no-sync` is accepted before **and** after the subcommand (appending it used to abort with a usage error); a `ledger/` that was committed first and only later added to `.gitignore` is now skipped silently instead of printing a "commit it manually" hint that git refuses to honour; autostash pop conflicts are detected from the index (git 2.27+ rewrote the message, so the old string check never fired and conflicts were reported as "restored") and the conflicted files are named.
- `dsh-task-ledger@0.0.74` published (2026-10-21): bundles the updated skill; no host behaviour change.
- `task-ledger@1.2.2` published (2026-10-19): every edit to a worklog must now be followed by exactly one `log` call — an edit without a matching execution record counts as unfinished work.
- `dsh-task-ledger@0.0.56` published (2026-10-19): bundles the updated skill text; no host behaviour change.
- `task-ledger@1.2.1` published (2026-10-19): prompt slimmed from ~26 KB to ~9 KB (details moved to `references/`, loaded on demand); `description` rewritten as pure routing (three intent clusters + explicit-only close/release) — no commands, paths or workflow text; handover removed from the prompt (release → claim only, `set --owner` kept for a future UI); history table separator fixed to 9 columns; older worklogs without the 执行记录 section get one appended automatically.
- `dsh-task-ledger@0.0.55` published (2026-10-19): bundles the slimmed skill and its references; no host behaviour change beyond `0.0.54`.
- `task-ledger@1.2.0` published (2026-10-19): worklog gains a script-maintained **执行记录** section (`- 时间 · 类型 · @谁 · 说明`, types `new`/`claim`/`set`/`release`/`log`/`close`, append-only) and a new `log` subcommand; `progress.json` gains `updated` (last-progress time); **`blocked` state removed** — blocked/stale are now time-derived flags (7 days since start / 3 days since last update), old `blocked` rows stay readable as in-progress.
- `dsh-task-ledger@0.0.54` published (2026-10-19): board stats `blocked`/`myBlocked` replaced by time-derived `overdue`/`myOverdue` (7 days since start); stale now means 3 days without progress and feeds the `updated` field; per-row `overdue` flag ships for the UI round.
- `task-ledger@1.0.2` published (2026-10-17): `history` JSON mode now emits JSON even when a workspace has no history files (fixes a 500 that blanked the whole board).
- `task-ledger@1.1.0` published (2026-10-17): history format 8→9 columns — new **creator** column (task initiator, distinct from owner which can be claimed away). `close` writes it; `upgrade_history` migrates legacy rows by following each row's worklog link and reading the 「创建：…（@发起人）」 header (same source as `created` — **no data lost**); read-only `history --json` also back-fills it for unmigrated 8-col rows.
- `dsh-task-ledger@0.0.18` published (2026-10-17): chart semantics fixed per user — **新增（我的）now means 'created by me' (creator)**, while 完成/未结（我的）stay 'owned by me' (owner). Previously all three used owner. Smoke adds a fork-semantics integration test (creator-created + other-owned open/closed fixtures: mine.created=2, mine.done=0, mine.remaining=0) and scopes the remaining baseline invariant to `all` only (mine's three series are now different scopes — mixing them in one identity is invalid).
- `dsh-task-ledger@0.0.17` published (2026-10-17): chart hover tooltip cleaned up — top line now only shows the week-end date (e.g. '截至 2026-10-17'), with the three colored rows below carrying the numbers; when '只看我的' is checked the date line shows '(只看我的)' so the scope is obvious.
