- [中文安装指南](./INSTALL.zh.md)
- [日本語インストールガイド](./INSTALL.ja.md)
- [한국어 설치 안내](./INSTALL.ko.md)
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)
- [日本語 changelog](./CHANGELOG.ja.md)
- [한국어 changelog](./CHANGELOG.ko.md)

> **Compatibility note:** v2.0.0 ships `ja` / `ko` dictionaries, but official DSH exposes
> only `zh` / `en` through `LocaleRuntime` (`LOCALE_IDS = ["zh", "en"]`). On stock DSH,
> selecting `ja` / `ko` fails with `locale "<id>" is not registered`. Use a DSH fork that
> updates `LOCALE_IDS` (locale-settings.ts) and `LOCALES` labels (client/index.ts), then
> rebuild.

> **▼ DSH version compatibility**
>
> Two DSH lines are served from two long-lived branches, each with its own version
> series, `engines.dsh`, and npm dist-tag ([release layout](./RELEASING.md)):
>
> | DSH version | Branch | Version | npm tag |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | 0.1.0-rc.7 ~ 0.1.1-rc.x | `legacy` | `1.x` | `@legacy` |
> | 0.1.2-alpha.1+ (incl. 0.1.5-rc.2) | `main` | `2.x` | `@latest` / `@dsh-0.1.2` (`@2.x` is a range) |
>
> The series number tracks the **DSH line** (`1.x` = DSH ≤ 0.1.1, `2.x` = DSH 0.1.2+),
> and the majors fence each other: a `^1.x` install never resolves a `2.x` release and
> vice versa. `engines.dsh` states the same split but DSH never reads it — the ranges
> and dist-tags are what hold an old DSH on `1.x`.
>
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` was **removed** at `0.1.2-alpha.1` — it did not
> merely move. The `legacy` line still reaches `ctx.slots` through it; `main` gets
> the same declaration from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client`. Two
> version-sensitive seams are handled by capability probes rather than version
> checks: (1) settings registration uses `register`, which exists on both lines
> (`installSection` is an addition, not a replacement); (2) `effectivePolicy` is a
> **private** method of the user-approval service on both, so it is read behind a
> `typeof` probe and degrades to “policy unknown” when absent or throwing.

Version **2.6.0** — see the [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md).

A single, self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed permission gate for DeepSeek Harness.

`dsh-perm-gate` decides every tool call through a fixed priority chain:

| Stage | Decision | What it is |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| **P0** | `deny` | deterministic hard-deny: credential material, protected-path mutation, dangerous shell |
| **P1** | `allow` | a precise, bounded **session grant** |
| **P2** | `deny/allow/ask` | static rule chain: blacklist first, then allow, then ask |
| **P3** | `allow/deny/ask` | optional LLM semantic classifier (default **off**) |
| **P4** | `ask` | official approval seam |

Strictly fail-closed: a P0 decision is never overridden by a grant, a rule, the classifier, or a human.

<!-- host-compat:begin — generated by scripts/sync-hosts.mjs from scripts/hosts.mjs; DO NOT EDIT -->
- **Supported DSH hosts:** `0.1.0-rc.2` `0.1.0-rc.3` `0.1.0-rc.6` `0.1.0-rc.7` `0.1.0-rc.8` `0.1.1-rc.1` `0.1.1-rc.2` `0.1.2-rc.1` `0.1.5-rc.1` `0.1.5-rc.2` `0.1.5-rc.3` `0.1.7-rc.1` `0.1.7-rc.2` `0.2.0-rc.1` `0.2.0-rc.2` `0.2.1-rc.1` `0.2.1-rc.2` `0.2.1-rc.3` (18 rc releases across lines 0.1.0 / 0.1.1 / 0.1.2 / 0.1.5 / 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1)
- **Runtime-verified:** `0.2.0-rc.2` — evidence in `.compat-results/`
<!-- host-compat:end -->

## Why

The DSH safety ecosystem splits this across several plugins (`dsh-permission-rules`,
`dsh-auto-mode`, `dsh-auto-review`, `dsh-movein-permissions`). `dsh-perm-gate` merges the
gate + approval + (optional) classifier into one package, with one audit trail and no
cross-plugin version coupling.

## Features

- **Command whitelist / blacklist** — matched on an **argv decomposition** (not a raw string),
  with recursive descent into `sh -c`/`bash -c`, pipeline detection, redirect-target
  checking, and recursive/force (`rm -rf`) recognition.
- **Deny priority** — a matching deny rule wins over any allow rule.
- **Session grants** — precise `(tool, canonical fingerprint)` grants with `TTL` + `maxUses`;
  re-running with a different target never reuses authority. Sub-agents inherit but cannot mint.
- **Pure-function rule engine** — glob/regex compilation with a ReDoS bound, loud fail on
  malformed rules, and source-hash compile caching.
- **Audit** — every decision is logged as an `{ignorable:true}` event with its `callId`; the
  model-visible reason matches the recorded outcome.
- **自动审查 tier** (`permissive`, plus `permissive-full`) — an **independent approval mode**
  (separate from read-only, full-access and whitelist tiers) that is neither "auto-approve" nor
  blanket trust. Front-end exposes a **single switch** (`permissive`); the four backend strategies
  are **combinable** and driven by plugin settings — still fail-closed against P0. The permission
  picker and the settings row both show it under the product label 自动审查, with no icon. The
  `permissive-full` variant keeps the identical approval behaviour but drops the built-in file
  sandbox, which otherwise denies the named pipes `git clone` / Cygwin / ConPTY need.
- **Sandbox-escalation auto-answer** (`trustEscalation`) — a sandbox escalation is asked from
  *inside* the shell / pwsh / edit tool body, after `tools/pre-execute`, so the gate never saw
  it and a call it auto-allowed still prompted you to approve the widening. With this strategy
  on, the exact call the gate cleared (matched by `callId`) is answered here instead.
- **Risk-graded `llmAssist`** — a custom OpenAI-compatible LLM grades each `ask` as
  `safe` / `risky:<category>`; hard categories (deletion, credential, remote, system, bulk)
  **always ask**, neutral enters verdict learning, and every failure stays fail-closed.
- **Verdict learning** — neutral-risk asks that the human approves and that actually execute
  count up; after the threshold, the *exact same operation* (fingerprint-matched) auto-allows.
- **Decision event feed** — every decision is appended to a JSONL feed and surfaced by the
  browser half as a notice strip above the conversation input plus an approval-records tab
  (newest first) in the conversation view.

A preset **deny-keyword blacklist** (inherited from dsh-approval-gate's `DEFAULT_DENY_KEYWORDS`:
`rm -rf`, `push --force`, `drop table`, `mkfs`, `git reset --hard`, `docker system prune`, …) vetoes
any call whose text contains a keyword — case-insensitive substring, applied before whitelist,
grants and LLM. It is editable as a list in the settings card (preset entries are tagged, and a
one-click restore brings the preset back); unset or empty applies the preset — the blacklist
never silently turns off.

## Install

Requires an existing [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) installation.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-perm-gate
```

Full install, upgrade, migration and troubleshooting steps live in the
[Installation guide](./INSTALL.md) — also available in
[中文](./INSTALL.zh.md) / [日本語](./INSTALL.ja.md) / [한국어](./INSTALL.ko.md).

## Configuration

### AppContainer sandbox (Windows; beta)

`dsh-perm-gate` can run gate-allowed shell commands inside a **Windows AppContainer** instead of
handing them back unconfined. The container token is created with **zero network capabilities**, so
non-loopback egress is blocked by Windows Firewall (WFP) itself — not by an advisory environment
variable. The container SID is OS-derived from the fixed name `dsh-perm-gate.ac`, so the one-time
`CheckNetIsolation LoopbackExempt` (which lets the container reach `127.0.0.1`) is a per-machine
step, not a per-session one. Egress is therefore possible **only** through the network proxy:

- `sandboxEnabled` (default `false`) — master switch. When on, every **auto-allowed** shell call is
  rewritten into the launcher invocation; a human-approved call is out of scope (the user approved
  it consciously). If the launcher cannot be built or the OS rejects the container launch, the call
  is **denied** (fail-closed) with reason `sandbox: …` — never run unconfined.
- `sandboxMode` — `workspace-write` (default; workspace gets Modify + private temp FullControl,
  system dirs stay readable through the stock ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES ACEs) or `read-only`.
- `sandboxProxy` — **the proxy parameter**: empty (default) follows the builtin filtered proxy's
  actual `127.0.0.1:<port>` when `networkEnabled`; an explicit URL must be loopback-bound (the
  container cannot reach anything else) and destination filtering is that proxy's job.
- `sandboxLoopback` — `exempt` (default; attempt the one-time exemption, warn with the exact
  elevated command if denied) or `off`.

The launcher is a small C# program shipped as source (`assets/appcontainer-launcher.cs`) and
compiled on first use by the .NET Framework compiler every Windows carries (`csc.exe`); the plugin
itself keeps zero native dependencies. Verify a machine end-to-end with:

```
node scripts/smoke-appcontainer.mjs
```

Known boundary: on Windows 11 25H2+ builds where the classic AppContainer creation APIs have been
removed (verified on 26200) and the mxc replacement is not yet exposed (26600+), the launcher fails
closed at the kernel step; the sandbox then denies sandboxed calls with a clear reason instead of
running them unconfined. On Windows 10 / 11 ≤ 24H2 the documented classic path applies.

Add the plugin to `cordis.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-perm-gate
  name: dsh-perm-gate
  config:
    rulesFile: ./permissions.yaml   # optional; defaults to $DSH_HOME/perm-gate/rules.yml
    dshHome: $DSH_HOME              # root pinned for protected-target checks
    defaultAction: ask              # allow | ask | deny
    gatePresets: [permissive, permissive-full]   # tiers where the gate is active (default)
    sessionSweep: true              # hourly cleanup of archived/dead sessions' gate data
```

### Session sweep

On startup and every hour the gate reads DSH's workspace store
(`$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`, read-only) and classifies every session it
holds authorization-chain data for. Sessions DSH has archived (`global.archivedSessionIds`)
or no longer tracks at all have their decision events dropped from
`$DSH_HOME/perm-gate/events.jsonl` and their pre-change snapshot files deleted
from `$DSH_HOME/perm-gate/snapshots/` — history the review page can no longer
reach, for data the harness itself considers gone. Live sessions are untouched,
unattributable rows (empty session id) are never deleted, and any failure is
fail-open: the round is skipped and retried an hour later. Set `sessionSweep: false`
to disable; `workspaceStoreFile` overrides the store path. Restoring an archived
session does not restore its swept history.

### Rules file

```yaml
permissions:
  defaultAction: ask
  deny:
    - command: [rm#recursive]
      reason: no recursive rm
    - command: [ssh]
      reason: no direct ssh
    - paths: [.dsh/**]
      reason: protect harness metadata
  allow:
    - command: [pnpm, node]
      reason: dev tools
    - command: [curl, wget]
      args: ["https://*.example.com/*"]
      reason: allowed endpoint
  ask:
    - command: [bash, sh]
      reason: ask shells
```

A command entry `word#flag` matches the command word (`word`) with the modifier `recursive` or
`force` — so `rm#recursive` matches `rm -rf`, `env rm -rf`, and `sh -c "rm -rf /"`.

### Network policy (opt-in)

A local HTTP/CONNECT proxy that adjudicates the outbound traffic of **shell
subprocesses** against the same rules file, plus an approval path for targets no
rule covers. **Off by default** — enabling it binds a loopback port and rewrites
the proxy environment for child processes, so it is never turned on implicitly.

```yaml
- id: dsh-perm-gate
  config:
    networkEnabled: false          # master switch (default false)
    networkMode: whitelist         # deny-all | whitelist | allow-all
    networkUnlisted: ask           # ask | deny  — unlisted target handling
    networkUnattributed: allow     # allow | deny — traffic with no shell attribution
    networkInjectEnv: true         # rewrite HTTP(S)_PROXY/ALL_PROXY for children
    networkAskTimeoutMs: 120000    # approval wait before failing closed
    networkGrantTtlMs: 1800000     # how long one approval covers its target
```

**Tiered behaviour.** Nothing reaches the network without an allow rule.
An unlisted target is escalated to the interactive approval seam, raised on
behalf of the shell command that opened the connection; approving widens reach
for that target for the session. A `deny` rule is **never** escalated —
approval can widen what an unlisted target may reach, but it can never override
a rule that says no.

**The boundary — read this before relying on it.** The proxy is a *cooperative*
policy layer, not an enforcement boundary. It only sees traffic from clients
that read the proxy environment:

| Client | Covered? |
|--------|----------|
| `curl`, `wget`, `git`, Go `net/http`, Python `requests` | yes |
| **Node.js `http`/`https`/`fetch`** | **no — connects directly** |
| Java (without `-D` proxy flags), .NET `HttpClient` | no |
| Raw sockets, custom TCP | no |
| DNS, QUIC/HTTP3, non-HTTP protocols | no |
| Connections to a literal IP | no |

So a shell command like `node -e "require('http').get('http://host/')"` is not
intercepted. Treat this as a guardrail against accidents and a place to state
intent, not as a hermetic sandbox.

DSH's **own** network traffic — the built-in network tools and the LLM
transport — is deliberately left alone. Those connections carry no shell
attribution, and `networkUnattributed: allow` (the default) passes them
through unreviewed: reviewing them would let the host block *itself*, which is
a worse failure than a missed block. Set `networkUnattributed: deny` only if
you know your host's clients ignore the proxy environment.

Query the live state at `GET /api/dsh-perm-gate/network` (mode, bind, port,
proxy liveness, env-injection state, block counters, recent blocks).

## The 自动审查 tier (machine value `permissive`)

自动审查 is an **independent approval tier** in the DSH permission picker, parallel to
Read Only / Workspace Write / Full access / Whitelist. It is **not** generic "auto-approval" and
never mints blanket authority: it only narrows or widens the seam *before* the human/LLM step
while P0 hard-deny stays monotonic and non-negotiable **within the gate's own scope**.

> **P0 is scoped, not global.** The gate acts only while the session's permission preset is one
> of `gatePresets` (default `permissive` / `permissive-full`). Under any other preset — Read Only,
> Workspace Write, or Full access — the **entire** gate stands down, P0 hard-deny included,
> because the selected tier's own policy governs that session. This is deliberate (see
> `gatePresets` in the configuration table), but it means "P0 is non-negotiable" holds *inside*
> the gate's tiers rather than across every tier. A stand-down is not silent: the gate records one
> `stand-down` event per session/preset transition and the browser shows a sticky **GATE OFF**
> strip above the input. Set `gatePresets: ['*']` to make P0 global again.

**Two variants ship**, because a preset's `sandbox` and `approval` are independent knobs and
coupling them forced a bad trade:

| Picker label | Machine value | sandbox | approval |
|--------------|---------------|---------|----------|
| 自动审查 | `permissive` | `workspace-write` | `ask` |
| 自动审查（高权限） | `permissive-full` | `danger-full-access` | `ask` |

The plain tier keeps the built-in file sandbox. That sandbox also denies the named pipes a child
process needs to start, so `git clone`, MSYS2/Cygwin `sh.exe` and ConPTY fail under it with
`Win32 error 5` / `couldn't create signal pipe`. Because the gate is active **only** in the tiers
listed in `gatePresets`, wanting the gate meant accepting that restriction. 自动审查（高权限）
removes the coupling: identical approval behaviour, no file-sandbox restriction. The tier's own
description states the trade plainly — the workflow is smoother, approvals still apply per call,
but there is **no system sandbox left as a backstop**. Both are in the
default `gatePresets`, so either one gives you the full P0–P4 chain — the gate reads the preset
**name** only, never the sandbox mode.

The picker label is a **host-supplied product string**, not a per-locale dictionary entry: DSH
renders a plugin tier's `name:` verbatim on both permission surfaces (the General-settings
default row and the composer picker) and only supplies its own localized labels for the three
built-in values, so `cordis.patch.yml` ships the Chinese label for every session.

The **icon** is a different story. The composer's glyph map is closed, and its own comment states
the rule: *host-configured names outside the design set get none.* `permissive` is a built-in
value, so 自动审查 already has a shield+eye glyph; `permissive-full` gets the same glyph only
because `npx dsh-perm-gate-patch-glyph` adds it to that map. That patch edits a **host**
package, so it is lost on every DSH upgrade — see
[After a DSH upgrade](./INSTALL.md#after-a-dsh-upgrade-re-apply-the-composer-glyph-patch).

In `cordis.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-perm-gate
  name: dsh-perm-gate
  config:
    rulesFile: ./permissions.yaml
    defaultAction: ask
    permissive: true            # single front-facing switch (independent tier on)
    permissiveStrategies:        # backend, combinable
      trustAutoAllow: true       # in-scope safe ops auto-allow; dangerous/unknown ask
      alwaysConfirm: false       # every crossing asks; allow-controls add repeat-allow / wl-migrate buttons
      llmAssist: false           # LLM classify first, human fallback on ask/failure
      trustEscalation: true      # a cleared call's own sandbox escalation needs no prompt
    yolo: false                  # unattended: never ask a human, block danger, run the rest
    rulesFallback: false         # no reviewer available => decide on the rule nets alone
    scriptReview: true           # attach the body of a script the call runs to the review
    credentialPaths: []          # long-tail secret paths, held to the `.ssh` standard
    denyKeywordsExtra: []        # appended blacklist words (never replaces the preset)
    extraContentArgKeys: []      # argument fields that are documents, not operations
    extraOperationArgKeys: []    # argument fields that ARE executed code (wins on conflict)
    safenetPass: true            # the permissive-mech implementation exists (mechanical takeover)
    safenetAsk: false            # the permissive-snet implementation exists (mechanical screen, still asks)
```
Three switches, each owning exactly one permission preset the plugin contributes to the picker —
so a switch changes the behaviour of its own tier and of no other, and switching an implementation
off returns that tier to the ordinary human flow instead of quietly turning it into a different one.

| switch | tier | who settles an ask | asks a person | calls the model |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `permissive` | `permissive` / `permissive-full` | machine screen + grader refine, then a person | yes | per `llmAssist` |
| `safenetAsk` | `permissive-snet` | a person, with the machine screen's doubts listed | **yes** | **never** |
| `safenetPass` | `permissive-mech` | the machine screen alone: named danger blocked + fed back, rest runs | no | **never** |
| `yolo` | `permissive-yolo` | the grader answers in the person's place; risky blocks + feeds back | never | every residual |

`safenetPass` is the reviewed form of `approval: never` (that preset passes every ask with nothing
judging it) and what YOLO degrades to with no reviewer. `yolo` is the model-backed tier by
definition: with no reviewer in seat it still refuses to ask a person, settles on the machine
screen, and records `yolo-allow-no-reviewer` so the history cannot read as if a model had answered.
All five tiers ship in the plugin's own profile patch, so they are in the picker on install —
nothing to hand-edit. Presets outside `gatePresets` never reach any of this: the whole gate
stands down there, so there is no ask to settle.


`trustAutoAllow` is the baseline middle tier (rule-allow auto-passes). `alwaysConfirm` surfaces
the approval panel for every crossing; its "allow controls" add two extended buttons — 
**repeat-allow this type this session** (a bounded session grant) and **allow every occurrence**
(which persists the command word into the `permissions.yaml` allow whitelist via
`approveAllowEverywhere`). `llmAssist` consults a real, configurable LLM (`classifierEndpoint` /
`classifierModel`, any OpenAI-compatible API) to auto-decide an `ask`, and falls back to the
human seam on `ask`/error — always fail-closed. `trustEscalation` (on by default while the tier
is on) answers a `sandbox_permissions` escalation raised from inside a call the gate already
allowed; see below. When `permissive` is off, the gate behaves exactly as before.

### Unattended tiers, and how to protect a secret the preset never heard of

Three switches change **who decides**, seven keys change **what is known**. They are all
`volatile`: an edit in the settings card applies to the next tool call, no reload.

- `yolo` (the `permissive-yolo` tier) — never raises a confirmation. A dangerous ask
  (irreversible, unlearnable, an unreadable payload, or a hard-risk verdict from the configured
  reviewer) is blocked and the reason comes back to the agent as a `工具审核意见` message;
  everything else runs. With no reviewer in seat the tier does not quietly allow — the mechanical
  screen settles it and the event is recorded as `yolo-allow-no-reviewer`, because a tier that
  advertises a model must not report one it never got.
- `rulesFallback` — degraded review. Only when there is **no reviewer** (none configured, or the
  endpoint gave no verdict) the deterministic nets decide instead of parking the call on a popup
  nobody will answer. While a reviewer answers, nothing changes. It governs the ordinary 自动审查
  tiers (`permissive`, `permissive-full`); the three tiers that own an implementation already say
  who answers, so this switch does not degrade them.
- `scriptReview` (on by default) — when a call runs a script, its body is read (bounded, never
  executed) and shown to the model, the human card, **and** the deterministic nets: a delete that
  only appears inside `clean-home.sh` is now graded on code. A fully-read script also stops being an
  unreadable payload, so it leaves the `U` tier. Switch it off to keep file contents on the machine
  — out-of-workspace script runs then go back to "unknowable, ask a human".

The long tail of *what counts as a secret* is yours to extend, and each list only ever adds to the
built-in one — replacing the preset lists is deliberately not offered, because forgetting `content`
or `plan` would silently re-create a bug this gate already fixed:

- `credentialPaths` — path globs (`**` crosses directories, `*`/`?` stay in one segment; a plain
  entry matches a whole path fragment; `~/` expands to your home; a relative pattern also matches at
  any depth). A listed path is held to the same standard as `.ssh`: reading it outside the workspace
  is refused, mutating it through `write`/`edit` is refused. That tier is P0 — not appealable, not
  clearable by a reviewer — which is why it is a setting and not a `rules.yaml` rule: read-only tools
  are auto-allowed *before* the rule chain runs, so a rule cannot see them.
- `denyKeywordsExtra` — words appended to whichever blacklist is live (preset or your own
  `denyKeywords`), so a company CLI subcommand or token prefix gets a deterministic block without
  you copying fifty preset entries into your profile.
- `extraContentArgKeys` / `extraOperationArgKeys` — which argument fields are prose and which are
  operations. The first stops a host tool's `steps`/`notes` field from being read as an act (that
  is how issue #2 happened: an honest plan naming `rm -rf` got refused for describing it). The
  second opens the reverse route for a `workflowYaml` whose body really executes — and it wins if
  both name the same key. Naming a genuine document field there makes "the plan mentions `rm -rf`"
  a refusal reason again, so it is off by default.

Declaring `command` or `file_path` as prose cannot weaken the gate: the executed command and the
mutated path are judged by their own code paths, not by this table (asserted by tests).

### Sandbox escalation: why a `safe` verdict still prompted

A tool call can raise **two independent approvals**. The gate owns the first — its own `ask`, on
the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall. The second comes from `approveEscalation` **inside the tool
body**, at `tools/execute` time, whenever the model passed `sandbox_permissions` +
`justification`; by then `tools/pre-execute` has already settled, so the gate's allow never
reaches it. A call the LLM graded `safe` and the gate auto-allowed therefore still showed a
prompt asking you to approve the sandbox widening.

`trustEscalation` closes that gap. The gate remembers every call it positively allowed (keyed by
the host's `callId`, which the escalation request repeats) and answers the escalation
`allowed-once` itself. It applies only when *all* hold:

- the 自动审查 tier is on and `trustEscalation` is on;
- the request carries a `callId` the gate cleared, with a matching tool name;
- the reason is a recognized escalation naming `workspace-write` or `danger-full-access`.

Everything else — an unrecognized reason, a different call, a call the gate asked or denied, the
`approval: never` passthrough — delegates to the human unchanged, so a future DSH wording change
fails closed rather than open. The auto-answer is recorded on the event feed
(`verdict: "escalation-auto"`, `mode: <target>`). Turn the switch off to keep widening
human-gated while other allows stay automatic.


### Risk-graded llmAssist, verdict learning, and the event feed

When `llmAssist` is on, the configured LLM grades one `ask` at a time with a structured
protocol. Grading happens **inside the gate's `tools/pre-execute` waterfall, before the decision
is returned to the host**: a `safe` verdict delegates the call straight through, so the approval
panel never appears; only a genuinely uncertain verdict reaches you. Two receiver sources are
selectable in the settings card: a **custom API** (any
OpenAI-compatible endpoint — `classifierEndpoint` / `classifierModel` / `classifierApiKey`,
with presets including Xiaomi MiMo `https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1`), or the **DSH host model
group** (the session's configured `llm` service, via `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection`,
optionally overridden with `classifierProvider` / `classifierModel`). A **health test** button
(`POST /api/dsh-perm-gate/health`) runs one minimal completion and reports latency.

- `safe` → the call is auto-allowed (audited as the `classifier` source); no panel is shown.
- `risky` + a **hard category** (`deletion`, `credential`, `remote`, `system`, `bulk`) → the call
  **keeps the human ask**. The classifier **never denies**: the deny path belongs to the
  deterministic layers alone (P0 hard-deny, the deny-keyword blacklist, explicit `deny:` rules), so
  a misgraded category is always negotiable instead of an unappealable block. Hard categories stay
  distinct from `neutral` in one way that matters: they are **never learned**, so repeated
  approvals can never sediment them into an auto-allow.
  (Denying on the model's word was measured live: a benign `git commit -F …` graded `remote`
  produced an auto-deny with no panel and no grant to retry with.)
- `risky:neutral` → with `riskLearning` enabled (Settings card, off by default), each human
  approval that actually executes (settled via the host's `tools/result` event) counts toward
  a `tool|category` key; once the count reaches `riskThreshold` (default 3) **and** the new
  call's operation fingerprint (command word + target basename) matches a confirmed sample,
  the exact same operation auto-allows. A different target never reuses that authority. With sedimentation (`riskSediment`, on by default) a
threshold-reached key's confirmed samples become **deterministic allow rules**: an exact hit allows
outright without another LLM call — even with `llmAssist` off — and the sedimented rules are visible
and manageable (terminate / remove) in the settings card.
- Timeouts (`riskTimeoutMs`, default 20 s, one retry), transport failures, and off-protocol
  model output leave the ask untouched — the gate never guesses.

Learning state persists to a plugin-owned JSON (`$DSH_HOME/perm-gate/learning.json`, or
`learningFile`), never into your YAML rules file. Every decision is appended to
`$DSH_HOME/perm-gate/events.jsonl` (or `eventsFile`) and served at
`GET /api/dsh-perm-gate/events?sessionId=&since=`; the browser half polls it and shows the
latest decision as a notice strip above the conversation input (asks stay visible until the
next event) and lists the whole session's decisions newest-first in the **Approvals** tab of
the conversation view.

Every decision's affected files are snapshotted before the change lands (≤5 files, ≤256 KB each)
under `$DSH_HOME/perm-gate/snapshots/`; in the **Approvals** tab each file chip opens a line diff
(`GET /api/dsh-perm-gate/diff`) with a **revert** action that delivers a restore instruction into
the conversation (`POST /api/dsh-perm-gate/revert`). A snapshot inventory bar clears them per
session or entirely (`GET /api/dsh-perm-gate/snapshots-stats` / `POST /api/dsh-perm-gate/snapshots-clear`).

An `ask` the gate routes to a human is tracked until the human answers: a passive
`approval/request` observer records the closed outcome (`allowed-once` → **approved**,
`rejected` → **rejected**, `cancelled` → **cancelled**, `unavailable` → a denial, since no approval
channel existed), with `tools/result` set

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-qq-bridge

把 QQ 接进一个 DSH 智能体：谁在私聊里说话、谁在群里 @ 它，它就在自己的会话里想，然后把回答发回去。

它不是「QQ 机器人框架」，而是一条通道。它自己不做协议逆向、不登录账号、不伪装客户端——它连的是 [NapCat](https://github.com/NapNeko/NapCatQQ) 或 LLBot 这类已经登录好的 OneBot 11 后端。所以风险边界很清楚：**登录和设备指纹的问题归后端，桥只负责「收到消息 → 跑一轮 → 发回回答」**。

---

## 为什么是这样

### 一个会话就是一个 DSH session

企鹅号上「跟谁说话」是可以枚举的：私聊是一个人的 id，群是一个群的 id。所以会话 id 直接由它派生：

```
qq:<namespace>:<kind>:<id>      qq:onebot:private:10001
                                qq:onebot:group:67890
```

第一段是 `sessionNamespace`（默认 `onebot`），**刻意不是当前传输的名字**：号是同一个号，换传输不换人，见下面「换传输不换会话」。

四段各自 `encodeURIComponent` 再用 `:` 连起来。**每段都编码**，所以一个 id 里带 `:` 也伪造不出另一个会话的键——这不是洁癖，是「发错人」这个错误的唯一防线。

这个 id 同时是 DSH 的 session id，落在磁盘上，重启后 `resume` 而不是 `create`。**一个桥如果在重启后把对话重新开一遍，对用户来说和失忆没有区别**，而失忆看起来就像记忆插件坏了——所以「先问存储里有没有，再决定 create 还是 resume」这件事值得单独写一段代码。

群是**一个群一个会话**，不是每个成员一个。群里多个人的话进同一个上下文，因为群里的人本来就在同一个房间里；按成员分会话会让 agent 分别回答每个人，而它看见的是同一段对话。

### 群聊默认只在被 @ 时说话，但可以改

三条路线写进配置项 `groupMode`：

| 值 | 行为 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| `mention`（默认） | 只有被 @ 才回 | 正常的群。个人号在群里每句都回，结果是被全员静音 |
| `always` | 每条消息都回 | 两三个人的小群当共享记事本用 |
| `off` | 一句都不回 | 挂着看但不说话 |

默认是 `mention`，理由是**社会性的不是技术性的**：它不是一个能力限制，是一个礼貌问题。

`off` 下**即使被 @ 也不回**。@ 不是推翻运维决定的理由——一个人可以在群里 @ 一个明确设置为不说话的号，这是那个人越界，不是配置该让步。

三档都在真群里验过（2026-10-19，群 1070071261）：`always` 下一条无 @ 的 `测试6` 让会话文件从 24311 字节长到 31474；`off` 下一条带 `at: 3658332922` 的 `测试7` 让会话文件**一个字节都没变**。判据是会话文件，不是日志——「没回」和「没收到」在日志里一样安静。

改 `groupMode` 要重启进程才生效：配置在启动时读一次。

`mention` 放行时会把传输层合成的 `@你` 从文本里剥掉。那个标记不是任何人打出来的字；留着它，模型会学会「别人用第三人称称呼我」。

**手打的 `@LD` 不算 @。** 在 QQ 里从成员列表选中一个人（或者输入 `@` 后从弹出的候选里点选），消息里才会出现一个 `at` 段；直接敲键盘打「@LD」只是四个普通字符，和说「@LD」这个词没有区别。所以 `mention` 模式下后者不会被回应。

这不是缺陷，是唯一可能正确的行为——桥看不到任何能区分「他想 @ 我」和「他在谈论我」的信号，猜错的代价是每一条提到你名字的聊天都触发一次回复。真机联调时我自己就撞上了：手打 `测试带@LD ` 被静默忽略，拉群历史才看出那条消息里根本没有 `at` 段。

排查时不要看会话里的文本，`admit()` 剥标记之后两种来源长得一样。看原始段：`node tools\group-history.mjs <群号>`。

### 工具只有三个，而且刻意少

被外部消息唤醒的 agent，威胁模型和被人敲键盘的 agent 完全不同：它读的是陌生人写的字，而它手上每个工具都是那段字能拉的杆。

所以只有：

- `qq_whoami` — 我是谁、连着哪些会话、今天还能主动发几条
- `qq_send` — 给一个**已经聊过的**会话发一条文字
- `qq_history` — 读回当前会话最近说过的话

**刻意没有**：任选目标、列群、改 `groupMode`、读别人的会话、同意好友申请。

结果是一段提示注入最多能让它往「已经有人在的房间里」多发一句话——和回复路径同权，不多一点。这是设计目标，不是巧合。

好友申请和群邀请在传输层就被丢掉（`notice`/`request` 事件一律不翻译），因为**同意好友是运维的决定，不是 agent 能靠回复同意的事**。

### 空回答不发

模型返回空串时不发任何东西。它可能通过别的通道回了，也可能判断这条不需要回；**编一句填充话比沉默更糟**，因为那句话是凭空造出来的。

反过来，agent 抛异常时**要**说一句「我这边出了点问题，等一下再说。」——静默是错的答案，但每次失败只说一次，不是每次重试说一次。

### 一个会话串行，不同会话并行

同一个 agent 上并发两轮，等于同一个上下文窗口里两段对话交错：模型在回答第二句时已经读到自己还没写完的第一句。所以每条会话一条 Promise 链。

不同会话之间不互相等：一个人慢不该让另一个人等。

## 结构

```
lib/
  types.js    JSDoc 契约：QqBackend / QqEvent / QqTarget。没有运行时代码
  text.js     OneBot 消息段 ↔ 纯文本；CQ 码转义；长文本分段
  policy.js   三个决策：这条该不该唤醒、是不是重复、是不是太频繁
  onebot.js   OneBot 11 正向 WebSocket 客户端（可测试：WebSocketImpl 可注入）
  switchboard.js  一个号可以有多条传输；切换是先连后断
  bridge.js   编排：收到 → 投递 → 回答 → 限速 → 分段 → 送出
  host.js     会话 ↔ DSH session：create 还是 resume、怎么成一条 user 消息、哪段算回答
  tools.js    三个工具，以及为什么只有三个
  roster.js   会话名单落盘，让重启后还能主动说话
  index.js    Config + apply：把上面几块接起来；`/qq` 命令也在这里
test/
  *.mjs       断言套件，`npm test` 全跑
  e2e-agent.mjs   真 agent + 真 socket + 假 QQ（要真 key，手动跑）
```

数据流：

```
                                             ┌─ onebot A ─┐
OneBot 后端 ──WS──▶ onebot.js ──QqEvent──▶ switchboard ───▶ bridge.js
                                             └─ onebot B ─┘   │
                                                     （只有一个连着）policy.admit（群模式/白名单/去重/回声）
                                                                 │
                                                             enqueue（每会话串行）
                                                                 │
                                                       host.handle ──▶ DSH session（一轮）
                                                                 │
                                                        回答文本 ◀──┘
                                                                 │
                                                      cleanOutbound → 限速 → 分段
                                                                 │
                                  OneBot 后端 ◀──WS── send_private_msg / send_group_msg
```

`bridge.js` 里没有一次 `import` 到 Cordis 或 OneBot。这不是为了好看：**每个决策都要能在没有模型、没有 socket、没有 profile 的情况下断言**，否则它只能在线上学。

## 安装

桥是一个 DSH bundle。在一个 profile 里装它：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = 'D:\A\DSH-L\agent\home'
node D:\A\DSH-L\agent\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js plugin --profile b add D:\A\DSH-L\projects\dsh-qq-bridge
```

然后在 `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 里给那一行配参数：

```yaml
- id: qq-bridge
  name: dsh-qq-bridge
  config:
    endpoint: ws://127.0.0.1:3001
    groupMode: mention
    preset: companion        # 用哪个 agent 预设（人设、记忆）
```

后端那边（NapCat）需要开「WebSocket 服务器」，端口对上即可。桥是**正向连接**（主动连后端），所以不用给桥开端口、不用配入站鉴权回调、桥可以随时重启。

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关掉就只保留配置，不连 |
| `endpoint` | `ws://127.0.0.1:3001` | OneBot 11 正向 WS 地址 |
| `accessToken` | `''` | 需要时作为 `Authorization: Bearer` 发出 |
| `backend` | `onebot` | 开机先连哪个传输；可填 `backends` 里声明的任一 id |
| `backends` | `{}` | 额外传输，`{ id: { endpoint, accessToken } }`。声明了就能用 `/qq backend <id>` 切过去 |
| `sessionNamespace` | `onebot` | 会话 id 的前缀。**刻意不是当前传输的名字**，改它等于把所有会话改名、把所有人变成初次见面 |
| `groupMode` | `mention` | `always` / `mention` / `off` |
| `allowedGroups` | `[]` | 群白名单；空表示所有群按 `groupMode` 处理 |
| `preset` | `''` | 每个会话用哪个 agent 预设；空用 profile 默认 |
| `provider` / `model` | `''` | 模型路由；空用 profile 当前的默认模型 |
| `workspace` | `''` | 新会话记录的 cwd；空用进程 cwd |
| `language` | `zh` | 信封和工具描述的语言 |
| `minimumGapMs` | `1200` | 同一个会话两次发送的最小间隔 |
| `maxChars` | `1200` | 单条上限，超过在句末切开 |
| `ignoreAutoReply` | `true` | 丢掉对方 QQ 的 `[自动回复]` ，不让它唤醒 agent |
| `dailyProactive` | `0` | 每天允许主动发几条；`0` 是禁止主动 |
| `maxLiveAgents` | `8` | 内存里保留几个热 agent，超出淘汰最久未用的 |
| `rosterPath` | `''` | 会话名单文件；空用 `$DSH_HOME/qq-bridge/conversations.json` |
| `ownerIds` | `[]` | 谁是主人。名单里的号私聊才算主人在说话；空 = 退回旧假设（私聊即主人） |

`dailyProactive` 默认 `0` 是有意的。**主动说话是这个插件唯一由模型发起、而不是由人发起的路径**，所以它默认关着，打开要运维按天给额度。

`ownerIds` 是补上来的，起因是一个真 bug。桥原本用 `own: !group` 判断「这是主人在说话」——**私聊证明的是房间里只有两个人，不是其中一个是主人**。公开账号上任何人都能私聊这个号，所以第一个找上门的陌生人就被当成了主人：B 用主人的昵称称呼他，把主人的私事说给他听，而记忆插件把他说的话记成了主人的自述，连名字都被覆盖了。`own` 现在由这个名单回答，名单为空时保留旧行为，让没有声明过自己的部署不至于突然不认人。**它必须和 dsh-hippo 的 `ownerIds` 一致**：桥用它写消息的 `own` 标志，记忆用它决定一条事实归谁，两边不一致时，桥认为的陌生人在记忆里是主人。


### 换传输不换会话

一个 QQ 号可以被不止一条路摸到：本机的 NapCat、另一台机器上的 LLBot、协议路线不通时换一个端口重启。所以传输是可替换的，而**换的时候进程不重启**——重启还会顺带丢掉每一个热会话和每一轮没说完的话。

```
/qq status              # 现在连的是谁，通不通
/qq backend llbot        # 先连新的，连上了再断旧的
```

三条设计上的取舍：

- **会话 id 跟号走，不跟传输走。** `sessionNamespace` 而不是当前传输的名字进到每一个会话 id 里。否则切一次传输，所有会话改名，每个人都要重新见一次面。
- **先连后断。** 切换失败时留在旧传输上，而不是两边都没有。失败会在回复里说明原因，不谎报成功。
- **只给人用，不给模型用。** 切换没有做成工具：一个被陌生人唤醒的 agent 不该能改变自己被找到的方式，否则一次提示注入就能让整个号停在一个不工作的传输上。

## 一些不那么显然的决定

**回声也要拦。** 后端会按自己的账号 id 过滤掉机器人自己发的消息，但那依赖 `get_login_info` 的往返；在连上但还没拿到 id 的那一小段时间里，id 是空的，只看 id 的过滤会把机器人自己的消息当成入站。所以桥另外记住自己发过的文本，见到原样回来就丢。

**长回答按语义切，不按字数切。** 在 `。！？；…，、` 和换行里从后往前找断点；找不到才硬切，且不劈开代理对。拼回去必须等于原文——这条有测试，因为「切消息」这种功能坏起来是丢字，而丢字看起来像模型说话不利索。

**图片不静默丢。** `[CQ:image,...]` 变成 `[图片]`。让模型知道「对方发了张图」比让它以为对方什么都没说更有用。`reply` 引用段直接丢，引用不是内容。

**非文本段不发明。** 不认识的段不输出任何东西。给不认识的段造占位符是往上下文里塞噪音。

**`qq_send` 找不到目标时返回失败，不返回成功。** 一个工具为了「看起来正常」而报告发出去了，是最坏的答案：agent 随后会相信那个人被告知了。

**会话名单是薄的。** 只有 key / kind / id / name，没有消息文本。一份会长出内容的名单会变成另一份必须和会话日志保持一致的东西。

**信封里说「谁」，`source` 里也要说一次。** 文本信封写了 `ㅤ不想（1405337008）：…`，模型读得到，但**记忆插件读不懂**——它只看见一串文本，分不清「主人在说自己的事」和「群友在说群友的事」，于是把后者记成前者的。所以每条注入的消息额外带 `source.speaker = { id, name, kind, own, group? }`。`kind` 必须留在 `'user'`：DSH 会按 message source 的 kind 分流（压缩策略、导出器都认这个键），树外的 kind 会静默掉出全部处理，而 `assertV4MessageSources` 只校验非空且不是 `'plugin'`，其余字段原样保留。（[dsh-hippo](https://github.com/Dx3906-xn/dsh-hippo) 就是按这个字段分主语和场合的。）


**`session/event` 不用。** 会话日志里的消息必须带 id，DSH 在校验时拒收**整个会话**。所以合成消息一律走 `createUserMessage()`，`source.kind` 用标准的 `'user'`——记忆插件、转录导出、压缩策略都按 kind 分流，树外的 kind 会静默掉出全部。

**自动回复不当人话。** 对方 QQ 开着「不在」自动回复时，那句 `[自动回复]你好，我现在有事不在…` 会作为一条真实消息到达。第一次真机联调就撞上了：桥认真回了一句「那我不吵你了」。它不只是多花一次模型调用——agent 有记忆，会把这句话当成对方关于自己的陈述存下来。所以 `admit()` 在开头按 `[自动回复]` 前缀丢掉它（`ignoreAutoReply: false` 可关掉这个过滤）。**只认前缀不认措辞**：`自动回复` 也可以是句子里一个普通词。

## 开发

```powershell
cd D:\A\DSH-L\projects\dsh-qq-bridge
npm test                     # 8 个断言套件，不需要 key、不需要号
node test\e2e-agent.mjs      # 真 agent + 真 socket + 假 QQ，会烧 token
```

`npm test` 跑的是 `test/run-suites.mjs`，它把跳过清单写在仓库里并**印出来**：一份只活在别人 shell 历史里的跳过清单会自己长大，直到套件因为没跑而全绿。

两类文件：

- **断言套件**（`text/policy/bridge/onebot/socket/tools/roster/host/switchboard/command.mjs`）：不需要参数，必须全绿。
- **仪器**（`e2e-agent.mjs` 以及假后端 `fake-onebot*.mjs` / `ws-server.mjs` / `helpers.mjs`）：需要参数或真部署，不参与 `npm test`。
- **真机排查脚本**（`tools/`）：需要一个活着的后端，全部只读或只做一次显式动作。

`tools/` 里的六个，按问题选：

| 脚本 | 回答什么问题 |
|---|---|
| `whoami.mjs` | 现在到底有没有登录、以谁的身份。3001 在监听只说明 OneBot 服务起了，不说明后面有账号 |
| `list-groups.mjs` | 这个号在哪些群里、群号是多少、有哪些好友 |
| `watch-events.mjs` | 后端**实际**推来了什么：原始 segment、`at` 数组、`self_id` |
| `group-history.mjs` | 群历史的存储形态：某条消息到底有没有 `at` 段 |
| `send-group.mjs` | 往群里发一条（验证 `send_group_msg` 与回声过滤） |
| `watch-group.mjs` | 那条群消息**有没有唤起一轮**：看会话目录是否长出新文件 |

`whoami.mjs` 是第一件该跑的东西：账号被踢之后 NapCat 会留在二维码模式，「桥在重连」和「号掉线了」在日志里都只是 `socket error`，只有问后端本身能分辨。

`watch-events.mjs` 与 `group-history.mjs` 存在的理由值得单独说：**「它到底有没有 @ 我」这个问题不能从会话文本回答**。`admit()` 会把合成的 `@你` 剥掉，所以被 @ 和被手打 `@LD` 的消息在 agent 眼里长得可能一样。只有原始段能分辨。

`watch-group.mjs` 解决另一半：**忽略是静默的**，所以「桥没回」和「桥没收到」在日志里一样安静。它盯着会话目录——桥只在真的把消息交给 agent 时才建会话，因此新文件出现就是「这条唤起了」的诚实信号。

`e2e-agent.mjs` 会自己搭一个一次性 `DSH_HOME`（默认 `<系统临时目录>/dsh-qq-bridge-e2e`）并往里放一个 profile，然后用假 OneBot 服务端驱动：连上、私聊两轮（第二轮必须记得第一轮说的话）、群里不被 @ 时不回、被 @ 时回在该群。它断言的是**库里的行和 socket 上的字节**，不是 agent 说了什么好听的话。

两个跑 e2e 时真踩过的坑：

**不要复制一个活的 DSH home。** `Copy-Item -Recurse` 会顺着 profile 里 `node_modules` 的 junction 展开成几百 MB，而且**筛的是复制那一刻的代码**——改了仓库却没生效，现象是「新功能没起作用」，方向完全指错。所以 e2e 用代码建 home，`node_modules/dsh-qq-bridge` 是指回仓库的 junction。

**这个 home 不能放在仓库里面。** 它的 profile 有一条指回仓库的 junction，于是仓库会通过 `<home>/profiles/qq/node_modules/dsh-qq-bridge` 再出现一次；下一次 `rmSync` + 重建就从「仓库包含 home」变成「仓库包含包含仓库的 home」，一层层套下去直到 Windows 拒绝路径长度。所以默认位置是系统临时目录，传一个仓内路径会被拒绝并说明原因。

删这种带 junction 的目录时，**先 `cmd /c rmdir` 拆掉 junction 再 `Remove-Item -Recurse`**——PowerShell 5.1 会顺着 junction 递归删掉仓库本体。

- **群聊三档都在真群验过**（群 1070071261）：`mention` 下不 @ 不回、选中 @ 后回在群里且 `@你` 被剥掉、手打 `@LD` 不算 @；`always` 下无 @ 也回；`off` 下连 @ 都不回

还没做：

- **只有 OneBot 这一个协议。** `backends` 切的是同一个协议的几条路（不同的 NapCat、不同机器、不同端口），不是不同的协议。`gui-auto`（GUI 自动化）后端能绕开协议 hook 的风控面，但实现量大，`QqBackend` 接口是给它留的位置。
- **只发文本。** 图片、文件、语音需要先想清楚「模型能不能决定把本地文件发出去」——那是比「它能发一句话」大得多的权限。
- **不管登录。** 桥不启动 NapCat，也不管它的登录态；后端掉线时桥只负责重连。
- **微信没有。** 微信生态是另一套（iLink 长轮询、无法主动推送、不支持群），需要单独一个插件而不是这个插件多一个后端。
- **`relationship` 级别的社交图谱。** 群是一个会话，所以 agent 在群里分不清「谁跟谁熟」；需要的话得在记忆层做，不是这一层。
- **没有协议端的撤回/编辑。** 说错了只能再说一句。

# DSH Archive Manager **Safely manage archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness** [Русский](README.ru.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) [![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40michengai%2Fdsh-archive-manager.svg?label=npm%20package)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@michengai/dsh-archive-manager) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/%40michengai%2Fdsh-archive-manager.svg?label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@michengai/dsh-archive-manager) [![DSH Web Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Web-Plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager) [![DSH supported through 0.2.1-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-up%20to%200.2.1--rc.2-2563eb.svg)](#prerequisites)
> DSH Archive Manager is a community-maintained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin, not an official DeepSeek AI product. ## What you can do Put inactive conversations away and find them again when needed, keeping everyday task lists tidy. - **Archive conversations**: put away one chat or all unarchived chats in a workspace. - **Find past work**: search titles and content, combine project/favorites/date filters, and sort by time, title, or turns. - **Restore tasks**: restore one chat, selected chats, or a project group; select all filtered results for bulk actions. - **Clean up records**: permanently delete unwanted archives after confirmation, track batch progress, and retry remaining items. - **Organize important chats**: save favorites and preview idle cleanup while protecting favorites and active work. - **Inspect and troubleshoot**: preview without restoring, copy IDs/paths, diagnose errors, and repair supported legacy logs. > This README describes 1.0.0. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for the complete feature list and upgrade boundaries. ## Session diagnosis and repair The archive page collects read failures, including archived IDs with missing summaries. Expand **Diagnosis and repair**, choose **Diagnose session**, then **Confirm repair** only when eligible. Repair converts supported legacy sources, including automation and early hint sources, while retaining the original log and conversation text. Sessions must be archived and closed in every DSH process. Missing files, permission failures, and unsupported corruption are reported; messages are never truncated or deleted to force recovery. Eligibility is verified from artifacts and the host format, not solely from error wording. ## Search and preview - Archived and Unarchived share title/content search, project, favorites, updated-date filters, and creation-time sorting. Star or unstar conversations on either tab. - Choose **Titles and content** to search user and assistant text; the default remains titles only. Date filters include the entire local end date and combine with project and favorites. - Matches show snippets and highlights. On Archived, click a snippet or **More → Quick preview** to inspect context without restoring. On Unarchived, a snippet opens the full conversation. - Preview renders Markdown tables, quotes, and code blocks with role labels; switch to source text for highlights. It shows up to eight recent messages, or context around the first match. Each message is limited to 2,000 UTF-16 code units without splitting Unicode characters. - Search accepts up to 200 query characters and reads batches of at most 20 sessions, sequentially within each batch. Tools, attachments, reasoning, system messages, and plugin injections are excluded. Read failures remain visible and can be retried. Stored text is not the model's current context. - There is no persistent full-text index. Large or long conversations can be slow; narrow project, dates, or favorites first. No session-count or latency guarantee has been established. Changing filters prevents later batches and stale results, but cannot interrupt the batch already reading. ## Turn counts and location - Both tabs show user submission counts, including image submissions; assistant replies, tool calls, and injected messages do not count as turns. - Sort by most or fewest turns; unknown counts remain last. Failed details can be retried. - **More** provides separate ID/path copying. Official JSONL storage returns the session directory; other backends use a valid host-provided path. Clipboard operations require browser permission and HTTPS or localhost; failures are reported. - Details are read in batches of up to 20 without activating or restoring sessions. Counts include inherited user messages, have no persistent index, and may take time for long logs. ## Screenshots Search, favorite, preview, restore, and clean up in **Settings → Archived sessions → Archived**: ![Archived: shared search filters, favorites, and restore](assets/screenshots/archived-sessions.webp) Switch to **Unarchived** for the same filters, idle cleanup previews, and project-wide archiving: ![Unarchived: idle cleanup and project archiving](assets/screenshots/unarchived-sessions.webp) > Screenshots show the pre-release development build labeled 0.1.44; this release is 1.0.0. The sidebar belongs to the installed UI plugin and does not represent new sidebar features in this release. ## Prerequisites - A working [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web installation with `dsh` available in your terminal. - Supported DSH versions: `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.1`, and `0.2.1-rc.2`. Intermediate `0.2.1-alpha.*` releases and earlier hosts are rejected by the version gate and this plugin will not run. Existing archives and favorites are kept. Install `1.0.20` if you still use a `0.1.x` host. - Node.js matching `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. Source installation also requires pnpm. ## Installation Examples use the `web` profile. Replace it with the profile you actually use. ### Ask an agent to install it Send this prompt to an agent that can run terminal commands on your computer: ```text Install the latest @michengai/dsh-archive-manager into my local DSH web profile using the official npm registry. Check the plugin configuration afterward, then explain how to reload DSH and open archived session management. ``` ### Install manually Run in PowerShell: ```powershell [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 dsh plugin --profile web add @michengai/dsh-archive-manager@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ ``` Restart DSH Web, then hard-refresh your browser with `Ctrl+Shift+R`. Open **Settings → Archived sessions** to get started. ## Usage | Goal | Action | | --- | --- | | Archive one chat | Open its sidebar menu and choose **Archive session** | | Archive a workspace | Open the workspace menu and choose the option to archive its chats | | Find an archive | Open **Settings → Archived sessions**, then choose title/content search or filter by project, favorites, and dates | | Change the order | Sort by update time, creation time, title, or most/fewest turns | | Restore one chat | Click the restore icon, or choose **More → Restore and open** | | Archive a project or ungrouped chats | On **Unarchived**, open the group’s **…** menu and confirm archiving all chats in that group, regardless of search filters | | Favorite a chat | Click its right-side star; use the favorites dropdown to filter | | Preview archived content | Click a match snippet or **More → Quick preview** | | Clean up idle chats | On Unarchived, set idle days, preview candidates, and confirm | | Locate a session | Copy its ID or path from More | | Handle read errors | Expand diagnosis, diagnose first, and confirm repair when eligible | | Archive across projects | Switch to **Unarchived**, select sessions across projects, then click **Archive** and confirm | | Restore or delete in bulk | Select chats and use the bulk actions, or use the project menu; there are no separate Restore all / Delete all buttons | The page opens on **Archived**, with **Unarchived** on the right. Switching tabs clears selections; changing search or project filters preserves them. Check the hidden selection count before applying bulk actions, or clear your selection first. **Select all filtered results** selects matching sessions, including collapsed groups. Project-wide actions still apply to the whole project regardless of search filters. Unarchived excludes subagents and blank placeholders. Settings and sidebar batch archive/restore call the official single-session APIs `ctx.workspaces.archiveSession` and `ctx.workspaces.unarchiveSession` serially. ### Favorites and idle cleanup Compact project groups can be collapsed. Stars and restore/archive icons appear on the right; archived session menus include restore-and-open and deletion. - Use the star on either tab and the **Favorites only** dropdown to find important chats. Favorites persist on the host across archive, restore, and browser changes. Reopen management to see changes made in other pages. Unknown or unreadable sessions retain their stored favorite IDs; cleanup requires confirmed artifact absence. - On Unarchived, enter 1–36,500 whole idle days and preview candidates under the current filters. Deselect individual candidates before confirmation. Favorites, the current chat, running sessions (including subagents), and pending interactions are protected; sessions without a valid activity time are excluded. - Archive rechecks favorites and activity. Batch archive, restore, and delete report successful, skipped, failed, and remaining items; the first failure stops the batch. Retry only the remainder. Delete retries still require confirmation. - **Undo this archive** restores sessions archived by the current batch, including successful retries. It is available only while the current management page remains open; refreshing or closing clears it. Permanent deletion cannot be undone. - Favorites can still be archived manually. Protection applies to idle cleanup only. There is no scheduled or automatic background cleanup. ### View and continue archived conversations Native conversation navigation has been available since `0.1.40`; 1.0.0 uses these entry points: - **Click the session title**: open the native DSH session to view messages, attachments, and tool details. Continue chatting while keeping the session archived. - **More → Restore and open**: unarchive the session and open it to resume work. ## Search API compatibility (integrators) The canonical API is `workspaceRegistry.searchSessionContent({ sessionIds, query })`, covering archived and unarchived sessions. Supply 1–20 session IDs and a nonempty query of 1–200 characters; IDs are deduplicated. Results have the shape `{ items: [{ sessionId, seq, snippet }], failures: [{ sessionId, message }] }`. Individual read failures appear in `failures`; invalid input rejects the call. `searchArchivedContent` remains the legacy, archived-only entry point. Both use the existing host Typert connection and authorization boundary; no HTTP endpoint or authentication setting is added. Keep the legacy descriptor throughout the currently supported host range, including patch releases. Removal requires an explicit compatibility-range change, client migration, and deprecation notice. New clients prefer the canonical API and use the old one only as a version fallback, never dispatching the same search to both. ## Updates Click **Check for updates** in the archive management page header. DSH CLI or Desktop environments with automatic update support can update directly; other environments provide a manual command for the current profile. You can also rerun the installation command above. ## FAQ ### Why is the entry missing after installation? Restart DSH Web and hard-refresh your browser. Make sure you installed into the profile you are using. If the entry is still missing, run: ```powershell [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 dsh --profile web --dump-config ``` The configuration should include `ui-workspace-archive-manager` and must not disable official `workspace` or `session-projection-cache`. A leftover `archive-manager-host` override can be removed. On current DSH hosts the official `ui-settings-unarchive-sessions` entry is gone, so this plugin no longer disables it (doing so only warned that the patch entry was missing). If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` still disables `workspace`, `session-projection-cache`, or `ui-workspace`, remove those overrides and restart. ### How is archiving different from deletion? Archiving puts a conversation away so you can restore it later. **Permanent deletion cannot be undone** and may also remove that session's attachments. It does not delete your project working directory. Deletion requires confirmation. ### Can I use it with Codex UI? Yes. [Codex UI](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) keeps its sidebar appearance and interactions. Archive management remains available in **Settings → Archived sessions**. For other problems, open an [issue](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager/issues) with your DSH and plugin versions, reproduction steps, and error details. ## Install from source
Expand for development or testing unreleased changes Run these commands in a directory of your choice. For local changes that have not been pushed, use the existing working copy. ```powershell [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 git clone https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager.git Set-Location .\dsh-archive-manager pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` Restart DSH Web and hard-refresh your browser afterward. Source code in [src](src) uses strict TypeScript. Both GitHub and npm include a ready-to-run `lib`. After changing source, run `pnpm build` before committing, or a source install keeps the previous runtime. Published JavaScript entry points and runtime modules remain unchanged; installing the npm package does not require TypeScript. Run `pnpm typecheck` for type checking, `pnpm test` to validate changes, or `pnpm verify` for the full checks.
## DSH product ecosystem For a desktop workbench, download [DSH Codex Desktop](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-desktop/releases). Existing [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) installations can add plugins as needed by following each project's README. Below are 11 first-party plugins; consult the corresponding desktop release notes and bundled catalog for what that version includes. | Plugin | What you can do | | --- | --- | | [Codex UI](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) | Organize projects and conversations, search tasks, and navigate chat turns | | [Agency Agents](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-agency-agents) | Choose and summon specialists for your task | | [Skills Manager](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager) | Find, enable, create, and import local skills | | [Archive Manager](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager) | Search, restore, or clean up archived conversations | | [IM Connect](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-im-connect) | Send tasks and receive replies through messaging platforms | | [Automation](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-automation) | Schedule tasks and review each run | | [BTW](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-btw) | Ask side questions without interrupting the main task | | [Simplify](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-simplify) | Use `/simplify` to improve code within your Git changes | | [PUA](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-pua) | Guide the Agent to try new approaches after failures, investigate causes, and verify results before completion | | [Code Review](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-code-review) | Use `/review` to request an independent Agent code review and receive the report in the current conversation | | [Codex 2.0](LICENSE). # DSH Android 手机端工程 > 基于 **《DSH 手机端 · 最终设计文档 v4.0》**（2026-10-17）落地实现的完整 DeepSeek Harness 手机端客户端。 --- ## 核心设计决策 (v4.0 基线) 1. **Host 运行在手机本地 Linux 用户空间**：基于 Compact Debian slim (glibc) + proot/bxroot + Node 24 + 真实 DSH，插件与 Agent 无需任何改动。 2. **核心 UI 原生化（Compose + Material 3）**：会话、聊天消息流、审批、设置、文件均由纯原生 Compose 承载；WebView 仅用于运行插件与重型组件（Web 岛）。 3. **真实文件系统接入（工作区 = 手机目录）**：默认工作区直绑手机公有共享文件夹（`/storage/emulated/0/Documents/DSH-Workspace`），在 Linux 容器内挂载为 `/workspace`，系统自带文件管理器直接可见，产物无需导出。 4. **内置 Surface 适配层（无伴生插件）**：将 `native-surface.js` 补丁内建于前端，自动拦截并调度 `conversation.composer.dock`、`shell.overlay`、`settings.*` 等全部 26 个核心 Slot，保障第三方插件生态 100% 正常运行。 5. **SDUI 声明式渲染器**：支持未来插件以 JSON 声明移动端布局（`dsh.mobile`），手机端以零 WebView 的原生组件树进行高性能渲染。 6. **多主机支持**：支持本地 Linux 用户空间 Host 与远程私有网关 Host 混合管理与无缝切换。 --- ## 模块拓扑与工程结构 ``` ├── app/ # 主入口：MainActivity (Compose), DshApplication, 资产与资源 ├── core/ │ ├── model/ # 核心领域模型 (HostDescriptor, DshSlotRegistry, ChatMessage, SessionInfo) │ ├── protocol/ # RPC 协议层 (ConnectionStateMachine, HostAuthenticator, RemoteClient) │ ├── bridge/ # Host 兼容层客户端 (BridgeClient, BridgeRegistry, BridgePluginCatalog) │ ├── network/ # OkHttp 底座与拦截器 │ ├── data/ # Room 2.7 本地只读缓存数据库 (6 张持久化表与 DAO) │ ├── designsystem/ # Material 3 设计系统调色板 (DshTheme, DeepSeek Blue) │ └── ui/ # 原子可复用 Compose 状态组件 ├── feature/ │ ├── chat/ # 现代消息流、思考折叠面板、悬浮药丸输入框、ComposerDockBar Pills │ ├── sessions/ # 现代化侧滑抽屉 (ModernNavigationDrawerContent) 与会话管理 │ ├── files/ # 真实工作区解析器 (WorkspaceManager) 与原生文件浏览器 │ ├── hosts/ # 多主机管理 (HostsScreen) 与扫码配对器 (RemotePairingManager) │ ├── approval/ # 系统与高危操作审批中心 (ApprovalScreen, Pending->Approve 状态机) │ ├── settings/ # 偏好与系统设置 (SettingsScreen, 容器休眠、安全、备份导出) │ └── runtime/ # 本地 Linux 容器生命周期管控界面 ├── plugin/ │ ├── runtime-web/ # 安全加固的 Web 岛容器 (WebIslandContainer, 独立进程沙箱) │ ├── surface/ # 内置 Surface 适配层 (SurfaceCatalogStore, SurfaceSheet, PluginOverlayContainer) │ └── mobile-ui/ # SDUI 声明式原生渲染器 (SduiPageRenderer, SduiValidator 预算门禁) ├── runtime/ │ ├── host/ # 本地运行管理器 (DefaultHostRuntimeManager, ProotCommandBuilder, RootfsInstaller) │ └── bridge/ # 设备能力桥 (BridgeServer 127.0.0.1 JSON-RPC 2.0, NativeScheduler) ├── tooling/ │ ├── codegen/ # Remote 描述符到 Kotlin 代码生成器 │ ├── contract/ # 会话流量与契约回放器 (ContractReplayer) │ └── frontend-patch/ # 前端补丁自动化注入器 (FrontendPatcher) ├── fixtures/ # 脱敏契约回放夹具 ``` --- ## 构建与测试验证 ### 编译调试安装包 (Debug APK) ```bash ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug ``` 产物位置：`app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk` ### 运行全量单元测试与工具链测试 ```bash ./gradlew test ``` 覆盖模块： - `:core:protocol`（连接状态机 Generation 丢弃、独立 CookieJar 隔离） - `:core:bridge`（bridge/v1 协商、查询解码、provider 缺失降级、插件目录归一） - `:runtime:host`（Proot 命令组装、输出流端口解析、SHA-256 镜像校验、脱敏备份导出） - `:runtime:bridge`（本地 JSON-RPC 方法分发与未知方法拦截） - `:plugin:surface`（26 个 Slot 到原生 Sheet / 浮层的放置决策） - `:plugin:mobile-ui`（SDUI 深度、节点数与体积门禁校验） - `:feature:files`（真实公有工作区目录创建与遍历） - `:feature:hosts`（二维码扫码 Payload 解析与过期检测） - `:tooling:contract`（契约代码生成、HTML 补丁自动化注入、夹具校验） --- ## 首次启动引导（Onboarding） 首次安装启动时展示与桌面端一致的 4 步引导，完成（或跳过）后写入 `dsh_onboarding` SharedPreferences，之后启动直接进入对话流： 1. **欢迎使用**：介绍文案 + 产品截图（浅色/深色、中/英四套资源），主按钮「开始设置」； 2. **准备可用额度**：按余额判断展示「继续 + 去充值」或「去充值 + 下一步」， 跳过时弹出「暂时跳过充值？」确认； 3. **你希望 DeepSeek Harness 帮你做什么？**：办公与创作 / 代码与开发两张可选卡片 （选中后替换为对应文件类型图标组并显示流光渐变描边），仅选办公与创作时直接完成； 4. **你希望看到多少工作过程？**：聚焦结果 / 关键细节 / 完整过程三张单选卡片， 选中后「进入应用」完成引导。 文案、图标与流转逻辑逐字对齐 `ui-settings-account` 的 `DesktopOnboarding`，仅将 桌面横向布局适配为手机纵向布局（单列卡片、全宽按钮、安全区留白、内容可滚动并垂直居中）。 完成后的选择会写回设置：工作步骤展示（`transcriptView`）与「显示代码工作视图」。 --- ## 弹层与菜单（面板系统） 所有下拉菜单、上下文菜单、底部面板与确认对话框统一使用 `core:designsystem` 的面板基元 （`DshPanels.kt` + `DshPanelTokens.kt`），数值直接对齐 Web 客户端的 `ui-primitives`（`Menu.module.css` / `MenuSurface.module.css` / `Modal.module.css`）与 `ui-theme` 设计令牌： - **菜单卡片**：16dp 圆角（紧凑 12dp）、4dp 内边距、最小 144dp / 最大 360dp 宽、 `menuSurfaceFill` 材质、0.5dp `border-l1` 描边、柔和阴影； - **菜单行**：34dp 最小高度、8dp/6dp 内边距、12dp 圆角、6dp 图标间距、13sp/20 行文字、 14dp 图标、14dp 尾部对勾、11sp/16 分组标题、0.5dp 分隔线； - **确认对话框**：`Modal` 规格——28dp 圆角、`min(380dp, 屏宽-48dp)`、 22/14/12/24 头部内边距、16sp/24 Medium 标题、28dp 关闭位 + 14dp 图标、 14sp/22 描述、20dp 内容间距、右对齐 8dp 间距底部按钮、24dp 底部留白； - **风险确认**：18dp 警告图标 + 16dp 方形勾选框，取消按钮最小 72dp、主按钮最小 136dp 且 勾选后才可用；**权限菜单**的 EXP 标记为 8sp/10 Medium 上标，行内图标 14dp； **模型菜单**最小 240dp、导航行 13sp/20、12dp 右箭头； - **输入栏触发器**：模型 / 权限药丸按 trigger——28dp 高、8dp 圆角、左 8dp 右 4dp 内距、 4dp 间距、13sp/20 二级色（权限 500 / 模型 400）、推理等级 13sp/20 caption 色、 14dp 图标与下箭头，按压仅用 hover 填充、无 Material 涟漪； - **底部面板**：菜单材质 + 16dp 顶部圆角 + 4dp 内缩，内容可滚动； - 深色模式使用暗色令牌（`#2C2C2E` 对话框层、`menuSurfaceFill`、`labelPrimary` 等）。 ### 页面（插件 / 自动化任务 / 任务看板） 三个抽屉入口已接通并统一为页面规格（`app/src/main/kotlin/com/deepseek/dsh/`）： - **插件页**（`PluginsScreen.kt`，对齐 `ui-plugin-manager`）：20/28 500 标题 + 13/20 二级引导语、48dp/40dp 细线图标框卡片、14/20 500 卡片标题、13/18 三级说明、 11.5/16 等宽 slot 说明、sm 按钮；与上游一致，仅呈现「已安装插件」分组， 不提供不存在的「发现 / 插件市场」页签； - **分类与图标来自 Host 兼容层**： 插件页读 `bridge/v1` 的 `client-slots/plugins.item` 注册，分类文案、顺序与 图形全部是官方客户端资源；图形经 `icon-svg` 转成 SVG 后由 `DshSvgIcon`（`core:designsystem`）在 Compose Canvas 上绘制，无 WebView； bridge 不可用时降级到 `package-inventory` 的 Host 原生清单，再不行就是空态 —— 任何情况下都不使用写死的分类表； - 页头为官方刷新按钮 + 拆分式「添加插件」主按钮（右侧 32dp 下拉）：下拉两项为 「安装第三方插件」（打开官方安装 Modal）与「让 Agent 创建插件」； - 点击插件卡片进入官方详情页：面包屑「‹ 插件」、48dp 图标 + 卸载危险描边按钮 + 官方开关、 20/28 标题 + 版本胶囊、等宽包名、一句话说明、「包含的组件」行 （40dp 图标框 + 名称/说明/模块 + 等待依赖状态点 + 开关）、 「来源信息」两行（代码来源 / 当前版本，44dp 行高 + `border-l2` 下划线）； 卸载会从 SurfaceCatalogStore 移除插件并返回列表； - **自动化任务页**（`AutomationTasksScreen.kt`，对齐 `ui-schedule` TaskManagerPage）： 20/28 标题、「已启用 / 已结束」SegmentedTabs、40dp 搜索框、 空态文案与 32dp「新建自动化任务」主按钮（Host 数据接入后可直接渲染任务行）； - **任务看板页**（`TaskBoardScreen.kt`，对齐 Agent Team 只读任务看板）： 20/28 标题、待处理/进行中/已完成分组（8dp 状态点 + 14/22 500 标题 + 12/18 计数）、 0.5dp `border-l2` 任务卡、空态「暂无任务」与只读说明。 插件安装对话框同步使用 Modal + 40dp 输入框 + 整宽 40dp 主按钮。 ### 对话主页（phone 适配后的细节对齐） - **顶栏**：0.5dp `border-l3` 底部分隔线，标题 16sp/24 Medium（完整显示、尾部省略）， 左侧菜单键 36dp `bg-module-platform` 圆钮，右侧图标 18dp 二级色； - **Composer 卡片**：28dp 圆角、`input-major`（浅色白 / 深色 `#2C2C2E`）底、 0.5dp `border-l2` 描边 + soft elevation；输入 14sp/22 一级色，占位符 13sp/20 caption 色； 行内 28dp 圆形加号（`bg-module-platform` + 14dp 图标）、28dp trigger 药丸、 34dp 蓝色发送圆钮，间距 10–12dp、无 Material 涟漪； - **Hero**：56dp 鱼标、标题 26sp/32 Medium、副标题 13sp/20 二级色、 快捷建议胶囊 34dp 高 / R12 / `bg-module-platform` / 13sp-20 二级色。 Android 窗口无法对弹层背后的内容做 backdrop blur，因此菜单/面板把半透明材质 合成到基础层上（等效于材质的扁平化结果）以保证可读性；对话框使用 `bg-mask-1` 遮罩并关闭系统默认 dim。 --- ## 模拟器实机测试 已在 Android 模拟器（`Pixel_10_Pro`, API 35+）完成实机跑通验证： 1. **启动与主界面**：冷启动进入纯净对话流，左侧滑出式抽屉流畅拉起； 2. **输入与 Pills 交互**：药丸输入栏内部集成 `DeepSeek-V3` 模型选择与推理等级切换（快速/深度思考/超强推理），下方横向滚动呈现 `42.5 tok/s` 与 `上下文 12% · 缓存 85%`； 3. **真实文件工作区**：直连 `/storage/emulated/0/Documents/DSH-Workspace`，生成的文本产物系统直接可见； 4. **插件与悬浮窗**：点击「表情包插件」拉起原生 BottomSheet，点击「桌宠与系统状态」进入可拖拽与最小化圆形气泡； 5. **审批中心与设置**：高危工具拦截与二次确认流转顺畅，用户配置与诊断包导出无缝。 --- ## Rootfs 运行时接入 ### 安装链路 `RootfsInstaller` 已实现真实流水线（不再只是打日志）： 1. 读取 `app/src/main/assets/rootfs-manifest.json`（发布流水线写入 `downloadUrl` / `sha256` / `archiveSizeBytes`）； 2. 优先使用 `files/cache/rootfs-local.tar.gz`（无网调试 / `adb push`），否则按 manifest 下载； 3. SHA-256 校验（有下载 / 有 checksum 时）→ tar.gz 安全解包（拒绝 `../` 路径穿越、支持符号链接与可执行位）； 4. 解包到 staging 后原子替换 `files/rootfs`，创建 `opt/dsh`、`root/.dsh`； 5. 写入 `files/runtime/rootfs-installed.json` 安装标记；运行控制页显示进度/错误。 ### 运行控制页 抽屉 →「运行控制」： - 「安装/重置 Rootfs」始终可用，失败原因会显示在页面（如校验失败、manifest 未配置）； - 「启动 DSH 容器」会先检查 `files/rootfs` 与 `jniLibs//libproot.so`，缺失时直接返回可读错误。 ### 发布前需要补齐的产物 1. `rootfs-manifest.json` 写入真实下载地址与 SHA-256； 2. rootfs 归档需以根目录布局打包（包含 `etc/os-release`、`usr/bin/env`、`opt/dsh`）； 3. `libproot.so` 按 `arm64-v8a` / `x86_64` 放入 `app/src/main/jniLibs//`（Android 10+ W^X 要求可执行文件必须来自 APK native 库目录）。 已在模拟器用本地测试归档验证：安装成功、标记落盘；启动按钮会正确提示缺少 `libproot.so`。 ### 首次启动下载 rootfs（当前实现） - Rootfs 现由独立的轻量仓库与 GitHub Actions 统一管理与发布：[`deepseek-harness-mobile-rootfs`](https://github.com/EricFL1998/deepseek-harness-mobile-rootfs)； - APK 不再内置 rootfs（体积保持约 20MB）；`rootfs-manifest.json` 的 `downloadUrls` / `downloadSha256` 按 ABI 配置下载地址与校验值，直接拉取 `deepseek-harness-mobile-rootfs` 自动化发布的 Release 资产； - 启动顺序：**rootfs 准备页 → onboarding → 主界面**，未下载/解压完成前不会进入 onboarding；失败可在准备页重试； - `RootfsInstaller` 支持下载进度、SHA-256 校验、tar.gz 安全解包（含硬链接可执行位恢复）； - proot 使用 16 KB page-size 对齐的 Android NDK 构建（Termux proot 5.1.107 + 独立 loader），放在 `jniLibs/{x86_64,arm64-v8a}/libproot.so`、`libproot-loader.so`，并附带 `libtalloc.so` / `libandroid-shmem.so`；启动时通过 `PROOT_LOADER` + `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=nativeLibraryDir` 加载；已能拉起 Node； - 当前剩余问题：DSH 启动时 profile bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app`）在 proot 内解析失败，容器内同一 rootfs 正常，需继续修该解析路径。
