**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)
[**Open the live product site**](https://omdsh-dev.github.io/dsh-genui/) · [**Watch the real demo**](#watch-the-real-interface) · [**Install in DSH**](#quick-start)
> Give the model's answers a face — the text is still there, and an interactive UI is already live. > > 🔌 Ecosystem: the repo carries the `#dsh` · `#dsh-plugin` topics — welcome to be listed by @dsh-plugin. `dsh-genui` turns a model reply into a **safe, interactive DSH surface**. Ask “how are this month’s orders doing?” and the answer can include a sortable data panel, a native video, a draggable plot, a local quiz, or a persistent session panel — without replacing the surrounding text. ## Start with the evidence | If you want to… | Go straight to… | What you can verify | |---|---|---| | See the complete DSH flow first | [40-second real walkthrough](#40-second-walkthrough) | Components are rendered inside a real DSH conversation. | | Inspect concrete UI outputs | [Three real outputs](#three-real-outputs-inside-a-dsh-reply) | Monitoring, function plots, and composable layout primitives. | | Try it in your own DSH | [Quick start](#quick-start) | A public npm install, a prompt to run, and an activation check. | | Learn the JSON language | [Component syntax](./SKILL.md) | The supported, guarded `dsh-ui` component specification. | ## Watch the real interface > **No concept mockups.** The recording and images in this section are captured from `dsh-genui` rendering in the DSH interface. Use them to see the actual visual language before installing. ### 40-second walkthrough
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5db33ec-7471-4d4a-a85b-79c9962ab4ef


Click the preview to download the original MP4 if the GitHub player is unavailable.

The walkthrough moves from an answer-embedded panel through forms, plotting, Mermaid, and 3D-oriented components. The player does **not** auto-play. If it does not load, use the [original MP4](./assets/demo.mp4); the four-step prompt sequence is documented in [demo-prompts.md](./demo-prompts.md). ### Three real outputs inside a DSH reply #### 1. A monitoring panel is an answer, not a separate dashboard


Real output: eyebrow stat cards, a filterable service table with drill-down rows, grouped totals, and spark/ring/bar cell types live inside the assistant reply.

#### 2. A function plot redraws locally as its parameters change


Real output: `plot` renders curves while parameter sliders update the graph locally — drag to redraw, no round-trip.

#### 3. Layout primitives compose into structured work surfaces


Real output: display typography, eyebrow stat cards, a ring progress, and labeled chapter dividers combine into a hierarchy the model can describe declaratively.

--- ## ⚠️ Read this first: DSH compatibility The browser plugin observes the DSH conversation DOM and mounts GenUI in plugin-owned React roots. It supports DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`, including `0.2.1-rc.2`, with continuous checks against the minimum `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1` and current `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2` releases. Streaming rendering shows each completed component as the model writes it. Fence discovery supports the stock `md-code-block` surface, `.code-block` and `.code-block-small`, plus any element whose banner labels it `dsh-ui` and contains a `
` body.

CI's packed host smoke installs the generated npm tarball in a real DSH host and verifies host startup and rendering. Source-backed fence routing is covered by integration tests; the smoke does not claim to validate a real model response. Real-model E2E requires configured model credentials.

The repository ships the host plugin and built browser bundle. The host still owns **client activation** and must provide the `slots` and `sessions` services. A downloaded `client.js` or a ModuleLoader cache entry proves only that bytes arrived — successful activation prints `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`. If that line is absent, check package/profile identity or host activation; DOM attributes such as `data-streaming` and `data-chat-anchor-key` are optional signals, not installation prerequisites.

---

## ✨ Before vs. after

| Plain answer | With dsh-genui |
|---|---|
| "Revenue this month: ¥128,430, +12.4% MoM — watch the conversion rate." | One line of analysis + three stat cards (revenue / orders / conversion), a trend chart, and a progress bar rendered right beside it |
| Want to see more? Type another question. | The panel already has "Refresh" / "Switch view" buttons — click, and the model updates the data |

## 🚀 Quick start

Prerequisites — all required:

1. **dsh `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`** (verified host roles: minimum `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`, current `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`)
2. **`pnpm` on your PATH**: the `dsh plugin` command depends on it. If missing: `corepack enable` (or `npm i -g pnpm`), then **open a new terminal** and confirm `pnpm -v` prints a version

Install and activate in DSH (one command, all dependencies included):

```sh
# Public npm package (works without an npm account)
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
```

To add it only as a Node dependency in an existing project:

```sh
npm install @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
```

> `npm install` only adds the dependency; it does not register the plugin with DSH. Use `dsh plugin add` above when installing it into DSH.

> ⚠️ **Don't use `link:` on a freshly cloned directory** — `link:` does not install the plugin's dependencies (mermaid / three / react), so the renderer will break. Use the npm command above for normal installation; reserve `link:` for local development iteration (see below).

### Package name and version matter

- **The scope matters**: npm also hosts a same-named, unscoped [`dsh-genui`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-genui) (a Vue/OpenTiny implementation by a different maintainer, unrelated to this repo). If an install listing describes "interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps", that is the other project — the host will reject it over incompatible peers. This plugin is always **`@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`**.
- **When the host rejects the install**: the supported host range is declared in peerDependencies and enforced by the host — upgrade to the `latest` plugin version on npm and reinstall; no other config changes are needed.
- **When the resolved version is older than `latest`**: this is usually pnpm's release-age policy (versions published within the last 24 hours are silently skipped). Wait a day and retry, or add the target version to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; if the profile exact-pins an old version, update the declaration first, then reinstall.

### Migrating from the old `@omdsh-dev` package name

If you installed from `github:omdsh-dev/dsh-genui` before v0.9.2, pnpm may keep the dependency under the old `@omdsh-dev/dsh-genui` key even though the repository now declares `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`. The loader resolves plugins from the profile's dependency keys, so a later reinstall can then fail with `Cannot find package '@changfenhuang/dsh-genui'`. Re-add the plugin under its current package name:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
```

This migration is required once for old GitHub-spec installs. New installs should use the npm command above and will use the current dependency key.

### Verify the install in 60 seconds

After the command completes, restart dsh web and hard-refresh the browser. In a **new** session, say:

```text
Use dsh-ui to draw a stats dashboard with a sortable service table.
```

You should see the reply turn into an in-place dashboard rather than a code block. To check activation, open the browser console and look for `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`.

### Developer iteration (link mode)

```sh
cd dsh-genui
pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
```

## 🧩 Capability map

| Surface | First thing to try | Observable behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Data | Ask for an order or service dashboard | `stat`, `table`, `chart`, and `progress` appear inside the reply; supported numeric table values sort numerically. |
| Media | Ask for an audio or video reference | Browser-reachable media plays inline, with poster/aspect-ratio and failure states. |
| Exploration | Ask for `plot` with a parameter | Dragging sliders redraws the curve locally and immediately. |
| Feedback | Ask for a short quiz | The UI grades and explains locally; only the next model step needs an `action`. |
| Workspace | Ask for `/panel` or `panel: true` | A persistent, resizable session dock is updated in place. |

The following is the detailed capability reference. Every behavior is constrained by the whitelisted `dsh-ui` specification; see [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for the JSON syntax.

- **Answer-as-UI**: components are embedded in the reply and appear as they stream — no waiting for the whole message
- **30+ components**: cards, tables, charts, forms, tabs, accordions, file trees, timelines, diffs…
- **Native media**: audio and video play inline from browser-reachable http(s) or same-origin relative URLs, with user-controlled playback, video posters/aspect ratios, and visible failure states
- **ECharts integration**: the `echart` node renders full ECharts charts with theme-aware colors, tooltips, and legends. Two modes: **preset shorthand** (`preset: 'bar' | 'line' | 'area' | 'pie' | 'scatter'` + `data`/`series`) for quick upgrade from the `chart` node, or **full option** (`option` field) for custom chart types, dataZoom, visualMap, and other advanced ECharts features. The echarts engine (~1 MB) is lazy-loaded on demand — the main bundle never carries it, and conversations without `echart` nodes never download it- **Function plots**: `plot` draws curves; parameter sliders redraw in real time, with optional auto-animation

- **Quiz**: `quiz` grades on click with explanation and retry; with `action`, the answer is also sent back to the model (grading stays local and instant)
- **Local grading (submit)**: a multiple-choice set uses one `radio` per question with `group` + `answer` + `explanation` and a `submit` button. Once the required radio members are answered, grading appears in the UI when no other collected block state needs delivery. An aggregated action sends `answers`, optional `fields`, `total`, and `answered` in other cases.
- **Submit groups**: `groups` names submission member keys from `radio.group`, `checkbox.group`, `input.id`, `textarea.id`, `select.id`, and `slider.id`. A radio needs a selection, a checkbox group needs at least one selection, and a field needs a value that remains after trimming. `groups` controls required members and progress; the payload still collects filled form state across the block. Without `groups`, any answered member enables submission.
- **State persistence**: answers, submission locks, and input values are saved per "session + content fingerprint" — refresh or reopen restores everything; re-rendering identical content keeps user state; new content starts fresh; LRU cap of 200 blocks
- **Form semantics**: `input` Enter / `textarea` Ctrl+Enter submits immediately (`submit:true`), no blur needed; fields with an `id` are collected into the submit's `fields`
- **Secrets ban**: GenUI must never ask for passwords, API keys, access tokens, recovery codes, or other secrets; even if a password input appears, it stays masked, is never persisted, and never enters form collection
- **Local-first principle**: state changes the UI can do itself (grading, quiz checking, resets, expand/collapse, selection) always happen locally and instantly; actions are reserved for things that genuinely need the model (generating new content, running tools, next-step suggestions)
- **Honest interactions**: interactive components must carry `action`; buttons without one render disabled (kills the "looks clickable, does nothing" fake button); buttons with `action` show instant "triggered" local feedback (proof the local event fired, not that the model received it)
- **Event loop**: buttons, checkboxes, radio buttons, switches, selects, inputs, textareas, submits, and quizzes send one event immediately per gesture; slider drags keep trailing-edge debounce, sending only the final value per slider, with different `id`s handled independently
- **Tool channel**: `render_ui` is registered by default and renders the same spec as a card in the tool row; `validate_dsh_ui` remains available. Set `renderUiTool: false` in this plugin's config to stop registering `render_ui`. The `dsh-ui` fence, `panel: true`, `/panel`, and historical `render_ui` results in the client tool view continue to work. Reload the host plugin after changing this setting.
- **Disable the `render_ui` tool**: add `renderUiTool: false` under this plugin's `config:` in your profile:

  ```yaml
  - id: genui
    name: '@changfenhuang/dsh-genui'
    config:
      renderUiTool: false
  ```
- **Session panel**: a persistent dock above the composer; `render_ui` / `panel: true` fences update the same surface in place; `/panel` opens it from the client (`/panel ` customizes via the model, `/panel clear` clears); the top border is draggable to resize; `append: true` merges incrementally — same-named tabs append content, new tabs get added; the whole panel caps at 200 nodes / 200 appends, after which the model should send `replace` to rebuild
- **Fence auto-repair**: enabled by default; set `fenceFeedback: false` in this plugin's config (under the plugin entry's `config:` in your profile's cordis.patch.yml) to disable same-turn fence corrections. A validated GenUI turn that ends with reasoning only still becomes `EMPTY_RESPONSE` and uses the host's retry policy. When a reply's final dsh-ui fence fails to render, the plugin steers the SAME turn with the per-node diagnosis so the model can resend a fixed fence. At most two corrections are sent per turn, shared by render failures and validated turns with no formal delivery; each fence fingerprint is corrected once per turn, and a nothing-delivered reminder is sent once per turn. A new turn can correct the same failed fence again. Plugin reload restores the current turn's fence fingerprints and correction count, along with delivery reminders, from persisted correction messages. Corrections are never sent in subagent sessions.
- **Self-healing & limits**: every fence passes a spec guard — bad nodes are silently dropped (the surviving siblings keep rendering: one bad component no longer degrades the whole fence), numbers clamped, strings truncated; the whole tree is capped at 200 nodes / 8 nesting levels; pathological specs never crash the UI
- **Canonical component protocol**: native field aliases such as `card.label` → `title`, `table.data`/`table.items` → `rows`, `callout.kind`/`callout.desc` → `tone`/`content` (tone value `danger` → `error`), `steps.items` → `steps`, `keyvalue.items` → `pairs` (record `label` → `key`), and `file-tree.nodes` → `items` (record `label` → `name`, `type` defaults to `dir` when children exist) are normalized deterministically before validation and rendering. A root-level component array is adopted as `items`, and a double-encoded JSON string is decoded once. `validate_dsh_ui` reports these normalizations and warns about unknown native fields without blocking custom renderer nodes.
- **Chart error self-healing**: mermaid failures auto-retry with repairs (strip backticks, quote Chinese/space labels, remove `
`) before degrading to source; a broken chart never hits the screen
- **Accessibility**: tabs/accordions/switches/progress bars carry full ARIA and keyboard navigation (arrow keys switch tabs, Home/End jump)
- **Zero intrusion**: without the plugin, fences are just code blocks — no errors, no session pollution

Component JSON syntax lives in [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md). On hosts with the public skill registry, the plugin registers this bundled `genui` skill automatically, so new Sessions receive the complete component and field catalog without copying files into `~/.dsh`.

`chart` stays the compact three-kind renderer: use `kind: 'bars' | 'line' | 'donut'` with finite numeric `data[].value` fields. `validate_dsh_ui` reports `variant`, unsupported kinds, and invalid datum fields explicitly; `render_ui` rejects the same errors instead of silently rendering the default bars view. Unknown extension fields remain allowed.

The model outputs this fence (written for the browser — you don't need to read it):

```dsh-ui
{"title":"Order overview","items":[
  {"type":"stat","label":"Total revenue","value":"¥128,430","delta":"+12.4%"},
  {"type":"stat","label":"Orders","value":"1,024","delta":"-3.1%"}
]}
```

What you see: two stat cards.

### ECharts example

```dsh-ui
{"title":"Q1 Revenue","items":[
  {"type":"echart","title":"Monthly Revenue","preset":"bar","data":[
    {"label":"Jan","value":98},
    {"label":"Feb","value":112},
    {"label":"Mar","value":128}
  ]}
]}
```

What you see: a themed bar chart with tooltips and axis labels — rendered by ECharts, lazy-loaded on demand.

## 🔧 How it works

The model writes the interface description as JSON inside a `dsh-ui` fence; the browser-side renderer (`src/client`) identifies it in the DSH conversation DOM and renders it. Components are whitelisted — the model can't smuggle in HTML or scripts; function expressions go through a standalone parser, never `eval`.

The core render package stays light (≈110 KB min / 28 KB gzip); the mermaid, three.js, and echarts engines are bundled separately as on-demand assets (loaded through the plugin's self-registered HTTP routes the first time they're used), so startup only downloads the rendering core.

## Export a GenUI artifact

Settled GenUI blocks expose **Export → HTML** and **GenUI JSON**. The `.html` file includes its renderer, styles, KaTeX WOFF2 fonts, and only the chart engines used by the spec. Local controls continue to work; model actions are disabled. Relative media URLs become absolute URLs based on the export page; media still requires network access when the file is opened offline. `.genui.json` preserves the original media URLs, normalized spec, durable interaction state, locale, and theme. Custom components disable HTML export, and export errors appear beside the menu. Hosts can use `createGenuiArtifact`, `parseGenuiArtifact`, `serializeGenuiArtifact`, and `buildStandaloneHtml` from `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/embed`; `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/assets/standalone` resolves to the built runtime script for copying or serving.

## ❓ FAQ

- **Rendering as a code block?** First check the browser console for `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`. If absent, the client bundle was not activated even if its URL returns 200 — check the profile dependency, `package.json.name`, `cordis.patch.yml`, ModuleLoader id, and configured bundle name. If present, inspect the fence label and body.
- **Chat UI goes blank when rendering a dsh-ui fence?** This dsh-genui release requires DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`.
- **`dsh: pnpm not found on PATH`?** Install pnpm, then **open a new terminal** and retry (`corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`).
- **npm install returns 404?** The npm package is public and requires no login. Run `npm view @changfenhuang/dsh-genui version` to verify the package name and public registry; if a newly published version still returns 404, retry shortly.
- **Installed but scene3d/mermaid/echarts don't render?** The engines (mermaid / three / echarts) are no longer inlined in client.js — they load on demand the first time they're used (`/plugins/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/assets/*.js`, hosted by the plugin's own HTTP routes). First restart dsh web + hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R); still broken, remove and reinstall (`dsh plugin --profile web remove @changfenhuang/dsh-genui`, then add again). Hosts without the asset routes degrade to source/load-error hints — update dsh.
- **Model not outputting fences?** New sessions pick it up after a restart; or just say "output it with dsh-ui".
- **No lib/ after cloning?** Build it yourself: `pnpm install && pnpm run check`.

## 🗺️ Roadmap (evaluated)

| Direction | Verdict | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Incremental patching (model sends diffs, not full specs) | Not doing | A fence costs 200–800 tokens; resending is nearly free; a patch protocol's teaching cost and error rate aren't worth it. Revisit if sub-second auto-refreshing panels ever appear |
| Action delivery | ✅ Discrete interactions send immediately; slider drags debounce by action and `id` | Discrete gestures remain individually observable while slider drags send their final value |
| Cross-session state persistence (replay restores tabs/switches) | Not doing | Replay-reset is the more correct default (the model has already updated the UI with a new fence); state survives naturally during streaming |
| MCP adapter / standalone gallery page / i18n | Not doing | No cross-tool demand signal; gallery material is covered by `gallery.ts` + demo-prompts + README screenshots; only 6 built-in strings |

## 核心设计决策 (v4.0 基线)

1. **Host 运行在手机本地 Linux 用户空间**：基于 Compact Debian slim (glibc) + proot/bxroot + Node 24 + 真实 DSH，插件与 Agent 无需任何改动。
2. **核心 UI 原生化（Compose + Material 3）**：会话、聊天消息流、审批、设置、文件均由纯原生 Compose 承载；WebView 仅用于运行插件与重型组件（Web 岛）。
3. **真实文件系统接入（工作区 = 手机目录）**：默认工作区直绑手机公有共享文件夹（`/storage/emulated/0/Documents/DSH-Workspace`），在 Linux 容器内挂载为 `/workspace`，系统自带文件管理器直接可见，产物无需导出。
4. **内置 Surface 适配层（无伴生插件）**：将 `native-surface.js` 补丁内建于前端，自动拦截并调度 `conversation.composer.dock`、`shell.overlay`、`settings.*` 等全部 26 个核心 Slot，保障第三方插件生态 100% 正常运行。
5. **SDUI 声明式渲染器**：支持未来插件以 JSON 声明移动端布局（`dsh.mobile`），手机端以零 WebView 的原生组件树进行高性能渲染。
6. **多主机支持**：支持本地 Linux 用户空间 Host 与远程私有网关 Host 混合管理与无缝切换。

The package is configuration only: one patch layer that points Harness's `subagent-acp` provider at `reasonix acp` and exposes it to the model as a `reasonix` tool. It contains no code. ## Before you install 1. Install Reasonix and run `reasonix setup` once on the same machine. Reasonix reads its provider key from its own home, not from environment variables, so Harness cannot pass one. 2. Make sure `reasonix` is on the `PATH` of the process that runs `dsh`. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` The package is not on npm; `pnpm` installs the `integrations/dsh-plugin` subdirectory of this repository (the `path:` selector, see [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)). ## After installing: switch it on An installed plugin starts **off**. Open its page in the DSH Web UI and turn the switch on. - The switch and both components must read Running. Turning it on in a running `dsh web` is enough: the next new session has the `reasonix` tool (observed on `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2). Restart `dsh` only if it is still missing. - While it is off the model may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell. - That looks like a delegation and is not one: there is no subagent, and the permission policy below does not apply. ## What it changes | Row | Effect | | --- | --- | | `subagent-acp-reasonix` | Spawns `reasonix acp` for each delegation; `permission: reject`. | | `tool-subagent-reasonix` | Adds the `reasonix` tool (`prompt`, `description`, optional `cwd`); `maxDepth: provider-managed`, which the provider requires. | ## Permissions - `permission: reject` is the default. Every approval card Reasonix raises is declined, so the child can read and research but cannot write files or run commands that need approval. - `permission: allow` makes Harness accept every card automatically. The delegated task can then do anything Reasonix's tools can do in that workspace. - Change the policy only in your own `cordis.patch.yml`, for a task and workspace you would approve wholesale. Details, what the parent receives, and limits: [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md). ## Versions The provider version must equal your `dsh` version. This release pins `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2. --- ## 中文 [官网](https://reasonix.io) · [文档](../../docs/DSH.md) · [源码](../../README.md) 把 [Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) 作为子智能体接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）。本包只有配置，没有代码：一层补丁，让 Harness 的 `subagent-acp` 提供方去启动 `reasonix acp`，并以 `reasonix` 工具的形式暴露给模型。 **安装前** 1. 在同一台机器上安装 Reasonix 并运行一次 `reasonix setup`。Reasonix 只从自己的主目录读取模型密钥，不读环境变量，所以 Harness 无法替它传密钥。 2. 保证运行 `dsh` 的进程的 `PATH` 里有 `reasonix`。 **安装** ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` 包不在 npm 上：`pnpm` 通过 `path:` 选择器安装本仓库的 `integrations/dsh-plugin` 子目录（见 [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)）。 **安装后：打开开关** 插件装好后默认是“关闭”的。到 DSH Web 界面的插件页打开它的开关。 - 开关和两个组件都显示 Running 才算生效。在运行中的 `dsh web` 里直接打开就够了，下一个新会话里就有 `reasonix` 工具（在 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 上实测）；仍然没有再重启 `dsh`。 - 没打开时，模型可能改在自己的 shell 里直接运行 `reasonix -p`。 - 这看起来像委派，其实不是：没有子智能体，下面的权限策略也不起作用。 **权限** - 默认 `permission: reject`：Reasonix 弹出的每个审批卡都会被拒绝，子智能体只能读和调研，不能写文件或执行需要批准的命令。 - `permission: allow` 会让 Harness 自动同意所有审批卡，被委派的任务可以在该工作区里做 Reasonix 工具能做的任何事。 - 只在你自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，为你愿意整体放行的任务和工作区才改成 `allow`。 详细说明见 [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md)。 **版本**：提供方版本必须与你的 `dsh` 版本一致，本版本固定为 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2。

Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Right Code reliably provides routing services for models such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, with both pay-as-you-go and monthly subscription billing options available. ## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) · [Use from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Agent presets:** [Session Agent compositions](./docs/AGENT_COMPOSITIONS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) · [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md) - **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History

# dsh-river-provider

A DeepSeek Harness provider plugin for [river.ai](https://docs.river.ai/) built around one
problem the stock OpenAI-compatible path ignores: **you have more than one river.ai key.**

Every request picks a usable account on its own, a rejected key is parked with a reason
instead of being retried forever, and the model picker gets a live catalog with real
context/output limits, per-model reasoning efforts and per-million-token prices.

- Provider id: `river`
- Endpoint: `https://api.river.ai/v1` (Chat Completions, streaming)
- Requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`

## Why not just the OpenAI-compatible provider

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` pointed at river.ai works for one key. It cannot do any of this:

| Gap on the generic path | What this plugin does |
| --- | --- |
| One key per provider row — N accounts means N providers and a manual switch | One row, unlimited accounts, automatic rotation |
| A rate-limited key keeps getting picked, so a turn fails until you edit config | Rejected keys are marked (window / throttle / auth) and skipped |
| `reasoning_effort` is passed through blindly | Per-model whitelists (`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` has no `low`; `GLM-5.3-Flash` needs one) |
| No `reasoning_content` handling | `reasoning_content` becomes a reasoning block, `content` a text block |
| Context/output sizes guessed or hardcoded | Real limits from the bundled catalog + live `/v1/models` |
| Cost unknown | Per-million prices, including cached input, refreshed from the console |
| A 429 loses the whole turn | `Retry-After` becomes `providerRetryAfterMs`, so the harness waits instead of failing |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ExSchwi/dsh-river-provider#v0.1.0
```

`--profile` is **required** — `dsh plugin` forwards its remaining arguments to pnpm inside
that profile, and DSH refuses to guess which profile you meant. Substitute your profile name
(`web`, `tui`, …) for `web`.

`dsh plugin add` records the package in the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`
and lets DSH compose the bundle layer itself — do not hand-edit those files.

The repo ships a prebuilt `lib/`, so the install needs no build step and pnpm never asks you
to allowlist a build script. (If you install from a source checkout instead, `npm run build`
first — `lib/` is the only entry point, `src/` is not shipped.)

The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so installing it inserts its plugin row
automatically:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: llm-river
      name: "@mars-sea/dsh-river-provider"
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: RIVERAI_API_KEY
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Then set the credential and enable the provider:

```bash
dsh credentials set RIVERAI_API_KEY rv_...     # or put it in .credentials.yaml
dsh config set llm-river.apiKeyEnv RIVERAI_API_KEY
```

The model picker then lists `river` models. Nothing about the provider is required for
other providers to keep working — this plugin registers only its own route.

> Restart is mandatory and a restart is not a reload: a session's context budget is fixed
> when the session is created, so an already-open conversation keeps the old limits. Open a
> new session to see the plugin's models.

## Accounts

One account is the `apiKeyEnv` / `apiKey` pair at the top level. Additional ones go in
`accounts`:

```yaml
llm-river:
  apiKeyEnv: RIVERAI_API_KEY
  accounts:
    - label: Work
      apiKeyEnv: RIVERAI_API_KEY_WORK
    - label: Spare
      apiKey: rv_...          # literal; prefer the env var
  modelAccountRules:
    - models: ["zai-org/GLM-*"]
      account: Work
  activeAccount: ""           # empty = rotate
```

Rules are applied in this order:

1. **Model rule** — a `modelAccountRules` entry whose glob matches the model id.
2. **Pinned account** — `activeAccount`, if that account is currently usable.
3. **Rotation** — the next usable account, starting after the last one used.
4. **Revival probe** — when every account is marked, cooldowns that have elapsed are
   retried once before giving up.

A key is marked after the provider rejects it:

| river.ai response | Mark | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `429` | `rate-limit` | skipped until `Retry-After` elapses |
| `402`, `403` with quota text | `throttled` | skipped for a fixed window |
| `401` | `invalid-credential` | disabled until the key changes |
| `503` | `throttled` | backed off, then retried |

`/river-accounts` prints what the pool currently believes:

```
- Default (default) — ready
- Work (RIVERAI_API_KEY_WORK) — cooling down 42s: rate-limit
- Spare (account-3) — disabled: invalid credential
```

A single turn can walk through several accounts: the key is resolved per HTTP attempt, not
per turn, so a rate-limited key mid-conversation costs one retry rather than the reply.

### Retry budget

DSH's retry layer reads `providerRetryAfterMs` from the failure and gives up once the wait
exceeds the adapter's `maxDelayMs`. This plugin reports `maxDelayMs = 900_000` (15 minutes,
matching river.ai's documented response ceiling) and counts one retry per account rotation,
so the budget is 16 rotations × 4.

**Retries are billed again.** river.ai's limits page is explicit: *"Incomplete streams cannot
be resumed; retries are new requests and may incur additional charges."* A turn that dies
halfway and is retried pays for the tokens of the attempt that failed as well — and the same
page warns *"Do not replay completed tool actions"*, so a retry also re-runs whatever the
model asks for next. When a reply keeps dying mid-stream the account is usually not the
problem; lower `streamIdleTimeoutMs`/`requestTimeoutMs` to fail faster, or move to a shorter
prefill.

## Reasoning

`reasoning_effort` is validated per model before the request is sent, because river.ai
rejects a value a model does not support:

| Model | Accepted efforts |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` | `none`, `high`, `max` |
| `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` | `none`, `high`, `max` |
| `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` | `low`, `high`, `max` (always reasoning) |
| `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4` | none — no published table |

No river model accepts `medium`. The picker offers exactly what the table lists and nothing
else, so a level that would be a `400` cannot be chosen in the first place. Two different
paths meet the rest of that wall:

- **`defaultReasoningEffort`** (this plugin's setting) is validated strictly. A value the
  model does not accept is a configuration error and is reported as one — nothing is snapped
  behind your back, because a snapped level changes both what the model does and what it
  costs, on every turn, with nothing to notice.
- **A per-turn request** from the harness may carry an alias river has never heard of
  (`minimal`, `xhigh`, `ultra`). Those are translated to the nearest supported level,
  cheaper side on a tie: a caller asking for `low` on DeepSeek gets `none`, not `high`.

Reasoning text arrives as a thinking block ahead of the answer rather than being glued onto
it.

## Context and output budget

`/v1/models` returns only `id`, `object` and `owned_by` — no context window, no output
ceiling, no modality list. Limits therefore come from a snapshot maintained against the
docs. A model river ships tomorrow still gets the full 1M context every river model
publishes, no effort picker it might reject, and a 32K output ceiling until the snapshot
names it.

Nothing caps the context unless you say so, so the advertised window is the model's own 1M:

```yaml
llm-river:
  contextWindowLimit: 262144   # optional: 1M → 256K
  maxOutputTokens: 65536       # optional: 64K instead of the model's 384K
```

Both are worth lowering, and not only for cost. `maxOutputTokens` becomes each request's
`max_tokens`, and DSH's compaction reserves that same amount when it decides how much
history fits. Pinning the documented maxima (context 1,048,576 / output 384,000) leaves
almost no room for compaction — the pressure budget collapses to near zero and long
sessions thrash. A 256K window with a 64K output budget keeps both meaningful.

A `finish_reason` of `length` arrives as `max-tokens`: the answer was cut, so raise
`maxOutputTokens` for that model rather than retrying the same turn.

## Images

JPEG and PNG are forwarded as base64 with the harness attachment store as the source — the
25 MB per-image limit and the 50 MiB request-body limit are checked before the request goes
out, and an oversized image fails the turn with a clear message instead of a `413`.

## Models and prices

The catalog comes from `/v1/models` and is merged over a bundled snapshot, so a new river.ai
model shows up without a plugin release. Prices are per million tokens and refreshed from
`https://console.river.ai/api/public/pricing` at most every six hours; a failed refresh
keeps the last known table rather than blanking it.

To trim the picker:

```yaml
llm-river:
  visibleModels: ["deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017"]
  modelVisibility:
    "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4": false
```

## Other settings

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiBase` | `https://api.river.ai/v1` | Endpoint base |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `RIVERAI_API_KEY` | Credential ref for the first account |
| `apiKey` | — | Literal key for the first account |
| `activeAccount` | — | Pin to one account; empty rotates |
| `modelAccountRules` | `[]` | Model → account routing |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | 900000 | Whole-request budget |
| `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | 600000 | Longest mid-stream silence |
| `maxOutputTokens` | per model | Output ceiling; also the request's `max_tokens` |
| `contextWindowLimit` | per model | Ceiling for the advertised context window |
| `defaultReasoningEffort` | `{}` | Default effort per model id or glob; invalid values error |
| `visibleModels` | `[]` | Allow-list for the picker |
| `modelVisibility` | `{}` | Per-model overrides |

## Reasoning effort and context as settings

Two knobs bound what a model costs. Both accept a per-model map or a ceiling, and
neither can push a number past what the model actually supports:

```yaml
llm-river:
  # Per model id (or glob). Must be a level that model accepts — anything else is
  # reported as a configuration error. "auto" keeps the model's own default.
  defaultReasoningEffort:
    "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017": high
    "zai-org/GLM-*": max
  # Advertised context ceiling. Only ever lowers the model's own capacity.
  contextWindowLimit: 262144
  # Output ceiling. Never above the model maximum.
  maxOutputTokens: 65536
```

`defaultReasoningEffort` is resolved when the harness asks for a model's metadata, so
it becomes the route's `defaultEffort`: a request that omits an effort gets it, a
request that names one keeps it, and the choice is recorded in the session's request
header. `auto` and an empty value both mean "no opinion" — a model nobody configured
keeps its own default rather than inheriting another model's.

The value is checked against that model's whitelist and, unlike a per-turn request, it is
never snapped: `low` on a DeepSeek model raises
`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash accepts only none|high|max for reasoning_effort, not "low"` instead of
quietly becoming `none`. Naming a model the snapshot does not know yet is rejected the same
way — there is no whitelist to validate against until the snapshot lists it.

`contextWindowLimit` is the ceiling for the window advertised to the harness, which is
what the usage meter, compaction thresholds and the reference-file budget read. It does
not change the request body: river has no field for it.

Keep `contextWindowLimit` comfortably above `maxOutputTokens`. `dsh-compaction-basic`
reserves the effective `max_tokens` out of the advertised window before computing its
pressure threshold, so a window that barely exceeds the output budget leaves compaction
no room and it refuses to run. With river's documented maximums (1,048,576 context vs
384,000 output) that margin is thin — capping both, as above, is the configuration this
plugin is tested against.

## Development

```bash
npm run typecheck
npm test                     # 62 offline tests, no network
npx tsdown                   # build lib/
```

Two opt-in tools hit the real API and are never part of `npm test`:

```bash
RIVERAI_API_KEY=rv_... node --import tsx tools/live-smoke.ts     # protocol, usage, errors
RIVERAI_API_KEY=rv_... RIVERAI_API_KEY_2=rv_... \
  node --import tsx tools/live-accounts.ts                     # two-account rotation
```

`tools/dump-frames.ts` records raw SSE frames to a file for offline replay, which is how
protocol changes get diagnosed without burning quota.

## Not included, on purpose

The upstream plugin this was modelled on carries Command Code-specific surfaces: a login
flow, plan filtering, zero-data-retention headers, a hosted web-search backend and TUI
quota widgets. river.ai has no equivalent endpoint for any of them, so none are faked here.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Liquid Glass — a theme for DeepSeek Harness

**简体中文** · [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A frosted-glass rewrite of the DeepSeek Harness interface: real SVG edge
refraction on the controls you touch, a wallpaper you choose, and a session bar
that shares the window's own title bar instead of stealing a row of its own.

![New session screen with the built-in animated wallpaper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass/main/assets/screenshots/screenshot-1.png)

---

> ## ⚠️ Please use **dark mode**
>
> This theme is designed for dark mode and it is the only mode it looks right in.
> The whole point is translucent glass over your wallpaper — in **light mode** a
> bright wallpaper leaves the glass washed out and the text on top of it hard to
> read.
>
> The theme does darken the light-mode secondary/tertiary greys to recover some
> contrast, but that is a mitigation, not a fix. **If you use light mode, expect
> readability to suffer.** Switching DSH to dark mode fixes it completely.

---

## What you get

### Desktop build

- **The session bar *is* the title bar.** DSH's own header stacks the 对话/轨迹
  tabs on a second row, 76px tall. This theme moves the whole bar into the 40px
  system caption — same row as 应用菜单/编辑 and the window buttons — and lays it
  out as one line. **You get that vertical space back**: the transcript starts
  40px from the top instead of 56px, and the tab buttons become small rounded
  buttons instead of oversized glass capsules.
- **A fullscreen button.** DSH's desktop build ships no fullscreen entry point at
  all — the frameless caption only has minimize/maximize/close, no F11 or
  `togglefullscreen` accelerator is registered, and the main process never calls
  `setFullScreen(true)`. The theme contributes a 28px button in the header that
  requests document fullscreen and toggles back out; the icon follows the state,
  and DSH's own fullscreen-aware layout takes over from there.
- **The caption band is frosted too**, top-down, exactly like the session bar —
  the strip is no longer a flat translucent rectangle.
- **Panels that used to be see-through now have a background**: the choice dialog
  (the panel DSH shows when it asks you to pick an option), the file preview that
  appears when you hover a row in the "已编辑 N 个文件" card, that card itself, and
  the question/answer receipt bubble in the transcript. Each gets a blur plus a
  glass fill at a readable opacity.
- **Readable light-mode text** (within the limits of the note above): the
  secondary / tertiary / caption greys are pushed one to two shades darker.

### The glass itself

- **Genuine edge refraction**, not just blur. An `feDisplacementMap` filter bends
  what is behind each surface at its rim, the way thick glass does. It rides the
  composer card, the send button, message bubbles, the queue dock, dialogs,
  menus and sidebar buttons. **Strength is a slider** — 0 turns it off, 1 is a
  full lens.
- **Every glass parameter is yours**: glass tint colour, tint opacity, material
  brightness, frost blur radius, edge refraction strength, and the code-block
  opacity. All of it applies live — no reload, no restart.
- **Glass-lens buttons** and the **water-drop settings icon** that replaces the
  stock gear.

### The wallpaper

- **Six sources**: none, a web URL (iframe, with an optional host proxy for sites
  that send `X-Frame-Options`), a local HTML file, a local image, a local video,
  or the **built-in animated demo wallpaper** that works out of the box.
- **Independent background controls**: wallpaper blur and wallpaper brightness are
  separate from the card frost, so you can keep the background soft while the
  glass stays crisp.
- **The demo wallpaper is tunable**: speed, blob count, colour cycling, blob blur
  and opacity, plus a background wash toggle.

### Everything else

- **One-row header** even on the web GUI — sidebar toggle, conversation title,
  then the tabs, the "open in…" dropdown and the right-sidebar toggle all on one
  line.
- **Nothing fights your other plugins.** The model-selection list is left exactly
  as DSH ships it (an earlier version restyled it, which collided with other theme
  plugins), and hover styling is deliberately scoped to the surfaces this theme
  actually changes.
- **A dedicated settings page** — "Liquid Glass" is a top-level section beside
  General / Model / Plugins, with live preview and a one-click reset.
- **A clean master switch.** Everything visual is gated on one class; disabling
  the theme strips every token override, removes the wallpaper and turns off all
  frosted/lens rules at once, leaving no residue.

---

## Screenshots

| | |
|---|---|
| ![New session screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass/main/assets/screenshots/screenshot-1.png) | ![Composer with edge refraction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass/main/assets/screenshots/screenshot-input.png) |
| New session, built-in animated wallpaper | Composer card, edge refraction close-up |
| ![Chat with glass bubbles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass/main/assets/screenshots/screenshot-chat.png) | ![Settings page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass/main/assets/screenshots/screenshot-settings.png) |
| Transcript with glass bubbles and the merged top bar | The Liquid Glass settings page |

---

## Install

### Desktop app

The desktop build uses its own profile, named `desktop`. It is created by the app
on first launch, so **quit the desktop app before installing**:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-theme-liquid-glass
```

Then start the app again.

### Web GUI

```bash
dsh plugin add --profile web dsh-theme-liquid-glass
```

Refresh the browser.

> **Compatibility** — requires DeepSeek Harness **≥ `0.1.2-rc.1`**, and supports
> the **0.2.x** runtime, which is what the desktop build ships. Both the web GUI
> and the desktop app use the same client bundle: everything above is available in
> both, with the desktop-only items marked as such. Harness versions before
> `0.1.2-rc.1` are not supported.

### From source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass
cd dsh-theme-liquid-glass
npm install
npm run build
```

Then link the directory into a profile. On Windows use a junction — a plain
`dsh plugin add "<absolute-path>"` can create a broken relative symlink and drop
the plugin from the profile's `bundles` list:

```powershell
dsh plugin remove --profile web dsh-theme-liquid-glass
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-theme-liquid-glass" `
  -Target "<absolute-path-to-theme-source>" -Force
dsh plugin add --profile web dsh-theme-liquid-glass
```

---

## Settings

The **Liquid Glass** page (Settings → Liquid Glass) has two groups: *Page
Background* and *Input Card · Frosted Glass*.

| Setting | What it does | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | Master switch — off removes every visual change | on / off |
| `wallpaper.kind` | Wallpaper source | `none` / `url` / `html` / `image` / `video` / `local` |
| `wallpaper.value` | URL, or a path relative to the wallpapers directory | text |
| `wallpaper.proxy` | Route web URLs through the host proxy (bypasses `X-Frame-Options`) | on / off |
| `wallpaper.muted` | Mute video wallpapers (autoplay policy blocks unmuted) | on / off |
| `demo.speed` | Demo wallpaper animation speed | 0.1 – 4 |
| `demo.blobs` | Demo wallpaper blob count | 1 – 6 |
| `demo.colorCycle` | Demo wallpaper colour cycling (0 = static) | 0 – 10 |
| `demo.blur` | Demo wallpaper blob blur | 10 – 140px |
| `demo.opacity` | Demo wallpaper blob opacity | 0.2 – 1 |
| `demo.wash` | Demo wallpaper background gradient wash | on / off |
| `glass.frosted` | Frost (backdrop blur) on card / bubbles / dock | on / off |
| `glass.blur` | Frost blur radius | 0 – 60px |
| `glass.bgBlur` | Wallpaper blur, independent of the card frost | 0 – 60px |
| `glass.refraction` | Edge refraction strength | 0 – 1 |
| `glass.tint` | Glass colour | hex |
| `glass.tintOpacity` | Glass colour opacity | 0 – 1 |
| `glass.glassBrightness` | Material brightness of the tint | 0.2 – 1.6 |
| `glass.brightness` | Wallpaper brightness | 0.2 – 1.6 |
| `glass.codeBlockOpacity` | Code-block background opacity, independent of the tint | 0.2 – 1 |
| `glass.toolTextColor` | Tool-call text colour (empty = default) | hex |

Settings live in `localStorage` under `dsh-liquid-glass.settings`, so they are
**per browser** — a different browser or cleared site data starts from defaults.
See *Why localStorage* below.

---

## Compatibility and deliberate choices

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Harness | `≥ 0.1.2-rc.1`, including the `0.2.x` desktop runtime |
| Surfaces | Web GUI and the desktop app (same client bundle) |
| Peer packages | the five `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` packages, declared as **optional** peers over `^0.1.2-rc.1 \|\| ^0.2.0-0` |
| Model-selection list | **left to DSH.** An earlier release restyled it; other theme plugins style the same menu and the two overwrote each other, so the theme backed off |
| Hover styling | scoped to the composer, queue dock, dialogs/menus, view tabs and sidebar only — it will not restyle another plugin's controls |
| Light mode | supported, but the glass reads washed out — see the note at the top |
| Settings storage | `localStorage` (per browser) |

---

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run build      # one-shot build → lib/index.js + lib/client.js
npm run watch      # watch mode (pairs with client HMR)
npm run dev        # build + smoke test
npm test           # client smoke test
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit
```

```
src/index.ts         Host half: wallpaper file routes, upload endpoint, web proxy
src/client/index.tsx Client half: token overrides, background layer, glass params, panels
src/shared.ts        Shared settings types and constants (no runtime deps)
build.mjs            SWC build pipeline → loader-format bundles
test/client.smoke.mjs  Smoke test: DOM + CSS + registration assertions
```

### Notes for anyone reading the source

- **Frost is never a `backdrop-filter` on `#root`.** A non-`none`
  `backdrop-filter` makes an element the containing block for every
  `position: fixed` descendant, which would re-anchor menus, popups and toasts.
  Frost therefore rides a dedicated background layer, or a `::before` pseudo.
- **The stylesheet is one template literal.** Every rule lives inside
  `const SHEET = ...` in `src/client/index.tsx`, so a stray backtick inside a CSS
  comment would end the template early. `build.mjs` guards against it.
- **Selectors are anchored on the harness's own stable attributes** —
  `data-slot`, `role`, `data-conversation-scroll` and friends. The CSS-module
  class names are build-time hashes and are only ever matched by their logical
  suffix (`[class*="_bubble"]`), never by a full name.
- **Every rule that touches harness chrome carries both anchors** where the
  harness changed its markup between 0.1.x and 0.2.x (for example the session
  header and the message bubbles), so one bundle serves both runtimes.

### Why localStorage

The harness settings gateway exposes only hard-coded product namespaces to
browser clients, so a third-party namespace stays `loading` forever even when the
host half registered it. The shipped appearance and skin plugins hit the same
wall and also use `localStorage`. The trade-off is that settings do not follow you
between browsers.

---

# DSH Tavern **基于 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Agent 酒馆。兼容 SillyTavern 生态，人物卡导入就能玩。** 更快 · 更稳 · 更鲜活 · 所有模型都能用 · 手机也能玩 [![观看 3 分钟实机演示：兼容酒馆生态，更快、更稳、更鲜活](docs/images/readme/promo-video.jpg)](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1MHaU6NE7S/) [下载安装](#快速开始) · [使用文档](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/) · [宣传视频](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1MHaU6NE7S/) · [Discord 交流群](https://discord.gg/hYAEjKnpra) - **兼容 SillyTavern 生态**：人物卡、世界书、预设、正则美化、MVU、酒馆助手脚本，导入就能用。 - **更快**：一轮约 10 秒，缓存命中率 95% 以上。 - **更稳**：状态栏不再掉格式。变量由后台按规则结算，每轮附更新结果，失败可单独重试；更新与重装都保留数据。 - **更鲜活**：同样的模型、同样的预设，比原版酒馆更有活人感。因为前台模型只管写正文，变量结算等任务性工作交给后台模型。 - **手机也能玩**：Android 手机直接安装；电脑上运行的酒馆，手机扫码就能远程游玩。 ## SillyTavern vs DSH Tavern | | SillyTavern | DSH Tavern | | --------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **上手门槛** | ❌ 要自己配预设、正则、扩展，学习门槛高 | ✅ 填好模型、导入人物卡就能玩，默认无需外部预设 | | **工作方式** | ❌ 一口气：一个模型在一次请求里完成所有事 | ✅ 分步：正文、变量结算、候选项各自完成 | | 出错重来 | ❌ 整轮重新生成，满意的部分也一起丢掉 | ✅ 哪步出错重来哪步，正文和候选还能附上指导意见 | | 正文 | ❌ 写正文的同时要记住各种格式要求，注意力被分散 | ✅ 前台专心写正文 | | 状态栏 | ❌ 每一轮都要求模型重新输出状态栏，写长了容易掉格式 | ✅ 状态栏固化：MVU 版由固定模板按变量显示，不再由模型输出，绝对不会掉格式 | | 候选项 | ❌ 写正文的同时还要兼顾生成候选项，注意力涣散，还可能掉格式 | ✅ 和正文任务拆分，专注生成候选项；通过工具提交并校验，显示在固定面板，绝对不会掉格式 | | **剧情规划** | ❌ 没有剧情规划，走向全靠模型临场发挥 | ✅ 多种方式规划剧情：
① 剧本模式，沿剧本主线发展
② 注入 Guide，临时规划剧情走向
③ 候选项自动规划下一步，避免剧情停滞 | | **记忆** | ❌ 靠压缩总结提前猜测需要什么记忆，提前注入，难以预测真实需求 | ✅ 内置记忆检索工具，需要什么记忆，Agent 自行检索原文 | | 缓存与速度 | ❌ 未考虑缓存利用：世界书条目内容一变化，缓存就失效 | ✅ 缓存命中率 95% 以上，一轮约 10 秒 | | 写作方法 | ❌ 写进预设，每轮常驻提示词 | ✅ 写成 Skill，按场景调用 | | **边玩边改卡** | ❌ 想排错或按喜好调整，都要自己翻人物卡、世界书、正则，逐项手改 | ✅ 边玩边改：
① 排查错误：有问题随时交给调试 Agent，结合实际游玩记录分析并修复
② 调整内容：用对话告诉 Agent 哪里不喜欢，按自己的口味微调 | | **酒馆生态** | ✅ 生态极其丰富：人物卡、世界书、预设、正则、MVU、酒馆助手脚本、大量第三方插件 | ✅ 兼容大部分人物卡（包括 MVU、正则、酒馆助手脚本、前端美化），世界书、预设可直接导入
⚠️ 不支持安装酒馆插件（DSH 插件可以装），但内置了酒馆助手、MVU、提示词模板等重要插件，足以支撑大部分人物卡 | ## 产品特色 ### 剧本模式 导入小说、剧本或大纲，绑定到人物卡，就能走进原作亲历主线。剧本定方向和关键事件，你决定人物怎么走到那里，随时可以偏离。剧本按片段读取，再长的小说也不用整本塞进上下文。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#c01) ![剧本模式：正文沿剧本推进，右侧显示剧本进度与当前片段](docs/images/readme/script-mode.png) ### 长期记忆 每轮正文完整保存，Agent 需要时自己回查原文，不靠摘要硬记；配合上下文压缩，玩到几百层仍能记起开局的细节。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#d06) ### 对话式修改人物卡 不用懂卡片字段，告诉 Agent 哪里不喜欢、想改成什么样，它先给方案，你确认后才写入。也能从小说里提取人物做新卡，或用同样方式修改世界书和预设。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#h04) ![卡片模式：与 Agent 对话修改人物卡，右侧为人物卡字段](docs/images/readme/card-editor.png) ### 人物卡转 MVU 版，状态栏不再掉格式 正文里的状态栏老是掉格式？让 Agent 把人物卡转成 MVU 版：前台只写正文，变量由后台按规则结算，状态栏常驻右侧，原卡图片和设定都保留。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#h07) ### 自助调试 Agent 正则没生效、美化显示不对、状态栏没更新？在右侧展开「遇到显示或生成问题？」，点「交给卡片 Agent 调试」，Agent 会读取这局的实际游玩记录和日志，分析原因并修改相关资源，不用自己翻配置猜问题。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#h08) ### Guide：给这一局注入上下文指引 想要的写法、节奏或剧情走向写成一条 Guide，比如“多写心理活动，对白不超过三句”“好感度涨得慢一点”。它会注入上下文，之后每轮正文、候选和变量结算都会参考，不用每次重复。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#b09) ### 带意见重写 不满意这轮回复，写上哪里要改，比如“保留事件，但减少旁白解释”，只重写这一轮，比反复抽卡更可控。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#b07) ![带意见重写当前正文，右侧为本局 Guide](docs/images/readme/rewrite-body.png) ### 后台人物设计 重要人物登场时，后台为其设计完整档案：动机、性格、外貌、说话方式、与主角的关系，之后反复出场都按同一套设定来，不会前后走样。已有设定直接复用，不重复造人。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#d10) ### 写作 Skill 把写作教程或喜欢的样文交给 Agent，提炼成场景写作 Skill，比如打斗、悬疑、感情戏各有一套写法；游玩时模型按场景自动选用。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#m04) ### 支持插件生态 插件分两类： **DSH 插件**：酒馆运行在 DSH 上，可以直接安装其他 DSH 插件一起使用，例如手机访问的 [dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket)、远程登录认证的 [dsh-webui-auth](https://github.com/Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth)、语音朗读插件等。缺什么能力，也可以让 Agent 帮你写一个自定义工具。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#m07) **DSH Tavern 专属插件**：为酒馆游玩专门开发的插件。社区已有： | 插件 | 作用 | | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | | [dsh-tavern-image](https://github.com/weixinlll/dsh-tavern-image) | 剧情自动配图，支持 ComfyUI、NovelAI、Gemini 等多平台，带人物库 | 以上为社区作者开发，更多插件见 [Discord 交流群](https://discord.gg/hYAEjKnpra)的插件分享。 ## 看看实际效果 **MVU 状态栏**：人物状态随剧情变化，正文下方可查看本轮更新了什么。 ![MVU 人物卡的变量更新结果与右侧酒馆状态栏](docs/images/readme/mvu-status-panel.png) **小手机**：带小手机的人物卡也能用。 **场景插画**：为当前剧情配一张图。 ![公开灯塔案例的场景插画与完整产品界面](docs/images/readme/scene-image-product.png) ## 快速开始 **桌面版仅支持官方 DeepSeek Harness，不再支持社区 DSH Desktop 或 DSH NEXT。** 从社区版迁移前请备份数据，再按[数据导入说明](docs/data-import.md)导入；Android 和独立命令行版继续支持。 当前版本适配 **DSH 0.2.1**。还在用 DSH 0.1.5（DSH Desktop 2.0.13、旧一键安装包）的，请用[稳定版](#稳定版dsh-015)。安装前建议备份 `.dsh` 目录。 ### Windows 1. 安装 [DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2](https://deepseek.com/harness/)，打开一次后从托盘退出。 2. 打开 PowerShell，粘贴下面这行并按回车执行： ```powershell $env:DSH_TAVERN_HOST='desktop'; $tavernInstaller=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadData('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.ps1')); Invoke-Expression $tavernInstaller ``` 3. 重新打开 DeepSeek Harness，即进入酒馆。 ### Android Android 仅提供 **独立 APK**（Android 11+ / ARM64）：[下载 DSH Tavern Android APK](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/releases/latest/download/dsh-tavern-android-release.apk)。它内置 DSHA v0.2.0-rc2 与 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，只运行酒馆自己的 `tavern` Profile，手机上只有一个 DSH 服务，内存和电量开销最低。首次按引导完成环境部署后自动安装并进入；酒馆更新在应用内完成。包名独立，可与旧版 v2.1 APK、原版 DSHA 并存，旧包数据需先导出再导入。详见 [Android 安装说明](docs/android-install.md)。 ### macOS 1. 安装 [DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2](https://deepseek.com/harness/)，打开一次后退出（⌘Q）。 2. 打开「终端」，粘贴下面这行并按回车执行： ```sh curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.sh' -o /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh && DSH_TAVERN_HOST=desktop sh /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh ``` 3. 重新打开 DeepSeek Harness，即进入酒馆。 ### 命令行版（Windows / macOS / Linux，用浏览器玩） 不需要桌面版。命令行版自带一套独立的 DSH，和程序、游戏数据一起装在自己的目录里（默认 `~/.dsh-tavern`），**不会改动、也不会和你已经装好的 DSH 冲突**：桌面版、全局的 `dsh` 命令照常使用，两边互不影响，可以同时运行。需要 [Node.js 22.19+](https://nodejs.org/) 和 pnpm。 Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell $env:DSH_TAVERN_HOST='cli'; $tavernInstaller=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadData('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.ps1')); Invoke-Expression $tavernInstaller ``` macOS / Linux： ```sh curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.sh' -o /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh && DSH_TAVERN_HOST=cli sh /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh ``` 装好后用 `dsh-tavern start` 启动，按显示的地址在浏览器打开；`dsh-tavern stop` / `status` / `update` 停止、查看、更新。 ### 手机远程访问 酒馆跑在电脑或服务器上，用手机浏览器也能玩。[详细说明 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#a02--section-2) - **电脑运行、手机扫码**：安装 [dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket)，在 **设置 → 手机访问** 选择局域网或公网，扫码即可。 - **服务器部署、账号登录**：安装 [dsh-webui-auth](https://github.com/Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth)，为远程网页加上登录认证。 ### 开始游玩 在 **设置 → 模型** 填入模型服务和 API 密钥（任意模型都可以，本地模型也行），导入人物卡就能开局。[图文教程 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#a02--section-5) ### 更新、旧存档与切回原版 - 在酒馆里点「检查更新」即可更新，也可以重新运行上面的安装命令；只替换程序，人物卡、聊天和设置都会保留。 - 旧版本的存档：打开后在「酒馆状态」里点「迁移存档」。正文、变量、分支和历史版本都会保留。迁移后的数据目录不要再让旧宿主直接读取。 - 桌面版切回原版 DSH：设置 → 原版DSH → 切到原版 DSH 并重启。之后在原版 DSH 的设置 → DSH酒馆，就能切回酒馆。不要删除 `.dsh/backups` 和 `profiles/desktop.fresh-*`。细节见[桥接插件说明](tavern-plugin/packages/dsh-profile-bridge/README.md)。 - 旧酒馆在自定义目录、需要继承数据时，见[数据继承说明](docs/data-import.md)。 ### 稳定版（DSH 0.1.5） 适配 **DSH 0.1.5-rc.2**（DSH Desktop 2.0.13、DSHA 0.1.5-rc2），在 [`stable` 分支](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/tree/stable)维护，只修严重问题。安装方法（含一键安装包）见 [稳定版 README](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/blob/stable/README.md#快速开始)。 已经装了稳定版、点更新时提示「DSH 版本不符」的：要继续用 DSH 0.1.5，按稳定版 README 重新运行一次安装命令，以后的更新就跟随稳定版；要换到当前版本，先装上适配的宿主再更新。 ## 交流与反馈 欢迎交流使用经验、分享人物卡或反馈问题： - **[Discord](https://discord.gg/hYAEjKnpra)**：DSH Tavern 交流频道，任何人都可以加入。 除 Discord 外，本项目没有官方的 QQ 群、微信群或其他群聊。 反馈故障时，可从对话顶部的“日志”下载执行记录；分享前请检查其中的对话和附件隐私。 ## 用户怎么说 [![用户反馈：同样预设下比酒馆更有活人感，速度也更快](docs/images/readme/testimonials/more-alive-and-faster.jpg)](docs/images/readme/testimonials/more-alive-and-faster.jpg) tok/s](docs/images/readme/testimonials/long-session-cache-hit.png)](docs/images/readme/testimonials/long-session-cache-hit.png) fullManifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0, per-user accent, shareable theme packs — purely native token system.

# DSH Tavern bundled Dream Skin Based on [RevolutionLA/dsh-dream-skin](https://github.com/RevolutionLA/dsh-dream-skin), npm version **9.23.0**, MIT (see LICENSE). Tavern changes: - Add light/dark Tavern Terracotta definitions from `tavern-themes.json`, with display labels in the native skin picker. - The native light/dark preference drives which half of that pair is active. The two skins declare a shared `schemeFamily`, and every skin restore resolves the saved id against the built-in preference first — without it the stored (light) Terracotta id overrode a built-in `dark` on every boot, since a skin and the built-in preference share one `ui-theme.preference` slot. - Fresh preferences select Tavern Terracotta, with no factory image, URL or gradient. Existing user preferences are retained by the upstream persistence logic. - Skin selection still offers its built-in gradients; manually chosen wallpapers remain supported. This runtime snapshot ships inside Tavern, including npm/Git installations. It is not independently published. Refresh with `node bin/vendor-dream-skin.mjs /path/to/unmodified/dsh-dream-skin-9.23.0` and rerun theme and package checks. No host dependency upgrade is required.

> **当前版本适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**（官方 DeepSeek Harness 或独立命令行；Android 使用独立 APK），安装见[快速开始](#快速开始)。还在用 DSH 0.1.5 的，请用[稳定版](#稳定版dsh-015)。

# DSH Tavern **基于 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Agent 酒馆。兼容 SillyTavern 生态，人物卡导入就能玩。** 更快 · 更稳 · 更鲜活 · 所有模型都能用 · 手机也能玩 [![观看 3 分钟实机演示：兼容酒馆生态，更快、更稳、更鲜活](docs/images/readme/promo-video.jpg)](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1MHaU6NE7S/) [下载安装](#快速开始) · [使用文档](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/) · [宣传视频](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1MHaU6NE7S/) · [Discord 交流群](https://discord.gg/hYAEjKnpra) - **兼容 SillyTavern 生态**：人物卡、世界书、预设、正则美化、MVU、酒馆助手脚本，导入就能用。 - **更快**：一轮约 10 秒，缓存命中率 95% 以上。 - **更稳**：状态栏不再掉格式。变量由后台按规则结算，每轮附更新结果，失败可单独重试；更新与重装都保留数据。 - **更鲜活**：同样的模型、同样的预设，比原版酒馆更有活人感。因为前台模型只管写正文，变量结算等任务性工作交给后台模型。 - **手机也能玩**：Android 手机直接安装；电脑上运行的酒馆，手机扫码就能远程游玩。 ## SillyTavern vs DSH Tavern | | SillyTavern | DSH Tavern | | --------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **上手门槛** | ❌ 要自己配预设、正则、扩展，学习门槛高 | ✅ 填好模型、导入人物卡就能玩，默认无需外部预设 | | **工作方式** | ❌ 一口气：一个模型在一次请求里完成所有事 | ✅ 分步：正文、变量结算、候选项各自完成 | | 出错重来 | ❌ 整轮重新生成，满意的部分也一起丢掉 | ✅ 哪步出错重来哪步，正文和候选还能附上指导意见 | | 正文 | ❌ 写正文的同时要记住各种格式要求，注意力被分散 | ✅ 前台专心写正文 | | 状态栏 | ❌ 每一轮都要求模型重新输出状态栏，写长了容易掉格式 | ✅ 状态栏固化：MVU 版由固定模板按变量显示，不再由模型输出，绝对不会掉格式 | | 候选项 | ❌ 写正文的同时还要兼顾生成候选项，注意力涣散，还可能掉格式 | ✅ 和正文任务拆分，专注生成候选项；通过工具提交并校验，显示在固定面板，绝对不会掉格式 | | **剧情规划** | ❌ 没有剧情规划，走向全靠模型临场发挥 | ✅ 多种方式规划剧情：
① 剧本模式，沿剧本主线发展
② 注入 Guide，临时规划剧情走向
③ 候选项自动规划下一步，避免剧情停滞 | | **记忆** | ❌ 靠压缩总结提前猜测需要什么记忆，提前注入，难以预测真实需求 | ✅ 内置记忆检索工具，需要什么记忆，Agent 自行检索原文 | | 缓存与速度 | ❌ 未考虑缓存利用：世界书条目内容一变化，缓存就失效 | ✅ 缓存命中率 95% 以上，一轮约 10 秒 | | 写作方法 | ❌ 写进预设，每轮常驻提示词 | ✅ 写成 Skill，按场景调用 | | **边玩边改卡** | ❌ 想排错或按喜好调整，都要自己翻人物卡、世界书、正则，逐项手改 | ✅ 边玩边改：
① 排查错误：有问题随时交给调试 Agent，结合实际游玩记录分析并修复
② 调整内容：用对话告诉 Agent 哪里不喜欢，按自己的口味微调 | | **酒馆生态** | ✅ 生态极其丰富：人物卡、世界书、预设、正则、MVU、酒馆助手脚本、大量第三方插件 | ✅ 兼容大部分人物卡（包括 MVU、正则、酒馆助手脚本、前端美化），世界书、预设可直接导入
⚠️ 不支持安装酒馆插件（DSH 插件可以装），但内置了酒馆助手、MVU、提示词模板等重要插件，足以支撑大部分人物卡 | ## 产品特色 ### 剧本模式 导入小说、剧本或大纲，绑定到人物卡，就能走进原作亲历主线。剧本定方向和关键事件，你决定人物怎么走到那里，随时可以偏离。剧本按片段读取，再长的小说也不用整本塞进上下文。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#c01) ![剧本模式：正文沿剧本推进，右侧显示剧本进度与当前片段](docs/images/readme/script-mode.png) ### 长期记忆 每轮正文完整保存，Agent 需要时自己回查原文，不靠摘要硬记；配合上下文压缩，玩到几百层仍能记起开局的细节。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#d06) ### 对话式修改人物卡 不用懂卡片字段，告诉 Agent 哪里不喜欢、想改成什么样，它先给方案，你确认后才写入。也能从小说里提取人物做新卡，或用同样方式修改世界书和预设。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#h04) ![卡片模式：与 Agent 对话修改人物卡，右侧为人物卡字段](docs/images/readme/card-editor.png) ### 人物卡转 MVU 版，状态栏不再掉格式 正文里的状态栏老是掉格式？让 Agent 把人物卡转成 MVU 版：前台只写正文，变量由后台按规则结算，状态栏常驻右侧，原卡图片和设定都保留。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#h07) ### 自助调试 Agent 正则没生效、美化显示不对、状态栏没更新？在右侧展开「遇到显示或生成问题？」，点「交给卡片 Agent 调试」，Agent 会读取这局的实际游玩记录和日志，分析原因并修改相关资源，不用自己翻配置猜问题。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#h08) ### Guide：给这一局注入上下文指引 想要的写法、节奏或剧情走向写成一条 Guide，比如“多写心理活动，对白不超过三句”“好感度涨得慢一点”。它会注入上下文，之后每轮正文、候选和变量结算都会参考，不用每次重复。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#b09) ### 带意见重写 不满意这轮回复，写上哪里要改，比如“保留事件，但减少旁白解释”，只重写这一轮，比反复抽卡更可控。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#b07) ![带意见重写当前正文，右侧为本局 Guide](docs/images/readme/rewrite-body.png) ### 后台人物设计 重要人物登场时，后台为其设计完整档案：动机、性格、外貌、说话方式、与主角的关系，之后反复出场都按同一套设定来，不会前后走样。已有设定直接复用，不重复造人。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#d10) ### 写作 Skill 把写作教程或喜欢的样文交给 Agent，提炼成场景写作 Skill，比如打斗、悬疑、感情戏各有一套写法；游玩时模型按场景自动选用。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#m04) ### 支持插件生态 插件分两类： **DSH 插件**：酒馆运行在 DSH 上，可以直接安装其他 DSH 插件一起使用，例如手机访问的 [dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket)、远程登录认证的 [dsh-webui-auth](https://github.com/Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth)、语音朗读插件等。缺什么能力，也可以让 Agent 帮你写一个自定义工具。[了解更多 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#m07) **DSH Tavern 专属插件**：为酒馆游玩专门开发的插件。社区已有： | 插件 | 作用 | | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | | [dsh-tavern-image](https://github.com/weixinlll/dsh-tavern-image) | 剧情自动配图，支持 ComfyUI、NovelAI、Gemini 等多平台，带人物库 | 以上为社区作者开发，更多插件见 [Discord 交流群](https://discord.gg/hYAEjKnpra)的插件分享。 ## 看看实际效果 **MVU 状态栏**：人物状态随剧情变化，正文下方可查看本轮更新了什么。 ![MVU 人物卡的变量更新结果与右侧酒馆状态栏](docs/images/readme/mvu-status-panel.png) **小手机**：带小手机的人物卡也能用。 **场景插画**：为当前剧情配一张图。 ![公开灯塔案例的场景插画与完整产品界面](docs/images/readme/scene-image-product.png) ## 快速开始 **桌面版仅支持官方 DeepSeek Harness，不再支持社区 DSH Desktop 或 DSH NEXT。** 从社区版迁移前请备份数据，再按[数据导入说明](docs/data-import.md)导入；Android 和独立命令行版继续支持。 当前版本适配 **DSH 0.2.1**。还在用 DSH 0.1.5（DSH Desktop 2.0.13、旧一键安装包）的，请用[稳定版](#稳定版dsh-015)。安装前建议备份 `.dsh` 目录。 ### Windows 1. 安装 [DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2](https://deepseek.com/harness/)，打开一次后从托盘退出。 2. 打开 PowerShell，粘贴下面这行并按回车执行： ```powershell $env:DSH_TAVERN_HOST='desktop'; $tavernInstaller=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadData('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.ps1')); Invoke-Expression $tavernInstaller ``` 3. 重新打开 DeepSeek Harness，即进入酒馆。 ### Android Android 仅提供 **独立 APK**（Android 11+ / ARM64）：[下载 DSH Tavern Android APK](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/releases/latest/download/dsh-tavern-android-release.apk)。它内置 DSHA v0.2.0-rc2 与 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，只运行酒馆自己的 `tavern` Profile，手机上只有一个 DSH 服务，内存和电量开销最低。首次按引导完成环境部署后自动安装并进入；酒馆更新在应用内完成。包名独立，可与旧版 v2.1 APK、原版 DSHA 并存，旧包数据需先导出再导入。详见 [Android 安装说明](docs/android-install.md)。 ### macOS 1. 安装 [DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2](https://deepseek.com/harness/)，打开一次后退出（⌘Q）。 2. 打开「终端」，粘贴下面这行并按回车执行： ```sh curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.sh' -o /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh && DSH_TAVERN_HOST=desktop sh /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh ``` 3. 重新打开 DeepSeek Harness，即进入酒馆。 ### 命令行版（Windows / macOS / Linux，用浏览器玩） 不需要桌面版。命令行版自带一套独立的 DSH，和程序、游戏数据一起装在自己的目录里（默认 `~/.dsh-tavern`），**不会改动、也不会和你已经装好的 DSH 冲突**：桌面版、全局的 `dsh` 命令照常使用，两边互不影响，可以同时运行。需要 [Node.js 22.19+](https://nodejs.org/) 和 pnpm。 Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell $env:DSH_TAVERN_HOST='cli'; $tavernInstaller=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadData('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.ps1')); Invoke-Expression $tavernInstaller ``` macOS / Linux： ```sh curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/main/install.sh' -o /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh && DSH_TAVERN_HOST=cli sh /tmp/dsh-tavern-install.sh ``` 装好后用 `dsh-tavern start` 启动，按显示的地址在浏览器打开；`dsh-tavern stop` / `status` / `update` 停止、查看、更新。 ### 手机远程访问 酒馆跑在电脑或服务器上，用手机浏览器也能玩。[详细说明 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#a02--section-2) - **电脑运行、手机扫码**：安装 [dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket)，在 **设置 → 手机访问** 选择局域网或公网，扫码即可。 - **服务器部署、账号登录**：安装 [dsh-webui-auth](https://github.com/Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth)，为远程网页加上登录认证。 ### 开始游玩 在 **设置 → 模型** 填入模型服务和 API 密钥（任意模型都可以，本地模型也行），导入人物卡就能开局。[图文教程 →](https://flizzywine.github.io/dsh-tavern/#a02--section-5) ### 更新、旧存档与切回原版 - 在酒馆里点「检查更新」即可更新，也可以重新运行上面的安装命令；只替换程序，人物卡、聊天和设置都会保留。 - 旧版本的存档：打开后在「酒馆状态」里点「迁移存档」。正文、变量、分支和历史版本都会保留。迁移后的数据目录不要再让旧宿主直接读取。 - 桌面版切回原版 DSH：设置 → 原版DSH → 切到原版 DSH 并重启。之后在原版 DSH 的设置 → DSH酒馆，就能切回酒馆。不要删除 `.dsh/backups` 和 `profiles/desktop.fresh-*`。细节见[桥接插件说明](tavern-plugin/packages/dsh-profile-bridge/README.md)。 - 旧酒馆在自定义目录、需要继承数据时，见[数据继承说明](docs/data-import.md)。 ### 稳定版（DSH 0.1.5） 适配 **DSH 0.1.5-rc.2**（DSH Desktop 2.0.13、DSHA 0.1.5-rc2），在 [`stable` 分支](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/tree/stable)维护，只修严重问题。安装方法（含一键安装包）见 [稳定版 README](https://github.com/flizzywine/dsh-tavern/blob/stable/README.md#快速开始)。 已经装了稳定版、点更新时提示「DSH 版本不符」的：要继续用 DSH 0.1.5，按稳定版 README 重新运行一次安装命令，以后的更新就跟随稳定版；要换到当前版本，先装上适配的宿主再更新。 ## 交流与反馈 欢迎交流使用经验、分享人物卡或反馈问题： - **[Discord](https://discord.gg/hYAEjKnpra)**：DSH Tavern 交流频道，任何人都可以加入。 除 Discord 外，本项目没有官方的 QQ 群、微信群或其他群聊。
