## 四、设计决策说明

以下为设计理由，而非功能清单。每项均记录于 `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` 与 `docs/DECISIONS.md`，可逐条追溯。

### 4.1 情绪回归采用指数曲线

真实情绪表现为初期变化快、后期趋缓。线性衰减会在某一时点骤然归零，与观察不符。

### 4.2 情绪弥散与熟悉度负相关

心情偏离基线时，对关系疏远者的影响大于对熟悉者的影响。原因是熟悉度低时无法为其区分情绪来源，该设定符合拟人化预期。

### 4.3 语音输出设有四道闸门

语音合成需要 2–5 秒、上传需要 1–3 秒，纯文本约 1 秒可发出。若群聊中每条均为语音，会显著降低可用性。因此语音仅在情绪明显偏离基线时使用，以保证其信息密度。

### 4.4 分条策略优先保持语句完整

示例句「嗯……算了吧，你先忙。」切分为四条会破坏语句连贯性，切分为两条更贴近自然表达。因此强分隔符必切，软停顿仅在句子超长时参与。

### 4.5 隐私项不提供开关

日志上传一经开启，关闭期间产生的内容会在重新开启时补发，因此「关闭即可清除」不成立。与其提供可能造成误解的开关，不如不提供。

### 4.6 进程终止仅依据 pidfile

按进程名匹配终止会连带终止官方 DSH。本项目使用独立进程组，退出时仅终止自身记录的 PID。

### 4.7 组合包安装前自动创建还原点

组合包采用完整字段集（作者、图标、截图、权限声明、校验和）。安装前执行冲突检测并自动创建还原点，默认保留 3 个。

### 4.8 不设置无效控件

尚未接入后端的项目标注「未接入」，不提供无响应控件。无效控件比缺少功能更严重，因其会使使用者误判功能已生效。

### 4.9 启动执行自检

DSH 对插件加载失败仅输出告警，不中断启动。该行为在插件宿主中属合理设计，但会导致功能静默缺失。因此每次启动执行激活数量自检：

| 检查项 | 判据 | 不一致时 |
|---|---|---|
| 插件激活数 | 配置树条目数等于实际激活数 | 界面横幅告警，列出未激活条目 |
| 隐私配置 | 会话日志上传与使用统计均为关闭 | 拒绝启动并给出修复指引 |
| 关键插件 | 情感、记忆、对话、人格均在激活列表 | 降级为只读并说明缺失能力 |

## 五、架构与插件体系

插件以 7 组挂载于 DSH 插件树，共 **32 个插件包**。

| 分组 | 数量 | 内容 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内核 | 5 | 情感、记忆、世界书、节奏、主动消息 | 情感、记忆、节奏已实现 |
| 对话 | 2 | 轻量对话通道、人格包 | 通道与人格已实现 |
| 通道 | 10 | QQ（官方 / 个人号）、微信公众号、个人微信、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、Discord、唤醒路由 | 骨架 |
| 表达 | 6 | TTS、表情包、立绘、桌宠、移动端桌宠、表达决策 | 骨架 / 占位 |
| 行动 | 4 | adb、浏览器、Minecraft、GUI 决策环 | 骨架 |
| 系统 | 4 | 隐私、市场、还原点、中文日志 | 骨架 |
| 界面 | 1 | Web UI | 界面壳已实现，插件入口为空 |

> 包划分待重划。原「29 包全自研」的结论形成于生态调研之前。当前 DSH 环境已安装 `dsh-pet`、`dsh-soul-md`、`dsh-context` 等插件，与多个自研包功能重叠。决策 85 已调整为「复用优先、只做差异，且可跟随上游更新」，因此包划分需在 S0 内重做一次，依据见 `docs/TECH-RESEARCH.md` §5.5。

### 5.2 隔离与命名体系

安装 NT-Dpet 不修改用户已有的 DSH 环境。隔离覆盖所有可能与官方版本冲突的标识：

| 项目 | 官方 DSH | NT-Dpet |
|---|---|---|
| 产品名 | DeepSeek Harness | NT-DPet |
| 应用标识 | `com.deepseek.dsh` | `com.ntars.ntdpet` |
| 用户数据目录 | `~/Library/Application Support/DeepSeek Harness` | `…/NT-Dpet` |
| 数据根 | `~/.dsh` | `…/NT-Dpet/dsh-home` |
| 技能根 | `~/.agents` | `…/NT-Dpet/agents` |
| profile | `desktop` | `nt-dpet` |
| 进程名 | DeepSeek Harness | `nt-dpet-host` |
| 进程管理 | 官方 App | 独立进程组 + pidfile，仅按 PID 终止 |
| 端口 | 3080 | 9060（可调，冲突时递增） |
| 环境变量前缀 | `DSH_*` | `NTDPET_*` |

四项禁止事项：不写 `~/.dsh`、不写 `~/.agents`、不占用 3080、不依赖官方 App 的进程存活。

唯一的跨目录读取：首次启动时以只读方式检查已配置的密钥，并询问是否沿用；经确认后才复制至自有目录，不回写原文件。

### 5.3 隐私与数据

- 对话与记忆默认全部存储于本机
- 记忆不加密（决策 89）：目录权限 0700、数据库文件 0600
- 上游默认的会话日志上传行为已强制关闭，并在每次启动时校验
- 对话通道不创建 DSH 会话，因此不产生会话日志
- 用户资产（人格、凭据、日记、还原点）存放于 `user/` 目录，与 `dsh-home/` 分离，避免配置重建时清除

## 七、当前实现范围

版本 0.1.0，处于 S0 阶段。

| 模块 | 状态 | 验证方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `@nt-dpet/emotion` 情感状态机 | 已实现 | 21 个单元测试；真实构建产物在 DSH 中挂载成功 |
| `@nt-dpet/dialogue` 对话通道 | 已实现 | 12 个单元测试；真实网关端到端验证通过 |
| `@nt-dpet/memory` 记忆双层 | 已实现 | 23 个单元测试，含 SQLite 持久化与 0600/0700 权限校验 |
| `@nt-dpet/rhythm` 分条与节奏 | 已实现 | 15 个单元测试 |
| `@nt-dpet/persona` 人格与称呼 | 已实现 | 13 个单元测试；五份人格锚点已撰写 |
| `@nt-dpet/ui` 接口层与界面壳 | 已实现（接口 `/health`、`/mood`、`/memory/recent`、`/chat`；情绪面板、右栏记忆与对话发送均接真实数据） | 51 个单元测试 + 14 项交互冒烟 |
| `@nt-dpet/pet-mobile` 移动端桌宠 | 占位（默认禁用） | 无实现 |
| 其余 25 个插件包 | 骨架 | 仅通过编译 |
| 安装器、三端打包 | 未开始（`desktop/src/main.ts` 为骨架） | 无可运行产物；`@nt-dpet/desktop` 仅声明 electron 开发依赖 |

端到端实测记录（真实插件，非测试桩）：

```
[e2e] dialogue 服务: true | emotion 服务: true
[e2e] 用时 15196 ms
[e2e] 回复: "欢迎回来喵，主人～"
[e2e] stopReason: stop | usage: {"inputTokens":44,"outputTokens":6,"totalTokens":50}
[e2e] 流式增量条数: 6
```

### 7.1 已知限制

1. 不提供安装包，当前仅可源码构建
2. 记忆为 SQLite 持久化，但事实提炼提示词尚未编写
3. 情感状态默认使用内存存储，进程退出即丢失；存储端口已预留
4. 界面壳尚未全部联通插件服务：接口层（`/api/ntdpet` 路由与自鉴权）已落地，情绪面板、右栏记忆与对话发送已接真实数据；启动自检、记忆管理页仍用静态数据（`docs/ROADMAP.md` M0.2.5 起）
5. 包划分未定稿
6. 测试覆盖不均：五个模块有单元测试，其余包尚无
7. 人格文本尚未经真实对话校验
8. 移动端仅保留占位
9. 对话目前是单轮：每次只把这一句发给模型，不带历史与记忆（system 提示词组装在 M0.7、记忆注入在 M0.5）；首屏仍是 `js/data.js` 的演示会话，真实消息追加在其后

---

## 八、平台支持

| 平台 | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | 已验证 | 唯一完成实测的平台 |
| Windows | 未验证 | 计划 S1 支持 |
| Linux | 未验证 | 计划 S1 支持 |

### 8.1 移动端桌宠（占位）

`packages/pet-mobile/` 已保留位置，默认禁用，无实现。三端能力差异为结构性差异，不能共用同一渲染实现：

| 平台 | 桌面常驻立绘 | 可行形态 |
|---|---|---|
| 安卓 | 可行（`SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`） | 常驻、可拖动、可交互 |
| 苹果 | 不可行（系统不开放第三方全局悬浮窗） | 灵动岛、实时活动、小组件与应用程序内形象 |
| 鸿蒙 | 待确认 | 服务卡片、万能卡片，需单独适配 |

因此移动端不以桌面立绘为主要形态，而以通知、锁屏信息、小组件状态为主。该判断需在产品层面确认后实施，详见 `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §11.4。

---

## 九、构建与测试

### 9.1 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js | ≥ 22 | 实测 `22.22.2` |
| pnpm | 9.x | 实测 `9.15.9`；`packageManager` 锁定 `pnpm@9.15.0` |
| DSH 宿主 | 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2` | 插件运行于其进程内 |

`pnpm` 未加入 PATH 时使用 `npx pnpm@9`。不使用 `corepack`：其默认安装 12.x，与 `packageManager` 声明不一致。

### 9.2 构建

```bash
# 安装依赖（跳过 postinstall，避免下载 Electron 二进制）
npx pnpm@9 install --ignore-scripts

# 构建全部 32 个包
npx pnpm@9 -r --filter './packages/**' build

# 类型检查
npx pnpm@9 -r exec tsc --noEmit
```

### 9.3 测试

```bash
# 情感状态机：21 个用例
npx pnpm@9 --filter '@nt-dpet/emotion' run test

# 对话通道：12 个用例
npx pnpm@9 --filter '@nt-dpet/dialogue' run test

# 记忆：23 个用例（含 SQLite 持久化与权限）
npx pnpm@9 --filter '@nt-dpet/memory' run test

# 节奏：15 个用例
npx pnpm@9 --filter '@nt-dpet/rhythm' run test

# 人格：13 个用例
npx pnpm@9 --filter '@nt-dpet/persona' run test

# 界面交互冒烟：14 项
node packages/ui/web/test/smoke.mjs
```

`--filter` 后必须带 `run`：`pnpm --filter X test` 会调用 pnpm 内置命令，退出码不反映测试结果。

### 9.4 在独立 DSH 环境验证插件

以下流程不触碰用户已有的 `~/.dsh`：

```bash
BIN="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js"
export DSH_HOME=/tmp/nt-dpet-probe/dsh-home

# 1. 从内置模板创建独立 profile
node "$BIN" --profile nt-dpet --from-default-profile web

# 2. 查看合成后的插件树
node "$BIN" --profile nt-dpet --patch ./my.yml --dump-config

# 3. 启动
node "$BIN" --profile nt-dpet --patch ./my.yml --no-open --port 9060
```

三项实测结论：启动日志中的 URL 带随机 token，默认绑定 `127.0.0.1`；插件加载失败不中断启动，仅输出告警；`--profile` 与 app 名不可同时出现。

### 9.5 界面预览

```bash
cd packages/ui/web && python3 -m http.server 8731
# http://127.0.0.1:8731/
# 工作视图：http://127.0.0.1:8731/#work
# 指定设置页：http://127.0.0.1:8731/?pane=her
```

项目介绍页：

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8920
# http://127.0.0.1:8920/
```

---

## 十、模型接入

模型调用统一经 `dsh-llm` 服务，由 provider 适配器实现。密钥不出现在配置文件中：patch 仅声明环境变量名，其值在每次请求时解析。

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'
  config:
    providers:
      magpie:
        displayName: 本地网关
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1
        apiKeyEnv: MAGPIE_API_KEY
        models:
          - id: group/ntars
            name: 本地模型
            contextWindow: 1048576
            maxTokens: 384000
```

```bash
export MAGPIE_API_KEY=<密钥>
```

两项注意：覆盖已存在的条目时必须写明 `id`；手工声明的 provider 不出现在 `ctx.llm.listProviders()` 中，但 `ctx.llm.stream({ provider })` 可正常使用。

---

## 十一、插件开发约定

### 11.1 包的必备文件

```
packages/<name>/
├── package.json          必须含 type: module、main、files、dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml      挂载声明，必须使用 insert 包裹
├── tsconfig.json
└── src/index.ts          export name / export function apply(ctx)
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: nt-dpet:core:emotion
      name: "@nt-dpet/emotion"
```

写成裸条目（`- id:` 直接开头）不会报错，也不会生效，条目会被静默丢弃。

### 11.2 四项约束

1. 仅 ESM：`@deepseek-ai/*` 为 ESM，CommonJS 会触发 `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`
2. 必须声明 `inject`：读取未声明的服务会抛出异常，且整个插件不激活
3. entry id 全项目唯一：命名规范 `nt-dpet:<组>:<名>`
4. patch 必须使用 `insert` 包裹

### 11.3 实现语言

本项目不规定实现语言，按组件选择最优解：插件与界面使用 TypeScript，本地语音使用 Python 子进程，macOS 原生能力使用 Swift。约束在于进程边界与接口契约，跨语言组件不得以 FFI 方式绑定运行时。

---

## 十二、实施阶段

| 阶段 | 内容 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| S0 | 骨架与最小可聊（文本、记忆、情感） | 进行中 |
| S1 | 三端打包（Windows → macOS → Linux） | 未开始 |
| S2 | 官方 QQ 机器人、微信公众号通道 | 未开始 |
| S3 | 组合包市场与还原点 | 未开始 |
| S4 | 语音与表情包 | 未开始 |
| S5 | 桌面桌宠 | 未开始 |
| S6 | 手机操作 | 未开始 |
| S7 | 其余通道 | 未开始 |

S0 完成前不发布任何可安装产物。

---

## 十三、风险与限制说明

**账号风险**：接入个人 QQ 号或个人微信可能导致账号永久封禁，并可能波及所在群聊与关联账号。本软件无法保证账号安全。官方机器人通道不存在该风险，为推荐接入方式。

**AI 内容标识**：本软件不代使用者添加 AI 生成内容标识。在公开平台使用其输出时，使用者依《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》（2025 年 9 月 1 日施行）承担标识义务。

**隐私**：对话与记忆默认存储于本机且不加密，安全边界由目录权限承担。上游默认的会话日志上传行为已被强制关闭并在每次启动校验。

---

## 十四、文档索引

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`NOTICE`](NOTICE) | 第三方组件与版权声明（法律文件） |
| [`docs/ADOPTION-REGISTER.md`](docs/ADOPTION-REGISTER.md) | 采用登记册：逐项采用决策与声明动作 |
| [`docs/UPSTREAM-CANDIDATES.md`](docs/UPSTREAM-CANDIDATES.md) | 上游候选清单：GitHub 扫描结果与定级 |
| [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构设计：拓扑、数据模型、接口契约、施工顺序 |
| [`docs/TECH-RESEARCH.md`](docs/TECH-RESEARCH.md) | 技术底账：选型、许可矩阵、宿主实测 |
| [`docs/DECISIONS.md`](docs/DECISIONS.md) | 决策记录：92 项，逐项可溯源 |
| [`docs/CREDITS.md`](docs/CREDITS.md) | 致谢与许可边界 |
| [`docs/HANDOFF.md`](docs/HANDOFF.md) | 上下文交接说明 |
| [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](docs/ROADMAP.md) | 开发清单：M0–M8 共 71 个可勾选项（M0 已细化到 22 个子步） |
| [`docs/AUTOMATION.md`](docs/AUTOMATION.md) | 定时任务的职责、边界与暂停方式 |
| [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) | 版本记录 |

---

## 十五、贡献

- 提交前执行 `npx pnpm@9 -r --filter './packages/**' build` 与相关测试
- 新增插件包须遵守 §11.1 的目录结构与 §11.2 的四项约束
- 涉及第三方代码时，先在 `docs/CREDITS.md` 与 `docs/ADOPTION-REGISTER.md` 中明确使用方式与声明要求

---

# DSH Claude Style **为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 风格与交互体验的主题插件。** > **你的下一个 Claude Code Desktop ，何必是Claude Code。** [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.en.md) [![version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-style?style=flat&label=version&color=D97757)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-style) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-claude-style?style=flat&label=downloads&color=D97757)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-style) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Nwflower/dsh-claude-style?style=flat&label=%E2%98%85&color=08C)](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-claude-style) [![dsh.so install](https://www.dsh.so/badge/install/dsh-claude-style.svg)](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/dsh-claude-style/) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%20%2B%20PolyForm%20Shield-2EA44F?style=flat)](LICENSE)
## 预览 两套主题在插件设置里切换，亮暗跟随系统。 ### Claude
> 工作台首页（上），对话界面（下）；浅色在左，深色在右。 ### DeepSeek
> 输入框上沿站着宠物小鲸鱼 Deepy，八个状态：

空闲
思考
写回答、调用工具
指挥子代理

等你操作
失败

# dsh-peak-cost [![CI](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/releases) [![CodeQL](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/codeql.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/security/code-scanning) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) A [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/guide/quickstart) plugin that adds one ambient line under the composer: ```text ● Off-peak · ≈ $0.338 · bal $7.27 ``` ![The composer dock line in DeepSeek Harness: peak status, session estimate and account balance, to the right of the shipped step counter and token meter](assets/composer-dock.png) It answers three questions about the session you are in: 1. **Is DeepSeek billing in peak hours right now?** 2. **How much has this session cost so far, in US dollars?** 3. **What is left in your DeepSeek account?** Hovering the line expands it into a breakdown: the billing window and the time until it flips, the estimated spend and model-call count, the input/cache/output token split, the cost of each token kind, what the same prompt would cost without caching, and both wallets behind the balance. The screenshot above is unedited: the line sits beside the shipped turn/step counter and token meter, and reads `● Off-peak · ≈ $0.338 · bal $7.27` for a session at 9 turns and 264 steps with a 99.6% cache hit rate.

## Behavior | | | |---|---| | Slot | `conversation.composer.dock` (below the composer card, beside the shipped activity and context-usage entries) | | Scope | Per session | | Updates | Spend follows every settled model call; the status label re-evaluates against the clock every 30 s; the balance refreshes every 60 s | | Locales | English and Chinese, following the app's language setting | ### Balance Next to the session estimate the line also shows your DeepSeek account balance: ```text ● Off-peak · ≈ $0.18 · bal ¥7.26 ``` It is read from the Host's account Remote (`ctx.remote.account.getBalance`) every 60 seconds and whenever the window regains focus — the same call the Settings → Account page makes — and **both wallet kinds are summed**: the recharge wallet plus any bonus/grant wallet, which is why it can differ from a single number on a top-up page. The tooltip always lists both: ```text Account balance: ¥7.26 Recharge ¥7.26 · bonus ¥0.00 ``` The account face is a Typert Remote namespace rather than a plain service, so the plugin captures it through a scoped `ctx.inject(['remote.account'], …)` and still falls back to `ctx.remote.account` on the root context. That keeps it independent of load order: the cost line renders immediately, and the balance appears as soon as the transport is reachable. The balance is optional in every direction: a signed-out account, an API-key-only setup, a failed read, or a build without the account transport all simply drop it, leaving the cost line intact. Nothing is cached to disk. ## Install The package is a Harness **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` half, so installing it in a profile mounts both the Host projection and the Web entry. Install the package spec `github:ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost` as a bundle — from the Plugins page of the app, or from an agent session through the plugin manager's `install_bundle` action with that spec as the target. The plugin needs a Harness build that provides the session projection registry, the `conversation.composer.dock` slot, and the client locale service — that is, the current DeepSeek Harness desktop/web app. It has no npm dependencies and no build step. To remove it, uninstall the bundle from the same Plugins page. ## How the number is computed Money is not inferred on the client from a token total. The Host half folds the durable session log and registers one session projection, `peakCost`, whose wire view carries the cumulative spend. The Client renders that value; it never re-folds events, so the figure survives paging, reloads, and compaction. Each `assistant/message` in the log is priced on its own: - **model** — from the message's own provider metadata, so a session that switches between `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` stays correct; - **tokens** — cache-miss input, cache-hit input, cache-write, and output are priced separately from the provider-reported usage (falling back to the usage chunk in the message's stream); - **billing window** — from the message's own timestamp, so a session that crosses a peak boundary is priced correctly in both windows; - **discount** — off-peak rates are half of peak rates. Because the fold is a pure function of committed events, replay and fork produce the same figure. ### Cache hits are part of the calculation Harness sends the whole conversation on every model call, so a long session burns a large prompt each time — and nearly all of it is a **cache hit**, billed at the hit rate rather than the input rate. That discount is the whole reason one session can move millions of prompt tokens for cents. A real session from this plugin, mid-conversation, off-peak on `deepseek-flash`: | | tokens | rate (off-peak) | cost | |---|---|---|---| | cache-miss input | 184,312 | $0.15 / 1M | $0.028 | | cache-hit input | 21,805,952 | $0.003 / 1M | $0.065 | | output | 102,878 | $0.60 / 1M | $0.062 | | **total** | | | **$0.155** | The same 22M prompt tokens billed without prompt caching would be **$3.36** at the miss rate. The tooltip shows this line for the session you are looking at, so the discount is visible rather than assumed. ### Why this number and your balance can disagree The figure is a **list-price equivalent**, computed from the session log; it never reads your wallet. Three things make a wallet diverge from it: - **Granted or bonus credit is consumed first.** DeepSeek deducts from granted/bonus balances before a topped-up balance, so a topped-up number can stay flat while usage accrues. - **The balance is not streamed.** It is read on demand from the platform; a panel left open shows what it read. - **Not every call is in the log.** Session-title generation and some compaction work never commit an `assistant/message`, so they cost money this estimate cannot see. Use the platform's usage page for the authoritative charge; this line is for watching a session's shape while it runs. ### Rates and calendar Defaults follow [DeepSeek's published pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) (USD per 1M tokens): | Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output | |---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-flash` | 0.006 | 0.30 | 1.20 | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.044 | 1.32 | 3.96 | Peak hours are **01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday**, excluding Chinese public holidays. Every other hour, all weekend, and Chinese public holidays are off-peak. Off-peak prices are half of the table above. Both the rates and the calendar are constants at the top of [`index.js`](index.js): - `MODEL_RATES` — add or change a model card when DeepSeek changes prices; - `PEAK_WINDOWS`, `PEAK_WEEKDAYS_ONLY` — the billing calendar; - `PEAK_HOLIDAYS` — Chinese public holidays as UTC `YYYY-MM-DD`. **Empty by default**: on a holiday the indicator reports "peak" while billing is actually off-peak, until you add the dates. Legacy aliases (`deepseek-v4-flash`, and the older `-chat` / `-reasoner` names) bill at the flash card. ## Known limitations - **An estimate.** It prices reported tokens at list rates. It is not a bill: nothing here reads your balance or the provider's invoice. - **Only settled model calls count.** Calls that never commit an `assistant/message` — session-title generation, some compaction work — are not in the log and are not counted. Failed attempts that report usage without a settled message are likewise skipped. - **One session.** Subagent sessions have their own logs and their own dock lines; this number is the session you are looking at. - **Unknown routes.** A model id that matches no card is counted in the message total but priced at zero; the tooltip reports how many. - **Search/Fetch.** Standalone Search and Fetch API charges are not modelled. ## Development ```bash npm test # node --test: fold semantics, window edges, wire schema, client rendering ``` The suite needs nothing beyond Node 22+: - [`test/fold.test.mjs`](test/fold.test.mjs) drives the Host fold directly — peak edges, weekends, cache buckets, model routing, unknown routes, stream fallback, checkpoint safety; - [`test/client.test.mjs`](test/client.test.mjs) loads the client module with a stubbed module loader and React, then renders the dock entry against projection values shaped like the wire view. Bundle layout: ```text index.js Host half: the `peakCost` session projection client.js Client half: the composer-dock entry and locale dictionaries cordis.patch.yml Loader row inserted by the bundle locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager title and description icon.svg Plugin artwork ``` ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT, native source and canonical Git plugin-manager installation are present. No versioned DSH host compatibility contract was established. Model usage/cost data display is not a measured billing reconciliation. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# token-stat

官方的 UsagePill 只统计当前会话，token-stat 把**全部会话的 Token 用量跨会话累计**成一个数字——输入框旁的药丸看总量，设置页按天、按模型看明细。计数口径与官方 token-meter 的折叠规则对齐：同一 `(turn, step)` 的用量样本**后到替换先到**、重试尝试照常累加，会话重放与重新结算都**不会重复计数**。

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，两个界面共享一份数据故事：

1. **输入框下方药丸**：显示全部会话的**累计 Token 用量**。官方自带的 UsagePill 只统计当前会话，本插件补充跨会话累计口径。
2. **设置里的「Token 用量」页**：单屏宽度完整展示（无横向滚动，仅纵向滚动），包含累计卡片、**每日用量曲线图**、**模型用量柱状图**、按模型/按会话统计表——不同模型使用不同颜色，只有实际产生用量的模型才会出现。

## 设置页「Token 用量」

- 挂载到 `settings.section` 槽位（设置面板左侧导航，排在「模型」之后）。
- **今日用量卡片**（页面顶部）：当天总消耗大字 + 当天各模型柱状图 + 图例，取自逐日明细中
  浏览器本地日期那份；当天还没有用量时显示空状态。
- **累计卡片**：总消耗、未缓存输入 / 缓存读 / 缓存写 / 输出四个分桶、会话数、整体缓存命中率。
- **每日用量曲线图**（SVG，悬停显示当天各模型明细与合计）：数据来自本插件 Host 半身注册的
  `tokenUsageDaily` 会话投影——镜像官方 token-meter 的折叠规则（同一 `(turn, step)` 的用量样本
  后到替换先到；`llm/retry-started` 解除替换槽使重试尝试照常累加），按每次请求的实际路由
  （`request/header` 的 `config.provider/model`）和事件本地日期归组，wire view 以
  `{ 'YYYY-MM-DD': { 'provider\0model': [输入, 输出, 缓存读, 缓存写] } }` 随会话列表下发。
- **模型用量柱状图**：每个用到的模型一根彩色柱 + 图例（名称 + 紧凑总量）；悬停柱体显示明细浮层——
  总量、缓存命中、缓存未命中，以及有值时的缓存写入与输出（今日卡片与全期对比图均支持）。
- **按模型统计表 / 会话明细表**：三列布局（模型/会话、数量、合计），四桶明细做副行，不在窄面板里横向溢出。
- 颜色：8 色调色板按用量降序分配，全程一致（图表、图例、表格色点）；无法归到路由的用量为灰色「未知模型」。
- **历史明细补算**：列表行自带的投影来自缓存；在本插件安装前已结束且未再打开的会话缺逐日明细，
  页面会用 `session/projections`（受支持的冷读取）两路并发逐个补算，并在标题旁显示进度
  「正在补充历史按日明细 n/m」。
- 表格数据与累计卡片来自 `session/list` 行的 `tokenUsage`（provider 上报，按会话最近一次使用的
  模型归类）；图表用每次请求的实际模型，口径更精确，页面内有说明。
- 刷新：`api-session/added|removed|status|activity` 推送去抖后自动刷新（仅当页面处于打开状态），
  重新打开页面时自动刷新一次，另有手动「刷新」按钮；断线 `connection/reset` 后回到待加载状态。

## 输入框药丸

- 挂载到 `conversation.composer.dock` 槽位，与官方 ActivityPill / UsagePill / ContextMeter 并排。
- 聚合 sessions 快照中每个会话的 `tokenUsage` 投影值，显示累计总量与有统计数字的会话数，例如
  `累计 1.2M · 8 会话`；悬停提示展示分桶明细、缓存命中率与当前会话合计。

## 通用

- 中英文界面（客户端 locale 服务）；结构样式只引用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，图表系列色为固定
  调色板（作品色），自动适配明暗主题。
- 不 require 任何 Harness Client 包；React 来自浏览器模块表，服务经 fiber `inject` 注入。
- Host 半身只注册 `tokenUsageDaily` 投影（可选挂载：无投影注册表的部署上插件其余功能不受影响）。

## 目录结构

```
token-stat/
├── package.json       # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client(web)
├── cordis.patch.yml   # 激活层：向 loader 插入 id=token-stat 的插件行
├── index.js           # Host 半身：tokenUsageDaily 会话投影（日期 × 模型 × 四桶）
├── client.js           # Client 半身：dock 药丸 + 设置页（卡片/曲线图/柱状图/表格）
├── test/               # 投影折叠逻辑单元测试（node:test，零依赖）
├── locale/en.json     # Plugin Manager 展示元数据（英文）
├── locale/zh.json     # Plugin Manager 展示元数据（中文）
├── icon.svg           # 插件图标（原创三柱图形）
└── README.md
```

## 安装

把本目录推到 GitHub 仓库（根目录即插件），之后任意 profile 一条命令直接安装：

```
dsh plugin add https://github.com/<user>/token-stat
```

也接受 `github:<user>/token-stat`、`git+https://…`、带 `#tag` 的任意 pnpm git 形式。
清单无构建脚本、无运行时依赖，pnpm 不会触发构建审批（`allowBuilds`），克隆打包即用；
测试目录不进安装产物（`files` 白名单）。Electron 托管的 profile（如 desktop）改用
`dsh plugin --profile desktop add …`；或在 DSH 会话里让 agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的
`install_bundle` 动作，`target` 传本目录的绝对路径。本地开发仍推荐目录链接：

```
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本目录绝对路径>
```

安装以本地链接方式指向本目录时，改代码后刷新 Web 页面即生效；调整
`exports`/`files` 等清单字段后需重新安装。

安装后刷新 Web 页面：输入框下方可见药丸（尚未产生任何对话用量时药丸不显示）；设置里
出现「Token 用量」项，点击即见统计。首次打开时页面会在后台补算历史会话的逐日明细。

## 覆盖配置

本插件当前无配置项。如后续新增，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中按 id 覆盖：

```yaml
- update:
    - id: token-stat
      config: {}
```

## 卸载

在 DSH 会话中让 agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `remove_bundle` 动作；
自建 profile 也可用 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @local/token-stat`。

## 许可

本地插件，随仓库分发；图标与代码均为原创，可自由修改。

# dsh-pet-baifan · 吃白饭

![吃白饭](assets/preview/cover.png)

dsh-pet（桌宠插件）的第三方扩展：右键桌宠 → **更多 → 吃白饭**，它就跑到屏幕底部等着，
米饭从天上一份份掉下来，追着吃到饱 —— 一直到被你把宠物拖走为止。

不自己养宠物、不画宠物：位移和动画全部借**你已经养的那只**（拿 dsh-pet 的占用锁指挥它），
页面里只多画米饭和头顶的分数。

## 安装 / 卸载

```powershell
# 本地开发：<repo> 换成 petE 的绝对路径，装的是链接（改完刷新即生效）
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:<repo>/baifan"
# 想装成不依赖本地目录的副本：先 npm pack，再 dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-pet-baifan-0.1.0.tgz
# 发布到 npm 之后：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-baifan

dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pet-baifan    # 卸（记得同时删掉 profile 里 bundles 的那一项）
```

包名、插件 id、客户端模块 id 都是 `dsh-pet-baifan`：这些都进全局命名空间（模块 id 撞了组合
直接失败，路由撞了直接抛错），带上前缀既表明它是 dsh-pet 的扩展，也不会被同名的通用词抢注。

装进 profile 后 `lib/` 是链接过去的，所以改代码只要**刷新页面**（Ctrl+F5）；只有宿主半侧
（`lib/index.js`）改动才需要重启 DSH。

## 怎么用

| 想干什么 | 怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 开一场 | 右键宠物 → 更多 → 吃白饭 |
| 让它停下 | **拖一下宠物**（占用锁被撤，当场收场，不用点菜单） |
| 重新来一场 | 再点一次「吃白饭」 |
| 看它吃了几份 | 吃完时头顶会弹分数气泡，图标跟着吃下去的东西变（碗饭 / 饭团） |

一场演出的顺序：跑到底部 → 原地蓄力 → 期待开饭 5 秒 → 米饭每 4.2 秒掉一份（场上最多 2 份）
→ 追着吃，吃完接着追。它会在这几个节拍上冒一两句台词（开饭、下去、等饭、掉落、吃完一口、
吃满 5 份）。38% 的概率掉的是碗饭，吃完还会掉个空碗下来。

![追饭](assets/preview/running.png)

## 依赖

- `dsh-pet` 必须在同一个 profile 里启用 —— 占用锁、菜单、动画、位置全在它那边；
- 宠物要在**网页**里显示（`display: web` 或 `both`），否则取锁会回 `pet-not-displayed`。

## 目录

```
dsh-pet-baifan/
├── package.json        # 包清单：宿主半侧入口 + dsh.client（web）+ dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 把 dsh-pet-baifan 这一层插进 DSH 配置树
├── lib/index.js        # 宿主半侧：把 assets/ 挂成 /dsh-pet-baifan/assets 前缀路由
├── lib/client.js       # 浏览器半侧：菜单、行为、米饭与分数
└── assets/
    ├── webm/           # 5 段动画（640×360 VP9-alpha）
    ├── pic/            # 3 张米饭图（碗饭 / 空碗 / 饭团）
    └── preview/        # README 用的截图，不随包发布
```

## 想改点什么

- **节奏**：`lib/client.js` 顶部的 `CFG`（掉饭间隔、跑速、位移时长、气泡时长…），每行都有注释。
- **台词**：同文件的 `LINES`，一组一句池，随机挑。
- **素材**：`assets/` 下的文件是 640×360 VP9-alpha；**重新编码素材后必须把 `lib/client.js`
  里的 `ASSET_V` 版本号 +1**，否则浏览器会用缓存里的旧片。

[![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](CONTRIBUTING.md)

**dsh-pet 的第三方扩展收录仓库。**

[dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet) 是 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的桌宠插件：一行命令装好，界面里就多一只透明动画小桌宠，能多开、能调大小位置，还能用 AI 视频自己做素材。

这个仓库把大家给它做的扩展收在一起——会吃白饭的、会打瞌睡的、会跟着鼠标跑的。你可以来挑一个装上，也可以把自己做的提交进来。

每个扩展占一个目录，收录信息写在目录里的 `plugin.json`；下面的列表由流水线从这些文件生成，不用手工维护。

## 收录列表

> 由流水线根据各扩展的 `plugin.json` 生成，请勿手工编辑。

<!-- plugins:start -->

### dsh-pet-baifan

右键桌宠，跑到屏幕底部，追着吃白饭。

![dsh-pet-baifan 1](baifan/assets/preview/cover.png)

![dsh-pet-baifan 2](baifan/assets/preview/running.png)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:PC2005-cloud/petE#path:/baifan"
```

图形化页面粘贴：`github:PC2005-cloud/petE#path:/baifan`

<!-- plugins:end -->

## 安装一个扩展

还没装 dsh-pet 的话，先按 [它的 README](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet) 装好——所有扩展都跑在它上面。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:PC2005-cloud/petE#path:/<扩展目录>"
```

也可以走图形化：DSH Web → 侧栏「插件」→「添加插件」，粘贴同样的地址：

```text
github:PC2005-cloud/petE#path:/<扩展目录>
```

`<扩展目录>` 是扩展的目录名，即包名去掉 `dsh-pet-` 前缀。安装前请确认 `dsh-pet` 已在同一个 profile 里启用。

## 想把自己的扩展放进来？

欢迎。收录规则、目录结构、`plugin.json` 字段和 PR 校验项都写在 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 里。

## 说明

- 各扩展的代码与素材归其作者所有；
- 收录不代表对功能或安全性的审核，安装前请自行阅读代码。

# dsh-excel-reconcile — Excel reconcile

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-excel-reconcile?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-excel-reconcile?ref=badge)

`dsh-excel-reconcile` joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields with declared tolerances, producing a markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook.

It reconciles; it does not adjudicate. A difference means the two sides disagree, not that either is wrong. Money is compared as integer minor units rather than floating point, so `12.3` and `12.30000000001` are the same amount at two decimal places, and a key that appears twice is reported instead of being paired with the first match.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-excel-reconcile
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-excel-reconcile'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-excel-reconcile: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-excel-reconcile-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings.*

**Boundary:** this is a comparison tool, not an audit. It does not decide which side is correct, does not verify that an invoice exists, and does not evaluate whether a payment was due. A duplicate key is reported and left uncompared rather than paired arbitrarily, because pairing the first of several matches hides the difference that matters. Tolerances are configuration, not regulation: the report says so, and the defaults only absorb rounding.

## What it answers

- Which keys exist on one side and not the other?
- Which matched rows disagree, on which field, and by how much?
- Is the disagreement bigger than the tolerance I configured?
- Which keys cannot be compared at all because they are duplicated?

## Standards it follows

This package encodes no clause. The reconciliation schema is its own: keys, compared fields, join mode, tolerance and severity. That is deliberate — a reconciliation has no normative basis to cite, and inventing one would make the report look more authoritative than it is.

The only format-level standards it depends on are the OOXML spreadsheet parts (`sharedStrings.xml`, `cellXfs`/`numFmtId`, `workbook.xml` plus `_rels`), which are read by `dsh-table-ingest`.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | all (pure ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |

## What it does

The tool takes two file paths and a YAML configuration:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `a.table`, `a.keys` | Side A's table name and key fields |
| `b.table`, `b.keys` | Side B's, positionally matched to A's keys |
| `join` | `full` (default), `left`, `inner`, `right` |
| `compare[]` | Fields to compare: `a`, `b`, `kind` (`number`/`text`/`date`), `abs`, `rel`, `severity`, `label` |
| `duplicates` | `reject` (default) reports and skips, `aggregate` would sum |
| `scale` | Decimal places for money, default 2 |

Findings are typed: `number-diff`, `text-diff`, `date-diff`, `not-a-number`, `missing-in-a`, `missing-in-b`, `duplicate-key`, `empty-key`.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | `rules/excel-reconcile.yaml` | 规则库路径 |

## Material format

```yaml
a: { table: 应收, keys: [合同号] }
b: { table: 对账单, keys: [合同号] }
join: full
compare:
  - { a: 客户, kind: text }
  - { a: 金额, kind: number, abs: 0.01 }
  - { a: 到期日, kind: date }
```

The diff workbook has five sheets: 汇总, 差异明细 (one row per difference, filterable), 仅A存在, 仅B存在, 合并结果. The difference sheet's columns are fixed: 序号, 问题类型, 严重程度, 主键, 字段, A 侧, B 侧, 差异, 说明, 建议处理, 处理状态.

## Rule sources

There is no evidence directory because there is nothing to cite: the rule pack is empty by design and each reconciliation carries its own configuration.

```sh
pnpm run check:citations   # expects 0 segments, 0 placeholders, 0 untraceable
```

Known limits: the join is single-level (no chained joins); a key present twice is never paired; money is compared at the configured scale, so a value carrying more decimals than that is rounded; and a column missing on one side produces a difference on every matched row rather than being skipped.

## Troubleshooting

- **The plugin installs but the tool never appears**: check that `main` resolves to `lib/index.mjs` and that `pnpm run build` produced it.
- **`dsh plugin add` rejects the package**: the peer range covers `0.1.x` and `0.2.x`; outside it, grant an explicit exemption.
- **A rule did not run**: read the `skipped` array.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build
node ../scripts/sync-shared.mjs dsh-excel-reconcile
```

# dsh-auto-model-routing English · [简体中文](README.zh.md) ![AUTO in action: a refactor-and-debug turn is judged complex and runs at high, a follow-up rename is judged simple and drops to low; hovering the AUTO chip shows the decision, clicking it switches to MANUAL](docs/auto-routing.gif) You should not have to raise or lower reasoning effort by hand for every message. In AUTO, each user turn is judged by the Jev decision model (via OpenRouter) as `simple` / `standard` / `complex` / `escalated`, and the plugin changes **only the reasoning effort** of the model you already picked. Provider and model are never changed. If Jev fails for any reason, AUTO switches itself off and the chip shows why. **Install.** DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, Node.js `>=22.19`. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-auto-model-routing # Or install source (approve the local build when prompted): dsh plugin --profile web add prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing ``` Restart DSH, refresh the Web page, then configure your OpenRouter key in **Settings → 自动模型路由**. The companion skill is included; it guides delegation but does not enforce every dispatch. Unlike model-pool routers or local classifiers, this plugin uses external Jev judgments and never switches the main model. The demos use an isolated Host with local mock Jev/model responses. In [ohmydsh](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh), enable only the local `auto-model-routing` entry and run `dsh build`; no separate skill customization is needed. ## Use | Where | What you do | |---|---| | **AUTO / MANUAL chip** (left of the model picker) | Click to switch. Hover to see this turn's effort, the latest Jev decision and its distribution. | | **Decision hint** | Appears above the chip for 3 s after each judgment, e.g. `complex → high · 0.70s`. | | **Gauge button** on a reply | Hover for the judgment; click to record which tier the turn should have used. | | **Settings → 自动模型路由** | OpenRouter key, default mode, effort cap, Jev deadline, hint switch and the routing maps (below). | ![Settings → Auto model routing: judging service, session defaults, and the Claude / GPT routing maps with main-chat effort and sub-agent recommendation per tier](docs/settings.gif) **Default effort.** Each model starts at its officially recommended effort: `standard` keeps it, `simple` goes one step down, `complex` one up, `escalated` two up. The result is capped (default `xhigh`), and AUTO never picks `max`. Each cell of the routing map can override this: main efforts apply to every model of a provider family, and sub-agent cells are full model + effort pairs. **Sub-agents.** The `route_subagent` tool uses the same judgment and returns provider/model/effort (Claude: Haiku → Sonnet → Opus → Opus; GPT: Luna → Sol → Sol → Sol). It only judges when the root chat is AUTO, and otherwise returns `routed: false`. These routes must be in the official sub-agent allowlist, which is fixed when a chat is created. ## Good to know - **New chats default to MANUAL.** You can change this in Settings. - **Fail closed.** No key, out of credits, rate limit, region block, timeout or a bad reply: the chat goes to `MANUAL · Jev 停用` with the reason. Click AUTO to retry. There is no local fallback and no retry. - **MANUAL only stops changes.** The chat keeps the last effort AUTO set. AUTO also writes it into the official selection, so new chats start from it. - **Data sent out.** In AUTO, every user turn sends up to 8000 characters of your message and short parts of the previous turn to OpenRouter / TypeSafe (`typesafe/jev-1.13`). The text is redacted by shape first (keys, tokens, URL credentials, IPs). This is best effort and does not guarantee that every secret is removed. - **The key** is stored through the official DSH credentials service, never in the plugin config. A key in the launch environment (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`) takes precedence and is read-only. To move it to the GUI, remove it from the launch environment, restart once, then save it in Settings. - **Files.** Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-auto-model-routing/config.json`; per-chat mode and judgments live in `$DSH_HOME/state/auto-model-routing/`. Changes take effect on the next request; no restart is needed. ## Architecture ![auto-model-routing architecture: the chip and RPC endpoints, the agent/pre-step hook asking Jev through OpenRouter, the agent/request hook rewriting only reasoning effort, and the route_subagent tool sharing the same judgment](docs/architecture.dual.svg) An `agent/pre-step` hook judges step 1 of each user turn. An `agent/request` hook (prepended) then rewrites only `reasoningEffort`, and syncs it to the official model selection. Entry point: [`src/index.ts`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing/blob/main/src/index.ts). Rubric: [`src/rubric.json`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing/blob/main/src/rubric.json). Effort table: [`src/effort.ts`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing/blob/main/src/effort.ts). UI: [`src/client/`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing/blob/main/src/client/index.ts). Regression cases: [`eval/`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing/blob/main/eval/README.md). Diagram source: [`docs/architecture.json`](docs/architecture.json) (archify). ## Development ```sh npm test npm run typecheck npm run build ``` Tests use the real AgentLoop with a fake LLM stream and a loopback fake Jev; they never call OpenRouter. `node scripts/label-report.mjs` summarizes your tier labels per rubric version. Specs and design: the current spec is [`openspec/specs/auto-model-routing`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/blob/main/openspec/specs/auto-model-routing/spec.md). The archived changes record the design history: [routing](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/blob/main/openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-22-auto-model-routing/design.md) (decisions D1–D14) and [settings](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/blob/main/openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-23-auto-model-routing-settings/design.md). The companion skill is [`skills/subagent-model-routing`](skills/subagent-model-routing/SKILL.md). Before you change the hooks, read [DSH plugin integration pitfalls](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/blob/main/docs/architecture/dsh-plugin-integration-pitfalls.md). ## Removal Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-auto-model-routing`, then restart DSH and refresh the page. --- ## What it does ohmydsh turns the configuration of **one person's DSH** into a single, reviewable, reproducible repository and manages it across its whole lifecycle: **add** a plugin, **review** its trust surface, **pin** an exact version, **build** it into place, **upgrade** it later, **disable** it without losing it, and finally **remove** it. - The **repository is the source of truth.** Everything that defines your setup lives here: the manifest, self-developed packages, skills, presets, patches and environment-level agent instructions. - **`~/.dsh` is a generated product.** `dsh build` materializes the repository into it idempotently. Never edit it by hand; change the repository and build again. - **`dsh.yaml` is the single switch.** The DSH version, the auto-update policy and every customization are declared there. `enabled: false` disables an entry without deleting it. Two kinds of readers, two entry points: - **You (or your AI) want to manage your own DSH** — start at [Quick start](#quick-start) and [Architecture](#architecture). - **You (or your AI) want to know what the self-developed plugins solve** — jump to the [plugin index](#plugins). ## Quick start You need Node.js 22+ and npm 10+ (see `.nvmrc`) and a bash shell (macOS, Linux, WSL or Git Bash). Pick one of three paths. ### Path 1 — copy my full configuration ```bash git clone https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh.git && cd ohmydsh ./scripts/bootstrap.sh # check Node and install dependencies (idempotent) ./scripts/install.sh # link the launcher into ~/.local/bin dsh build && dsh # materialize the configuration, then start DSH ``` ### Path 2 — pick parts Start from path 1, then trim `dsh.yaml`: set `enabled: false` on what you do not want (it stays in the repository and is easy to re-enable) or delete the entry for good. The `add-dsh-plugin` and `remove-dsh-plugin` skills make the edit, run `dsh build` and ask before restarting. Run `dsh build` again after every change. ### Path 3 — start from zero Replace `dsh.yaml` with the minimal manifest below and run `dsh build`. No new command, script or template is involved. ```yaml dshVersion: 0.2.0-rc.2 autoUpdate: enabled: false customizations: [] ``` `autoUpdate.enabled` must be explicitly `false`. When it is absent, auto-update defaults to on, and the launcher would then edit `dsh.yaml` and commit the change on its own. `dsh reset` is **not** the from-zero route. It only undeploys customizations from `~/.dsh`; the manifest stays unchanged and `dsh build` restores everything. ### Let an AI agent do it Hand this prompt to your agent. It asks which path you want and then follows the guard rails. ```text You are installing ohmydsh, a DSH customization repository. Follow these rules in order: 1. [ASK-PATH] Ask me first which path I want: (1) copy the full configuration, (2) pick parts, (3) start from zero. Do nothing before I answer. 2. [VERIFY-IDEMPOTENT] After every change run `dsh build` twice; the second run must report no changes. If it does not, stop and report. 3. [NO-DEPLOY-EDIT] Never hand-edit anything under ~/.dsh. Change dsh.yaml or the repository sources, then run `dsh build`. 4. [NO-SECRETS] Never write credentials into the manifest, command arguments or this chat. Secrets belong in .env.local only. 5. [STOP-ON-FAIL-CLOSED] If sync fails closed (for example AGENTS.md drift), stop and report the exact error. Never delete files to get around it. 6. [ASK-RESTART] Ask me before restarting DSH. ``` ### Command cheat-sheet ```text dsh build materialize dsh.yaml into ~/.dsh without starting DSH dsh stop stop the running DSH dsh restart stop, wait for the port, start again dsh reset undeploy customizations (the manifest is untouched) dsh history list previous startups and the plugins they loaded dsh plugin-update check remote plugins, confirm, edit dsh.yaml, build, commit dsh doctor check and repair host-level prerequisites ``` ## Architecture ![ohmydsh architecture: repository as source of truth, sync, ~/.dsh, DSH runtime](docs/assets/ohmydsh-architecture.dual.svg) ### Mental model The repository declares *what should be installed*. `scripts/sync.mjs` (run by `dsh build`) makes `~/.dsh` match it, fails closed on anything it cannot prove, and changes nothing on the second run. DSH then loads `~/.dsh` like any other deployment. ### Where customizations come from | Source | Declared as | Example | |---|---|---| | Third-party npm package | `source: remote`, exact version pin | `width-tiers` | | Official optional bundle | `source: remote`, pinned to the DSH version | `experimental-schedule` | | Self-developed package in this repository | `source: local`, code in `packages//` | `dsh-memex` | | Self-developed package in another repository | `source: remote`, GitHub release tarball | `dsh-cockpit-bridge` | | Skill | `type: skill`, `skills//` | `ws` | | Patch | `type: patch`, `patches/.yml` | `connection-webserver` | | Preset | `type: preset`, `presets//` | `dsh-pet-executor` | | Third-party resource | `thirdPartyResources`, pinned with integrity | `spec-superflow` | ### Directory layout ```text dsh.yaml the single switch surface instructions/ environment-level agent instructions packages// self-developed DSH packages skills// skills synced to ~/.dsh/skills presets// agent presets patches/.yml composition patches and overrides scripts/ sync, build, upgrade and maintenance scripts openspec/ specs and changes: behavior is written down before it is built docs/ adr/ decisions, architecture/ mechanisms, assets/ diagrams tests/ repository-level tests ``` ### Lifecycle ![ohmydsh customization lifecycle: add, review, pin, build, verify, upgrade, disable, remove](docs/assets/ohmydsh-lifecycle.dual.svg) Every customization follows the same loop: add the entry, review its source and trust surface, pin an exact version, build, verify that a second build changes nothing, and upgrade by repeating the loop. Finally disable it, or remove the entry and build again to uninstall it. ### Private overlay Entries that cannot be published (internal packages, machine-specific patches) go into a gitignored overlay. It is validated exactly like public entries and can only append. See [private overlay](docs/architecture/private-overlay.md). More mechanisms: [environment-level agent instructions](docs/architecture/agent-instructions.md) and [DSH plugin integration pitfalls](docs/architecture/dsh-plugin-integration-pitfalls.md) (read it before touching host capabilities). ## Multiple machines Each machine does the same two things: clone this repository (plus your optional private overlay) and run `dsh build`. [dsh-cockpit](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-cockpit) lets you manage and view several machines from one place. It does not distribute configuration; the repository does. ## Your configuration - `dsh.yaml` is the truth. Read it, not `~/.dsh`. - `node scripts/plugin-list.mjs` prints what is actually loaded. - A private overlay (`dsh.yaml.local`, or the file named by `DSH_LOCAL_MANIFEST`) appends entries that must not be public. - `.env.local` (gitignored) holds local settings and every secret. - `thirdPartyResources` pins assets that are not plugins: the spec-superflow workflow skills, the Jev MCP server (its `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` comes from `.env.local` only, never from the manifest) and the Anvil OpenSpec schema. ## Plugins Every enabled entry of `dsh.yaml`, grouped by origin. Third-party items link to their upstream; self-developed items link to their directory in this repository. ### Third-party packages - [cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) — Shows per-session cost statistics in the web client. - [archify-dsh](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) — Generates interactive architecture, sequence and data-flow diagrams from a conversation. - [llm-subscriptions](https://github.com/V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions) — Adds subscription-based providers (Codex, Claude, Grok, Copilot) switchable from the input box. - [width-tiers](https://github.com/aaronlei/dsh-width-tiers) — Switches the conversation width between five tiers. - [better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) — Turns the sidebar into a service-backed workbench with tabs. - [dsh-opencode-session-header](https://github.com/beihzb/dsh-opencode-session-header) — Sends the session header that OpenCode Go requires, fixing missing-session errors. - [michengai-btw](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-btw) — Adds `/btw` for one-off side questions answered from the current context, without running tools or writing back to the main conversation. Temporarily installed from a fork release of upstream MichengAI/dsh-btw PR #16. - [dsh-magpie-connect](https://github.com/bitxeno/dsh-magpie-connect) — Brings the models of a Magpie AI gateway into the model picker, alongside the direct providers. ### Official optional - [experimental-schedule](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle) — Official scheduled-automation page, schedule tools and time context. ### Third-party resources - [spec-superflow](https://github.com/MageByte-Zero/spec-superflow) — State-machine workflow skills for planned, spec-driven changes. - [jev](https://github.com/jkudish/jev-mcp) — MCP server giving agents semantic judgment tools; the key stays in `.env.local`. - [anvil](https://github.com/jikkujoyce/openspec-schemas) — OpenSpec schema for test-first change workflows. - [ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail) — Prompt-only skills for a minimal-change, low-bloat coding mode and its review and audit commands. ### Adapted third-party skills - [i-have-adhd](skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md) — Answer-first, short-step output mode, used only when explicitly requested. - [frontend-design](skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md) — Design guidance that avoids templated, default-looking interfaces. - [eli5](skills/eli5/SKILL.md) — Explains any topic at the level of a chosen audience. ### Self-developed packages - [worktree-session](packages/worktree-session/README.md) — Creates an isolated task branch and worktree on the first message of a session. - [dsh-openspec](packages/dsh-openspec/README.md) — Managed adapter exposing the official OpenSpec workflows as skills and commands. - [dsh-memex](packages/dsh-memex/README.md) — Native persistent memory with per-workspace scopes and a memory settings page. - [dsh-pet](packages/dsh-pet/README.md) — A resident desktop companion agent that runs management skills on a trusted snapshot. - [sidebar-session-provider-icon](packages/sidebar-session-provider-icon/README.md) — Shows the selected model's brand logo on every sidebar session row. - [session-title-copy](packages/session-title-copy/README.md) — Adds a short session-id badge next to the title that copies the full id. - [system-clock](packages/system-clock/README.md) — Shows the DSH host's clock, time zone and hostname at the bottom of settings. - [sidebar-session-resources](packages/sidebar-session-resources/README.md) — Collects links and produced files of the current session into a sidebar panel. - [home-network-model-guard](packages/home-network-model-guard/README.md) — Disables Claude models in the input box when the host egress region is restricted. - [subscriptions-sandbox-shim](packages/subscriptions-sandbox-shim/README.md) — Strips sandbox escalation fields and orphan tool calls for subscription providers. - [magpie-display-name-shim](packages/magpie-display-name-shim/README.md) — Shows Magpie gateway display names in the model picker instead of route ids, until the upstream fix ships. - [cockpit-worktree-open-shim](packages/cockpit-worktree-open-shim/README.md) — Connects the cockpit remote editor to Worktree Session's open action. - [cockpit-memex-browse-shim](packages/cockpit-memex-browse-shim/README.md) — Connects cockpit port forwarding to the memory card browser. - [dsh-collab](packages/dsh-collab/README.md) — Lets existing independent sessions share a collaboration ledger by invitation and wakes members on their next turn. - [auto-model-routing](packages/auto-model-routing/README.md) — In AUTO, asks the Jev decision model for each turn's tier and adjusts only reasoning effort; any Jev failure turns AUTO off and says why. [Standalone repository](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing). ### Self-developed skills, preset and patch - [ws](skills/ws/SKILL.md) — Inspects, promotes and cleans Worktree Session bindings. - [jev-workflow-router](skills/jev-workflow-router/SKILL.md) — Observation-only routing hint on whether work should use a formal workflow. - [memex-recall-report](skills/memex-recall-report/SKILL.md) — Reports memory recall statistics and which cards are never recalled. - [add-dsh-plugin](skills/add-dsh-plugin/SKILL.md) — Adds a remote plugin to the manifest, builds it and asks about a restart. - [remove-dsh-plugin](skills/remove-dsh-plugin/SKILL.md) — Removes a plugin from the manifest, builds and asks about a restart. - [dsh-sandbox-notes](skills/dsh-sandbox-notes/SKILL.md) — Notes on sandbox permissions and the "not strictly wider" error. - [subagent-model-routing](packages/auto-model-routing/skills/subagent-model-routing/SKILL.md) — Calls route_subagent before delegating and passes its model and effort explicitly; pauses and asks on failure. - [dsh-pet-executor](presets/dsh-pet-executor) — Preset for Pet execution sessions without the global skill provider. - [connection-webserver](patches/connection-webserver.yml) — Composition patch that restores Connection RPC channel registration. - [websocket-heartbeat](patches/websocket-heartbeat.yml) — Config patch that relaxes the official gateway's WebSocket heartbeat to 5 seconds so large histories survive short network hiccups. - [ponytail-skills](patches/ponytail-skills.yml) — Composition patch that mounts a dedicated skill provider for the ponytail package only. ### Self-developed, separate repository - [dsh-cockpit-bridge](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-cockpit) — Bridge between DSH and the dsh-cockpit multi-machine manager, installed from a GitHub release. ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) first, plus [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Behavior changes go through an OpenSpec change. Any change to `README.md` must update `README.zh.md` in the same commit, and the other way round. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Third-party plugins keep their own licenses; their upstream links are in the [plugin index](#plugins).

# dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim English · [简体中文](README.zh.md) When dsh-memex runs on another machine, its "open cards" button would point your browser at a `localhost` address that is not the memex host. This shim makes the button use the port forward that dsh-cockpit publishes, so the card browser opens at an address that really reaches the device. The only deployment-side coupling point: it registers the bridge's port forwarding into memex's generic browse-address extension. The sources and dependencies of the two ends never reference each other; removing the shim decouples them. ## 0.2.0 behaviour and prerequisites - Requires the bridge to provide `cockpitBridge.forwards` (the production deployment pins 0.6.4). The old `portForward` / channel register / publish contracts are no longer supported. - No top-level `inject`; each service is read once with a full dotted name through `ctx.get()`, so any load order of the two ends works. - It uses `acquire(devicePort, holder)`, single-flight per port; the holder carries a random binding id so that a late release from an old binding cannot affect its replacement. - starting/retrying/paused states wait for ready through `onChange`, for at most 15 seconds. Only the current `handle.address.url` is delivered; no URL is cached and the shim does not retry by itself. After opening, the holder is kept so the tunnel is not reclaimed right after the tab opens. - removed rejects the current wait and is not re-acquired automatically. The next explicit open can acquire again, including when the handle was deleted between two clicks. - Only a structured `CockpitForwardsError` with `code === 'local-device'` falls back to `http://localhost:`. unavailable (no handshake / not inside the cockpit iframe) cannot prove that the browser and the device are on the same machine, so like network or business failures it is rethrown unchanged; the user can still use the known device address directly. - A memex-only deployment that never discovered a bridge keeps the default local behaviour. If a bridge was discovered and is later unloaded or replaced, pending waits are cancelled and the old handle is released; while the bridge is gone, a fail-closed resolver stays in place so that a remote address never silently falls back to the browser's localhost. - The resolver is unregistered when the memex side is unloaded or the shim is disposed. Release includes late acquires and failures are handled; the bridge's page-instance reclamation is the final safety net. ## Verification Independent package test/typecheck/build. The integration regression uses memex's real registry (which returns localhost when nothing is wired) rather than a fake registry that would hide mis-routing. It covers ready waiting, concurrency, address changes, removal, failure classification and the service lifecycle. ## Removal This shim connects two ends: the **`cockpitBridge.forwards` port-forwarding service** of `dsh-cockpit-bridge` and the **`dshMemex.browseAddress` registry** of `dsh-memex`. Their sources and dependencies do not reference each other; the shim is the only place they meet. Remove it when you no longer open memex cards across machines through dsh-cockpit, or when either end ships the integration natively: delete the manifest entry → `dsh build` → restart; neither end needs any migration. Rolling back to an older shim must also roll the bridge back to a version that provides the old service; never mix the 0.1.1 shim with bridge 0.6.x.

# dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim English · [简体中文](README.zh.md) Without this shim, the "open in editor" action of a Worktree Session on a remote machine falls back to a local `vscode://file/` link that cannot reach the worktree. The shim hands the worktree path to dsh-cockpit's remote-editor capability so the editor opens on the right machine. A deployment-side adapter: it registers the remote-editor open capability exposed by `dsh-cockpit-bridge` into the generic open-behaviour extension point of `dsh-worktree-session`. ```text dsh-cockpit-bridge ──provide──▶ shim ──register──▶ dsh-worktree-session knows nothing about ws knows nothing about cockpit ``` ## Why a separate package Worktree Session is a generic plugin and must not know about dsh-cockpit; dsh-cockpit-bridge must not know its concrete consumers either. All coupling between the two ends lives only in this shim, which keeps independent upgrades and complete removal possible. ## Behaviour - No top-level `inject`; at runtime it watches both services appearing and disappearing, so any load order works. - It reads the bridge service by the full dotted name `ctx.get('cockpitBridge.editorOpen')`; `ctx.get('cockpitBridge').editorOpen` is forbidden. - It forwards only the absolute worktree path, unchanged, to the bridge: no validation, no rewriting, no state, no retries. - If either end is missing or unloaded, the shim is inert; Worktree Session automatically falls back to its default `vscode://file/` behaviour. ## Prerequisites and known limits - Requires `dsh-cockpit-bridge >= 0.4.0` (this repository currently pins 0.6.4); an older bridge does not provide the service and the shim silently does nothing. - The host machine needs VS Code Remote-SSH installed and must be able to reach the target device through the SSH config alias registered for the Cockpit device. - Without Remote-SSH the URI may be silently dropped; a directory name containing a dot may be treated as a file by the VS Code URI handler. ## Removal This shim connects two ends: the **`cockpitBridge.editorOpen` service** of `dsh-cockpit-bridge` and the **open-behaviour extension point** (`worktreeSession.openHandler`) of `dsh-worktree-session`. Neither side references the other, so the shim is the only place the two meet. It can be removed at any time, and it should be removed once you stop using dsh-cockpit remote editors, or when either end ships the integration natively. Delete or disable `cockpit-worktree-open-shim` in `dsh.yaml`, run `dsh build`, and restart DSH web. After removal: - Worktree Session returns to the default `vscode://file/` behaviour; - existing dsh-cockpit-bridge features such as session read-confirmation and the pending snapshot are unaffected; - neither end needs any source or configuration migration.

Never edit it by hand; change the repository and build again. - **`dsh.yaml` is the single switch.** The DSH version, the auto-update policy and every customization are declared there. `enabled: false` disables an entry without deleting it. Two kinds of readers, two entry points: - **You (or your AI) want to manage your own DSH** — start at [Quick start](#quick-start) and [Architecture](#architecture). - **You (or your AI) want to know what the self-developed plugins solve** — jump to the [plugin index](#plugins). ## Quick start You need Node.js 22+ and npm 10+ (see `.nvmrc`) and a bash shell (macOS, Linux, WSL or Git Bash). Pick one of three paths. ### Path 1 — copy my full configuration ```bash git clone https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh.git && cd ohmydsh ./scripts/bootstrap.sh # check Node and install dependencies (idempotent) ./scripts/install.sh # link the launcher into ~/.local/bin dsh build && dsh # materialize the configuration, then start DSH ``` ### Path 2 — pick parts Start from path 1, then trim `dsh.yaml`: set `enabled: false` on what you do not want (it stays in the repository and is easy to re-enable) or delete the entry for good. The `add-dsh-plugin` and `remove-dsh-plugin` skills make the edit, run `dsh build` and ask before restarting. Run `dsh build` again after every change. ### Path 3 — start from zero Replace `dsh.yaml` with the minimal manifest below and run `dsh build`. No new command, script or template is involved. ```yaml dshVersion: 0.2.0-rc.2 autoUpdate: enabled: false customizations: [] ``` `autoUpdate.enabled` must be explicitly `false`. When it is absent, auto-update defaults to on, and the launcher would then edit `dsh.yaml` and commit the change on its own. `dsh reset` is **not** the from-zero route. It only undeploys customizations from `~/.dsh`; the manifest stays unchanged and `dsh build` restores everything. ### Let an AI agent do it Hand this prompt to your agent. It asks which path you want and then follows the guard rails. ```text You are installing ohmydsh, a DSH customization repository. Follow these rules in order: 1. [ASK-PATH] Ask me first which path I want: (1) copy the full configuration, (2) pick parts, (3) start from zero. Do nothing before I answer. 2. [VERIFY-IDEMPOTENT] After every change run `dsh build` twice; the second run must report no changes. If it does not, stop and report. 3. [NO-DEPLOY-EDIT] Never hand-edit anything under ~/.dsh. Change dsh.yaml or the repository sources, then run `dsh build`. 4. [NO-SECRETS] Never write credentials into the manifest, command arguments or this chat. Secrets belong in .env.local only. 5. [STOP-ON-FAIL-CLOSED] If sync fails closed (for example AGENTS.md drift), stop and report the exact error. Never delete files to get around it. 6. [ASK-RESTART] Ask me before restarting DSH. ``` ### Command cheat-sheet ```text dsh build materialize dsh.yaml into ~/.dsh without starting DSH dsh stop stop the running DSH dsh restart stop, wait for the port, start again dsh reset undeploy customizations (the manifest is untouched) dsh history list previous startups and the plugins they loaded dsh plugin-update check remote plugins, confirm, edit dsh.yaml, build, commit dsh doctor check and repair host-level prerequisites ``` ## Architecture ![ohmydsh architecture: repository as source of truth, sync, ~/.dsh, DSH runtime](docs/assets/ohmydsh-architecture.dual.svg) ### Mental model The repository declares *what should be installed*. `scripts/sync.mjs` (run by `dsh build`) makes `~/.dsh` match it, fails closed on anything it cannot prove, and changes nothing on the second run. DSH then loads `~/.dsh` like any other deployment. ### Where customizations come from | Source | Declared as | Example | |---|---|---| | Third-party npm package | `source: remote`, exact version pin | `width-tiers` | | Official optional bundle | `source: remote`, pinned to the DSH version | `experimental-schedule` | | Self-developed package in this repository | `source: local`, code in `packages//` | `dsh-memex` | | Self-developed package in another repository | `source: remote`, GitHub release tarball | `dsh-cockpit-bridge` | | Skill | `type: skill`, `skills//` | `ws` | | Patch | `type: patch`, `patches/.yml` | `connection-webserver` | | Preset | `type: preset`, `presets//` | `dsh-pet-executor` | | Third-party resource | `thirdPartyResources`, pinned with integrity | `spec-superflow` | ### Directory layout ```text dsh.yaml the single switch surface instructions/ environment-level agent instructions packages// self-developed DSH packages skills// skills synced to ~/.dsh/skills presets// agent presets patches/.yml composition patches and overrides scripts/ sync, build, upgrade and maintenance scripts openspec/ specs and changes: behavior is written down before it is built docs/ adr/ decisions, architecture/ mechanisms, assets/ diagrams tests/ repository-level tests ``` ### Lifecycle ![ohmydsh customization lifecycle: add, review, pin, build, verify, upgrade, disable, remove](docs/assets/ohmydsh-lifecycle.dual.svg) Every customization follows the same loop: add the entry, review its source and trust surface, pin an exact version, build, verify that a second build changes nothing, and upgrade by repeating the loop.
